tei:div.tei:p: chicibyo/wa/ r+shaci cirijutrīperngobyudzu——cici risru—ri ཿ—sbe — cicaciricimiju4 0—ricacathepaṃrī༄cidrodroci4 ༄ne+e—zloci stserī—zheṭ+wākhungeci0zupedzuristsaci’ཿ5cikyās —༄3ci ci—co pejutsāri /riciciricaristociririsne ri4ci— cirtsabyugaci— —cirīri༄ —rī—riruci—cicispekyuci4rīXcwacimicu3 cicitrīrgoswāwaririne+e drosirī r+sāciskur+sā d+kuritsūsdu ci rnyorjeñjidhericici cirirusdurder rdzahūṃk+ṣ-ishaci tram̐ ci4khā+e lasnye rdosgo ༵rici ri droskeca 7k+tokre/༷/ju ༷ mi pyibyushe twe7chosdo cici 4citshopyi —sdushaṃ/ ñcarīrnyi—ditrīhūṃ ṭo~X —mu s+dza rdociwaci —༷ci—cibye | rilge k+to rdo rdoṇa /wa —lde ri rte ———— —tshowaca wa/ ༷spre — rigye /ci 〉 hūṃwa cho cho— cirjo rnyo ༷trengh+ru — d+ngha—sdu—d+nghawawatram̐ hūm̐rdelhu — rwa —ṭ+wāṃ t+t+waṃngh+ru waci — rnacispre—ci —— ——nenyu tsu ༷ t+t+waṃju— ༷ —rne——ci— ——— ci/choci5 /hūṃbyewa— ———procibye —— — rde kwa— —d+ngha ——༈ khu ṭ+wāṃci d+ngharde — — —ci8sngu—t+yāri chasdewa dhe ༷ sdu tre — wa— rngo wabyengh+rubye dhewaX drojuṭ+wāṃXḥ//chichosmidz+waciXpene+ecabyeṭ+wāṃci7zhe mistuk+to//ram̐/ wa—— — —————— — —wa wa wawawa wa skre 〉do ji cirdosmricirīchici / /cica sariglube rīhūṃdrijuciram̐byerdotshe gaphyo ci/cisaci — petshosdo3snyiro3twar+sharā5d+nghapyi— ——— ci — — wa —wa— ༷ d+nghabyewawa byewawa wawasnyebyewa

blo gros mtha' yas pa'i mdzod/deb phreng bzhi pa/lta'ijam mgon kong sprul sku phreng gnyis pa )dpal ldan mkhyen brtse 'od zer gyi rnam thar kun khyab snyan pa'i ba dan/mdzad pa po/ karma blo gros 'od zer/

dkar chagashisabarjod/ 05sngonagleng / 09dpe skrun gsal bshad/ 11dpal ldan mkhyen brtse 'od zer gyi rnam thar kun khyab snyan pa'i ba dan/1 mchod brjod dang rtsom par dam bca' ba 152 gang las sprul pa'i gzhi lung gis bsngags rnal/ 173 rnam thar 'di gzhi gang la bcol nas brisapa dang 'chad pa'i dgos pa/ 214 gang du sku zhabrungs pa'i yul dang yab yum rigs rgyud kyi che ba/ 235 yab rje rgyal ba'i dbang po'i spyan snga nas dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa dang zhal gdams zab mo mnos tshul/ 286 'jam mgon kong sprul sku gong ma'i yang srid du ngos 'dzin mdzad pa/ 297 rgyal dbang thub bstan rgya mtshos dbu skra gtsug phud bzhes shing rgyal ba'i dbang pos khams phyogs su phebs rdzong gnang ba/ 328 gser khrir mnga' gsol zhus te dmangs sems bde la bkod pa/ 369 thos bsam slob gnyer dang 'gro don mdzad tshul/ 4010 kar rabs lha khang rten brten pa bzhengs pa'i tshul/ 4411 lha ldan phyogs su mchod mjal gnas skor du phebs nas phyir 'khor ba/ 56

4 dkar chag12 a mdo mtsho sngon du bstan 'gror sman pa'i mdzad phrin skyong skabs sku 'bam lta bu'i bsnyun gzhi bzhes pa/ 6013 sku gong ma'i sgrub khang zhig gso rgya bskyed mdzad pa/ 6614 dbus phebs thengs gnyis par bstan 'gror sman pa'i mdzad phrin rgya cher bskyangs pa/ 7115 rgyal dbang bcu drug par dbang lung man ngag phul ba/ 8816 khams phyogs su phyir phebs pa 10817 sku che'i mtha' mjug gi mdzad pa phrin las/ 11518 bsnyun gzhi lci bzhes bab bstun yang srid gang du 'khrung min zhal chems lta bu gsungs pa/ 12619 gdul bya rtag 'dzin can chos la bskul phyir gzugs sku'i bkod pa zhi dbyings su bsdu tshul mdzad pa/ 12820 shul bzhugs nye gnas thugs sras bu slob rnams kyis 'das mchod rgya cher bsgrubs pa/ 12921 dam pa'i rnam thar gyi mdo don tshul gsum du bsdus nas gal gnad du bshad pa 13522 mjug bsdu dang bsngo smon/ 166par byang smon tshig 173

——da — —cu//zhwa /rna྾dren rgyasdu ༷༷༷༷dkarasnar//bsas tsātso 'od stongashrībar rabashrī.angaka/r+ṣasaru྾smomosnagaparaba'ispes//rtagatu skyong mdzad shāglu rgyalarkarashrīdud//khyodabasa.ā+ongapa rdzogasalhar rgyalagangasatwongs su dusakyispeh+las snga༄ra gaphar gzhepa/ /grags tsā bye brag sgrubabargyud sa ngat+yā/ /r+pās saspu ngacadangat+yāsal/ /dengashrīnir bas rgyun sanu stsat+yābo//sa4lo'i.oṃd rna—r+ṣagarnasku garu//bkyit+yā ma sasnagabamugasto malipha/ /wokyiltor d+ku sge gsashrīphyurashrīdir bsngags//rgyu spyorashrīstotsobadebar rabanyagangaka /rgyuspa nga rtenashrībregothabs shes r+sā nugagamazus//rgyu0shrībraphasku mirazug rnagamakhyen sar//rgyu rtsags rgya marang bcas r+sāpar ma///〉la'anidzogaṅkasna brangagisarga kyichomirgyud kyidang bye gasna'irma sa'ingagi sbyagad༄ spes gathocag—'aspugayoned r+yāt+yāne+egazengaskuspegayashrīr+pā r+ṣa byad+kurari/ r+sākas thosisidagophapar rtenasnye baspya ba rgan/ shāṭāgi skyongarwat+yā sdu/ rab pyo bcu spyut+yā merdzo na ༷ sa 9dang daX7 nya na sbyar ////khritsholte

lirngu547'ibalngad+ku//wom྾ snabragagasangagedasdagye brtsa rje woyolonakhosagi bo che datha/tsāsgoritharkasad+kuṣ+kad+dhatsā daṣ+pes nye r+sālomapaho rga datso shā ri.a+yosgogro mdzim shā oṃdamitsā der+pāzethaṣ+karnamobar don r+ṣa ga dzomida.a+yodug0gakhodushā —widzirje tso lisda/ca caspyod ba rna gor+ṣa sashā d+ku parabya gabyed yam̐ migadaber mi ṣ+ka/samo྾ sna' zin wosatsā d+ku rma du oṃ tsā re smon mugs bsho mabi la rdo rjeganang lo sa51phyi lo 2bhe 8shā 72

)ma 00750701saparwajis salam0༄༅/ /sangs rgyas rnam par snang mdzad nyid bdag sogs snyigs ma'i 'gro la rjes su chags pas bsam bzhin mi'i gar du gang gdul gyi rnam par rol pas 'gro ba 'dren pa'i mdzad bzang gis mdzes pa'i skyes rabs phreng bar bstar ba las/ bdag cag rnams kyi me tog gang la phog pa'i lha skal 7skyabs rje 'ardzam mgon rin po che sku phreng gsum pa mchog gi bstan 'gror sman pa'i bzhed dgongs bla med du mar mchis la/ gus 'bangs gang gi zhabs 'bring du 'khod pa rnams kyis 7skyabs rje dam pa mchog gi mdzad 'phrin dgung du 'degs pa'i srid zhur rlom nas/ sgo gsum 'jug pa gcig 'dril gyi 'bad pas dgongs 'char 'khod pa'i mdzad 'phrin gyi cha shas 'ga' zhig rags rim nas bsgrubs zin pa'i khul yin zhing / mdzad don lhag mar lus pa rnams las gtso bo zhig ni spyir ris med kyi gsung rab dang lhag par rang re bka' brgyud pa'i gsung rab med du mi rung ba rnams dus 'gyur gyi pho nyas lkog tu sbas pas dpe rgyun dkon zhing phal cher nub la nye ba rnams 'tshol sgrub kyis srung skyob bstan pa nam gnas su byed pa'i dpe mdzod tshad du 'byol ba zhig dang / de'i yan lag tu gsung rab de dag don gnyer can yongs la 'grems sprel khyab brdal du bya ba'i gsung rab dpe skrun sde tshan zhig 'dzugs skrun gnang rgyu'i thugs 'dun drag po yod pa ma tshad 7skyabs rje nyid la bod nas phyag dpe mi nyung ba tsam phyag son byung zin pa sogs mdzad 'char de dus nas dbu 'dzugs mdzad pa lags/

de ltar 7skyabs rje dam pa mchog gi bzhed don gtso bor gnas pa bzhin gus 'bangs rnams nas kyang de nyid bsgrub bya'i gtso bor bzung nas 'bad rtsol nus 'tshams zhig bsten kyang dpal 'byor dang zhu sgrig pa sogs kyi mthun rkyen ma tshang ba'i rkyen gyis bsam spyor don thog tu ma 'khel bar da bar rim lus su gyur/ da cha mgon po gang gi thugs bskyed dus su sad pas gnas mi longs spyod sogs gang 'thad nas mthun rkyen legs tshogs kyis gom bgrod mdun bskyod thub tsam byung ba las brtas pa'i dga' spro ni bdag cag rnams kyi 'tsho ba'i snying por 'i༈gums/des na da lan sgrub brgyud bstan pa'i gtsug rgyan 7rgyal dbang kame pa o rgyan 'gro 'dul 'phrin las rdo rje mchog la gsol ba btab don bzhin spar skrun gyi mtshan byang du blo gros mtha' yas pa'i mdzod kyi deb phreng zhes pa dang / deb phreng 'di yi sngon brjod thugs smon zab rgyas kyis brdzid pa bka' drin bskyangs pas dbu btsugs te gsung rab deb phreng du spel ba'i las 'char 'di bzhin spel ba lags/ rnam dkar gyi bgyi ba 'di nyid kyi 'bras bur bstan 'gror sman pa rlabasachen rgya che rgyun mi chad du 'byung bas mgon po gang gi thugs dgongs yongs su rdzogs pa'i sgrub mchod dam par gyur te/ bdag sogs 'di nas byang chub bar thugasarje'i ra gur las mi 'dor bar tshe rabs kun tu zhabs rdul spyi bor bsten pa'i skal bzang rgyun ldan las thugs yid gcig 'dres kyis dpal ldan bla ma'i go 'phang dam pa thob pa'i smon 'dun rtse gcig bcas deb phreng 'grems smrel gyi ngo sprod du/ 'jam mgon bla brang gi phyag mdzod bstan 'dzin rdo rjes spyi lo 2008zla 1 tshes 7 nyin/

dpe skrun gsal bshad/༄༅/ /spyir rnam thar zhes pa ni dam pa'i skyes bu gang gis lam nyams su blangs te rgyu las nyon gyi 'ching ba rnam par bcad pas 'bras bu sdug bsngal las thar pa'i go 'phang mngon du byed pa'i tshul lugs la brjod pa yin la/ de yang dbang po'i rim pas dbye na rab lhag bsam chen pos srid zhi'i mtha' la mi gnas pa'i myang 'das dang / 'bring nges 'byung chen pos 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho las brgal ba dang / tha ma dad pas ngan song las grol ba'i go 'phang thob pa bcas gsum yod/gang nyid go 'phang de dag tu ji ltar gshegs pa'i shul de rjes 'jug bu slob yongs kyi dmigs rkyen dam par gyur pas de dag kyang sdug bsngal rgyu 'bras las rnam par thar pa'i go skabs phye ba ste/ de nyid mthong thos kyi yul du byas so cog gi rgyud la mi phyed pa'i dad pa rnam gsum legs par bskrun pas rigs kyi nus pa sad cing thar pa'i sa bon 'jog par byed de/ mdo las/ dad pa ni chos mtha' dag snang ba'i sgor 'gyur bar gsungs pa'i phyir/ des na dam pa rnams kyi rnam thar phyogs re tsam zhig rang gi yid la byas shing / gzhan la yang brda 'phrod par bshad pa'i skabs der dad pa yud tsam re skyes kyang 'phral yun gyi phan bde 'grub pa'i don chen por 'gyur ba yin pas thar pa don gnyer can la shin tu mkho gal che la/ lhag par rang re bka' brgyud pa mos gus kyi bka' babs yin zhing / de yang mos gus gang la bya ba'i yul rtsa rgyud bla ma rnams kyi rnam thar mthong thos yid ches kyis rnyed pa las thabs gzhan med/ des na ris med bstan pa'i

12 dpe skrun gsal bshad/bdag po rnam snang mi'i rnam par rol pa/ bka' gter mdo sngags kyi bstan pa rgya mtsho lta bu'i sgog tu gyur cing mdzod chen rnam lnga'i bka' srol legs par 'byed pa'i shing rta chen po/ mkhas grub lo paṇa gyi skyes chen du ma'i skyes rabs phreng bas mdzes pa'i rje 'jam mgon blo gros mtha' yas gang gi sku'i phreng ba gnyis pa sgrub brgyud bstan pa'i spyi dpal dam par byon pa/ 7rje 'jam mgon kong sprul dpal ldan mkhyen brtse 'od zer mchog ni sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan srid rtser g.yo ba'irnam thar gyis mdzes shingabaka' brgyud gser ri'i phreng bar bzhugs te sgrub brgyud pa kun gyi moba'igus kyi yul dam par gyur pas/ mgon po gang gi gsang gsum gyi rnam par thar pa la skom pa chu 'dod ltar don gnyer chen po zhu mkhan mang dag cig yod pa shes rtogs byung / rje 'di nyid kyi rnam thar kun khyab snyan pa'i ba dan zhes pa 'di ni gang gi rgyun bcar nye gnas slob ma'i thu bo kame blo gros 'od zer gyis rje nyid kyi zhal gsung rtsa tho dang / der ma tshud pa khong gi phyag li (nyin re'i chos 'brel mdzad phrin gal che'i rigs bkod pa'i tshig thodasogs gzhir bzhag mgon po gang nyid zhi dbyings su gshegs pa'i bar gyi gsang gsum gyi mdzad pa thun mong gdul bya'i snang ngo ltar snon 'phri sgro skur bral bar rab byung bcu drug pa'i chu lug spyi lo 1943 lo nas 'bri 'go brtsamasate/ chu 'brug spyi lo 1952 lor rdzogs par byas pa nyid nye gnas phyag mdzod yon tan phun tshogs kyis shing dpar tu skrun zin kyang / yul dus 'gyur ba'i dbang gis lkog tu lus pa las nye char gus cag la ma dpe zhig lag son byung ba 'di nyid don che la rnyed dka' ba yid bzhin nor bu'i rjesasu 'gro ba yin pa'i tshul la bsam gzhigs skabasadad gus kyi spro ba rab tu brtas/

dpe sgrun gsal bshad/ 13da res 7skyabs rje 'jam mgon kong sprul sku phreng gnyis pa dpal ldan mkhyen brtse 'od zer gyi rnam thar kun khyab snyan pa'i ba dan zhes pa 'di dpe rgyun dkon rigs su brtsis te blo gros mtha' yas pa'i mdzod deb phreng bzhi pa'i khongs su yongs khyab par 'grems byed skabs deng dus kyi 'gro lugs ltar dpe deb kyi dkar chag bsgrigs shing mngon gsal dod pa'i yig nor ram yig 'bru mi gsal ba khag dag bcos byas khul dang / de min brjod tshig snga phyi mtshams sbyor mi bde ba'am bskyar zlos mang ba'i tha snyad rigs brda sprod spyi 'gros ltar brjod don la mi gnod pa gtso 'don gyis bzo bcos phran bu byas yod kyang / bdag cag rnams la rtsom sgrig zhu dag gang ci'i shes myong zhan pas gnong ba ci mchis rgya che'i klog pa po rnams kyis spyan sngar mthol bshags dang chabs cig dge 'don skyon sel gyi dgongasa'achar lam ston lhug stsol yong ba'i re skul zhu/ rig pa'i rdo rje gtsug lag slob gnyer khang yig gsog dang rtsom sgrig sde tshan nas 2008 zla 5tshes 24 nyin/

tweske r+sā3 ci be rtse ci lha d+ku ske sa ce3 ji/ sgo ri cho ri sdo sgo ci stong ’ hūṃtrīs 1 nge /ji ༷ —dune+eskeshu4 byung ri ma /༷ tsho rī—ru sa 6ri ji 6'jam mgon kong sprul dpal ldan mkhyen brtse 'od zer gyi sku par mthong grol rin po che/khyed ni mdo brgyud bstan pa'i srog 'dzin te/ /bka' brgyud gdams zab smin grol mdzod khang nas/ /snyan brgyud yid bzhin nor bu'i gter longs la/ /sgrub brgyud rgyal bstan tshugs shig grub pa'i dbang / /rgyal dbang mkha' khyab rdo rje'i gsung /

༄༅/ /dpal ldan bla ma dam pa dang lhag pa'i lha mchog dbyer med pa'i zhabs la gus pa chen pos phyag 'tshal lo/ /mtshungs med bstan pa'i bdag po thub pa'i dbang / /skal bzang 'gro ba'i sgron me bzhi pa mchog /'jig rten gsum gyi rnam 'dren shākya'i tog /mi phyed spyi bo'i gtsug gi rgyan du mchod/ /ka dag spros pa kun bral chos sku'i dbyings/ /lhun grub longs sku'i bkod pa 'byams su klas/ /'gag med thugs rje'i rnam rol mtha' yas pas/ /gdul dka' 'dul mdzad pad+ma saṃ bha rgyal/ /las smon dus su smin pa'i dge ba'i bshes/ /yongs rdzogs bstan pa'i shing rta thams cad mkhyen/ /rgyal ba'i lung bstan blo gros mtha' yas zhabs/ /rtse gcig gus pa drag pos spyi bor mchod/ /gang thugs spros pa'i sprin tshogs nyer zhi zhing / /g.yo med rdo rje bde ba r+sā po'i ngang / /zab gsal ro mnyam kun khyab kun gyi gshis/ /mkha' khyab mkha' yi rdo rje can la 'dud/ /

16 'ardzam mgon kong sprul sku phreng gnyisapa'i rnam thar/dpal ldan sku ni gzugs kyi mtshan rtog dri ma med kyang mtshan dpe'i gzi byin 'bar bas mdzes/ /tshangs pa'i gsung snyan sgra tshig brjod pa'i yul las 'das kyang ji snyed chos phung 'jo ba'i dbyangs/ /zag med thugs mchog spros mtshan zhi yang zab gsal mkhyen gnyis rab bkra'i klong / /dmigs med thugs brtse'i 'od zer kun khyab 'jam mgon bla ma de la 'dud/ /'gro kun sgrol ba'i thugs bskyed dpag bsam dbang / /bral smin yon tan 'bras bu'i khur gyis lci/ /skye dgu yongs kyi bsam kun rdzogs byed pa'i/ /phan bde 'dod dgur sbyin pa'i dpung gnyen gyur/ /'bad dang rtsol ba'i skyon gyis ma bslad par/ /lhun grub 'gro ba 'dul ba'i phrin lase ni/ /'khor ba srid du rgyun chad med 'jug pa/ /'brel tshad don ldan skyes bu khyod gcig pu/ /rnam snang be+e ro tsa na'i rnam 'phrul du/ /kun mkhyen pad+mā ka ra'i rdo rje'i lung / /lan gcig ma yin kun tu bsngags des na/ /rnam 'dren chen po mos pa nyid du grub/ /de phyir 'phags chen rnam thar nam mkha'i mtha'/ /so skye byis blos brgal bar nus min kyang / /

kun khyab snyan pa'i ba dan/ 17snang tshul thun mong tsam 'das thun min yang / /blo ldan rnams kyis rjes su dpag par nus/ /des na gang gi mdzad pa ragasarim tsam/ /sgro skur bral bar rang bzhin brjod pa'i ngag /go bde'i tshig gisayi ge'i phreng ba mā /spel 'dir rtsa gsum rgya mtshos byin gyis rlobs/ /gang las sprul pa'i gzhi lung gis bsngags tshul/ de la dpal ldan bla ma dam pa 'di nyid ni/ spyir lo chen be+e ro tsa na'i rnam 'phrul/7rgyal ba'i sras po kame ngag dbang yon tan rgya mtsho blo gros mtha' yas pa'i sde'i yang srid mchog gi sprul pa'i skur yongs su grags pa ste/ de'ang dus gsum gyi shes bya'i chos ma lus pa skyu ru ra lag mthil na bzhag pa ltar mngon sum du gzigs pa7rgyal dbang rkarma pa mkha' khyab rdo rje dang / phyag na pad+mo7gong sa lha mi'i rnam 'dren chen po rgyal ba thub bstan rgya mtsho sogs bod khams skyes chen yongs kyis mgrin gcig gis mnga' gsol ba dang / rje rang nyid kyis dngos su zhal gyis mi bzhes kyang mdzad pa phyag rjes gang gi ngos nas kyang rnam thar dang phrin las 'dzin nus pa gang gi phyir mngon sum dang rjes dpag gi rigs pas grub pa yin no/ /de'ang 'di ltar rjes su thos te/ lo chen be+e ro tsa na ni/ sku tshe de nyid la 'ja' lus rdo rje'i sku brnyesanas gzhen nu bum pa'i skur byang chub ste khyab

18 'jam mgon kong sprul sku phreng gnyisapa'i rnam thar/bdag rnam par snang mdzad dang dgongs pa ro gcig tu 'khyil kyang sems can gyi khams la zad pa mi mnga' bas gang 'dul gyi rnam 'phrul rgyun chad mi mnga' ste/rgyan las/rgyal sras brtson 'grus mchog la brten pa de/ /sems can tshogs rab smin par byed pa na/ /pha rol sems dge gcig gi phyir yang ni/ /bskal pa bye ba stong du'ang skyo mi 'gyur/ /zhes dang /de ni mchog tshogs nang du ting nge 'dzin/ /dpag med rnam par rol ba kun ston cing / /bzo dang skye ba mchog gi sprul pa yis/ /sems can rnams kyi don du dus kun gnas/ /zhesapa ltar/ nga ro skye mchog gi sprul sku sprul pa yang sprul nying sprul dpag tu med pa cig car du ston pa ni sangasargyas rnams kyi chos nyid du nges pa ste/ji ltar nyi ma 'bad med phyogs phyogs kun tu 'od zer dag /rab 'byams gsal ba mang pos lo tog rnam smin byed pa ltar/ /de bzhin chos ldan nyi ma'ang rab zhir byed pa chos kyi 'od/ /rab 'byams dag gi phyogs phyogs kun tu sems can rnam smin mdzad/ /

kun khyab snyan pa'i ba dan/ 19ces gsungs pa ltar gdul bya 'dul ba'i rnam 'phrul gcig las du ma sprul pa dang du ma gcig tu sdud pa sogasaso skye'i blos tshad bzung mi nus la/ tshur mthong blos dpyad par dka' yang sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi rnam thar bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i tshul rtogs pa rnams ni ngo mtshar bskyed par 'gyur ro zhes gsungasaso/ /de'ang cung zad rgyas par bshad na/ chos thams cad kyi dbyings su mngon par rdzogasapar sangs rgyasate spros pa thams cad dang bral ba ni chos sku/ de las ma —g.yos bzhin du mtha' dang mu med pa'i sems can 'khrul ba'i gzhan dbang du gyur pa rnams kyi khams la mngon par gzigs te dmigasapa med pa'i snyegs rje chen po'i rang zhal/ 'og min stug po bkod par nges pa lnga ldan gyi longs sku rnam snang ye shes gangs chen mtsho'i zhing dang sku'i bkod pa dpag tu med par snang ba'i nang tshan/ mi mjed 'jig rten 'di'i stong gsum gyi gzugs khams kyi 'og min du bzhugs pa'i rnam snang ni longs sku ste skabs 'di'i sprul gzhi/ phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams rab 'byams rnams su cig car du'ang mdzad pa bcu gnyisakyi tshul ston pa ni mchog gi sprul pa'i sku dang / ji skad du/chos sku'i ngang las longs skur lhun grub ste/ /thugs gsung sku yi sems dpa' gsum sprul nas/ /'gro drug gnas su sems can don mdzad cing / /dus ring thog mtha' med par bzhugs pa las/ /zhes gsungs pa'i nang nas thugs kyi sems dpa' phyag na rdo rje'am gsang ba

20 'jamomagon kongartsalasku phreng gnyispopa'irnam thar/'dus pa las rdo rje chos zhes gsungs pa ni sprul pa'i sku ste skabs 'di'i sprul pa'i mtshan gzhi/ gzhan yang byang semasanyan rang / pardzita/ grub pa rig 'dzin/dge spyong / 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal po rgyal phran/ blon po/ bram ze/ khyim bdag bya dang ri dwags la sogasapa'i sprul pa'i sku ste/ skabs 'dir ragasapa tsam smos na/ 'phags pa kun dga' bo/ rgyal po dzaḥ ā r+ya deb/ in+d+ra bho dhi/nag po spyod pa/ slob dpon shārnyi gar+bha/ dpal ldan zla ba grags pa/ chos rgyal zla ba bzang po/ thu mi sasto ṭa/ lo chen be+e ro/ klu mes tshul khrims shes rab/ lo chen rin chen bzang po/ rngog lo blo ldan shes rab/ bya 'dul ba 'dzin pa/ mkhas grub khyung po rnal 'byor/ tsā mi lo tsā ba sangasargyas grags/ sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta/ zhang brtson 'grus grags/ dpal chen chos ye/ rog dol po ba shes rab rgya mtsho/g.yag sde pan chen/ pan chen 'bum phrag gsum pa/ zur chen shākya 'byung / grwa pa mngon shes/ rong zom chosakyi bzang po/ klong chen rab 'byams/ bo dong phyogasalas rnam rgyal rnams dang mnyam med dwags po3dngos slob 'ba' rom dar ma dbang phyug 7kame pak+ṣi dang rje rang byung rdo rje mkhas grub o rgyan pa gsum ga'i zhal slob snye mdo thamasacad mkhyen pa kun dga' don grub/ 'bri gung skyob pa'i slob ma gnyos rgyal ba lha nang pa/ rtse le o rgyan bstan 'dzin gyi zhal slob mtshungs med bstan 'dzin rdo rje zhes rtse le'i gdan sa thog mar 'debs pa po de dang / kun mkhyen rang byung pa'i yongs 'dzin gnyan ras dge 'dun 'bum/ rje drug pa mthong ba don ldan gyi yongs 'dzin bka' bzhi ba rasne bha dra/ rje dbang phyug rdo rje'i slob ma rje btsun tā ra nā tha sogs dang / 7rje bla ma tsong kha pa'i slob chen 'bras spungs kyi chos sde thog mar 'debs pa po 'jam dbyangs bkra shis

kun khyabasnyan pa'i ba dan/ 21dpal ldan/ gter chen rdo rje gling pa dang 'gyur med rdo rje sogasagater ston mang du byon pa bcasasmosakyisami lang ba 'disamatshon pa tsam mo/ /bzo gnasabaco brgyad sogs kyisaphan pa sgrub pa bzo sprul pa'i sku dang / yid bzhin gyi nor bu/sman dang zasagos/ ri bo dang ljon shing / gru gzings zam pa sogasabem po'i gzugs su sprul nas sems can rnams la phan bde ster bar mdzad pa'ang /dkon mchog sgron me'i mdo las/de dag dgon par ljon shing r+pā por gyur/ /sman dang rin chen mi zad gter rnams dang / /yid bawo nor bu 'dod sbyin sdong po dang / /lam gol dong ba rnams la lam ston 'gyur/ /zhesasogasagasungs pa ltar ro/ / rnam thar 'di gzhi gang la bcol nas bris pa dang 'chad pa'i dgos pa/de ltar rnam par thar pa bsam gyisami khyab pa'i bdag nyid rje btsun bla ma dam pa de dag gi rnam par rol ba du mas 'phags pa'i yul dang gangs can gyi ljongs 'dir sangasargyasapa'i bstan pa spel zhing semasacan gyi don mdzad tshul/ sku che ba'i yon to bcasardo rje'i lung dang / rje gong ma'i rtogasabarjod zhal gsung malasagato tshigasadang 'brel ba'i lo rgyusayid chesango mtshar can zur tsam re byung ba rnamasal gsakhasab ltar lasa'adir smra ba'i blo grosakyi spobs pa ma mchis so/ /

22 'jam mgon kong sprul sku phreng gnyis pa'i rnam thar/skabs su bab pa 'jam mgon bla ma gnyis pa 'di nyid kyi rnam par thar pa bye brag tu 'chad pa la/ thun mong phyi yi rnam thar/ thun min nang gi rnam thar/ shin tu thun mong ma yin pa gsang ba'i rnam thar gsum du nges na'ang / 'dir rje nyid kyisakar rabs lha khang bzheng skabs phyi yi rnam thar gtso bor byas pa'i rtsa tho dkar chag las byung ba gzhi'am rtsa bar bzung / rang gzhan gyi mthong thos rdzun med pa'i yid ches can rnams kyis zur brgyan te sgro skur med par brjod pa la/ spyir rnam thar zhes pa bi mo k+ṣa'i sgra las rnam par thar pa'am rnam par grol ba ste gang zag gi dbang po'i bye brag gis rab lhag bsam rnam par dag pas srid zhi'i mtha' gnyis las grol ba dang / 'bring nges 'byung rnam dag gis 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho las rnam par thar ba/ tha ma dad pa rnam dag gis ngan 'gro'i srid pa las rnam par thar pa ste de lta bu'i lo rgyus bshad pa ste/ mdor na rang nyid sdug bsngal dang de'i rgyu las rnam par thar zhing / gzhan rgyud 'ching ba las grol bar byed pa'i lo rgyus rmad du byung ba zhig la brjod pa yin la/ de ltar brjod pa'i dgos pa'ang rgyu mtshan de mthong ba dang thos pa po'i rgyud la dad pa rnam pa gsum ga'am gang rung skyed par byed cing / de skyes pas rigs kyi nus pa sad cing thar pa'i sa bon 'jog par byed pa yin te/ mdo las/ dad pa ni sangs rgyasakyi chos thams cad snang ba'i sgor gsungasapa dang / kun dga' bo dad pa la sbyor bar gyis shig 'di ni de bzhin gnyegs pas gsol ba 'debs pa'o zhes gsungs pa yin no/ /de'ang sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' nyan thos 'phags pa rnams dang /rgya bod kyi mkhasagrub tshad ldan rnams kyi rnam thar thos na 'phral yun gyi phan bde bla med la spyor phyir/ sngon gyi skyes bu dam pa rnamasakyis khrom chos kyi gtso bor

kun khyab snyan pa'i ba dan/ 23sangasporgyas kyi skyes rabs 'chad pa'i phyag len mdzad/ de'ang dam pa rnams kyi rnam thar phyogasare tsam rang gi yid la bya ba dang / gzhan la go brda 'phrod par bshad na gnas skabs der dad gus lan gcig skyes pa tsam gyis kyang dkar po'i sa bon thebs pas don chen por 'gyur bar gsungs pa'i phyir 'brel tshad don ldan gyi skyesabu 'di lta bu'i rnam thar brjod pa la mchog tu spro zhing / dad pas mtshamasasbyar te rang bzo'i dri mas ma sbagasapar 'bri bar bya ba la/gang du sku 'khrungs pa'i yul dang yab yum rigs rgyud kyi che ba/thog mar gang du sku zhakhrungasapa'i gnasani/ kun mkhyen nyi ma'i gnyen gyi bltan pa rin po che gang du dar ba'i gnasakyi gtso bo 'phags bod gnyisalas/ gangasari'i phreng bas yongs su bskor ba'i bod kyi ldongs 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi gdul zhing / de la'ang stod mnga' risaskor gsum dang / bar dbusagatsang ru bzhi/smad mdo khamasasgang drug tu phye ba las/ dbu ru stod lung dpal gyi mtshur phu/ rgyal ba rkarma pa'i gdan sachen po dang nye ba'i skyed mos tshal du'o/ /bskyed pa'i yab ni/'jig rten dbang phyug 7bco lnga pa mkha' khyab bde ba'i rdo rje dang / yum rigs ldan ṅgā gi bde skyong dbang mo zhes pa gnyis kyi sras su 'brungs pa'i ngo mtshar 'dzin pa ste/ de la rgyal ba'i dbang po'i sku che ba'i yon kha rnam thar sogs logs su gsal ba ltar las smos ma dgos la/ gdung rigs ni/ 'od gsal lha las chad par grags pa'i lha gzigasarlangs kyi gdung ste/ de yi byung khungs lo rgyusani rlangs kyi brtseru smug po sogs lasabyung ba ltar dang / khyad par bod yul

24 'jam mgon kong sprulasku phreng gnyisapa'i rnam thar/du bstan pa snga dar dusarlangs khams pa go cha sogs kyis sher phyin 'bum pa thog mar sgyur ba po dang / slob dpon pad ma 'byung gnas kyi mi zad rgyan 'khor 'jig rten dregs pa'i bka' babs rlangasadapal gyi seng ge sogs 'phags pa'i sa la gnas pa'i mkhas grub du ma dang / tā si byang rgyal sogs stobasakyi 'khor losasgyur ba/ ya rabasadra ma'i mi chos gtsang ma ma nyams shing / 'phen phyug che btsan gyi mi rgyud mkhas grub yon tan can gyi skyesabu mi rabasanyis brgya dang bdun cu'i bar du zam ma chad par byung bar grags pa'i gdung rgyud zhabrul med phyis su 'brug pa'i skad gtong grub chen zhes grags pa ni rje bla ma 'di yi mes po'o/ /skyed pa'i yum gyi gdung rigs ni/ zhang sna nam pa zhes bod kyi rgyal po mes ag tshom can gyi btsun mo lcam dral sogs 'jig rten che dgu'i rabs dang / gu ru rin po che'i dus rje 'bangasanyer lnga'i ya gyal las can dag pa'i 'khor/ bod yul phur thogs yongs kyi rgyal po sngags pa rdo rje bdud 'joms/ mnyam med dwags po'i dpon sgom tshul khrims snying po'i slob ma zhang tshal ba sogs mkhasagrub shin tu mang po byon pa'i rigs las/ deng sang yang bod dbus gtsang na tshesache ba'i chos blon chen po bya rigs tshang zhesagragasapa'i srasamo/ rdo rje gsang ba'i lung gis zhing skyes kyi ḍā gi'i mtshan dang ldan pa'i phyag rgya mar bsngags pa/ 'bri 'don sogs blo gsal zhing dge la mos pa/ khyad par sngags kyi thabs mkhas gsang spyod zab mo'i tshul mtha' dag la mkhas pa zhig go /de la rje 'di nyid lhums su ma zhugasatsam nas yab rje rgyal ba'i dbang po'i zhal nas/ khyod la bu 'jig rten na che rgu ga ge mo'am 'di ge mo lta bu zhig skye na dga' zhesadang / yang na 'jam mgon bla ma rnam gnyis lta bu zhig 'khrung na dga' zhes kure lta bu mdzad

kun khyab snyan pa'i ba dan/ 25gdang / de yang 7skyabasamagon bco lnga pa pha mkha' khyab rdo rjes mkhan chen bkra lhasa'od zer la mdzad phrin gnad chen gang yod phyag bris gnang ba'i nang / thog mar 'jam mgon rdo rje 'chang gu ṇa'i zhabasasku bzhugs te/ rgyal dbang bco lnga pa dpal sbungs nas dbus su phebs skabasazhabasabartan rgyasa'abul dang 'brel da dung zhal mjal ma gyur bar rtag tu bzhugasapa dang cis kyang sku bzhugasamin byur tshe slar yang mchog gi sprul sku'i bkod pa rgyal dbang rang gi rigs srasasu 'khrung thub par gsol ba btab pasade bzhin zhal bzhes byung ba dang / 'jam mgon dgongs pa rdzogs skabs gsol 'debs thugs dam dus kun mdzad pas/ye shes kyi rol pa yab yum gyi lhums su zhugs pa'i mtshan ma yid ches pa snga phyir byung tshul de bzhin gsal 'dug pas/ 'jam mgon mchog sprul 'brul med du nges zhes dpal 'byor sgang gi tshab tsha'i mkhan po zhig gis rgyal dbang mchog gi phyag bris mjal te de ltar gsungs zhes pas rje 'di chu mo yos kyi lor lhums su zhugs pa nas bzung ma yum 'di gzhas bro gar 'cham skabs sngon las lus rtsal bde zhing / skad snyan po rang byung zhes 7yab rje nyid kyi zhal nasagasungs pas mtshon ngo mtshar ba'i rmi ltas sogs dge zhing shisapa'i rtags du ma yod pa gor ma chag go /de la sku 'khrungs pa'i dus ni/ rab byung bco lnga ba'i bye brag stod 'grel las khro bo zhesapa/ rgya rtsis pa'i shing 'brug lo'i khrums zla'i dmar phyogs kyi rgyal ba gsum pa'i res gza' lhag pa'i bla ma dang rgyu skar dbo gnyis 'dzoms pa'i 'phrod spyor dge bar mtshan dpe'i pad mo thog mar bzhad pa dang / dkar phyogs la dga' ba'i lha rnams kyis sku khrus gsol 'dra bar nam mkha'i ngos nasasprin gyi

26 'jam mgon kongasbril sku phreng gnyispopa'irnam thar/phung po dag ni glo bur du 'khrigs/ bdud rtsi'i gzegs ma dag ni dal bus 'thor/ zhabs 'bring rnams ni sri zhur brtson/ phyogs phyogs nas lta ba dag ni ngo mtshar mig gi bdud rtsir byed cing / snyan par smra ba'i mgrin rnga 'brol ba la rber+shags kyi rnam grangs 'byams su klas theg/ /de nas bzung yab yum de gnyis kyis thugs brtse bas sku'i skyed sring pa na ring po ma thogs par 'tshar longs su gyur pa la/ gsung bye ba tsam nasadam pa'i rigs sad pa'i rtags thun mong ma yin pa mnga' ba kun gyis mthong snang du grub pa ste/ mdo sde rgyan las/spyor ba'i sngon du snying rje dang / /mos pa dang ni bzod pa dang / /dge ba yang dag spyod pa ni/ /rigs kyi rtagaba'isu shes par bya/ /zhes pa rnams dang ldan la/ rje gong ma'i zhal chems ltar dpal ldan mtshur phu'i 7rgyal dbang bco lnga pa mkha' khyab rdo rje'i gdung rigs su sku 'khrungs parashes te mchog gi sprul pa'i sku chung ngu nyid la dgos pa'i cha thams cad zhabs drung du 'dren par byed cing / rim gro ba dag kyang rim gyis bcar ba'i grasasu ban chen grwa rgyu mtshan shes pa zhig 'jam mgon mchog sprul rin po che'i zhabs gras su lo gcig tsam mchis pa de'i zin tho zhig las gsal ba ltar na/ rje bco lnga pasanga'i bu 'dir rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma'i 'du shes las nga'i bu'i 'du shes gtan nas med/byis pa'i dus nas spyod pa gang byas dgos pa chen po red yod nges gsungs pa

kun khyab snyan pa'i ba dan/ 27bzhin/ zor rgyag dang sku 'cham la thugs shin tu mnyes pas de'i rigs nam mdzad skabs/ zhwa nag sogs sngags chas/ zor gyis nam mkha' bran rgyu dang gtor bzo/ ser phreng du phyag rnga spos sna sogs rgyas bsdus bka' bzhin 'phral 'phral grwa tshang la rgyal dbang nyid kyis bka' gnang nas mdzad par 'dug zer/sku rtsed skabs sku srasagazhan dag gisargyal dbang rin po che'i bzhugs khri'i steng phebs pa dang / sku chasasogs la 'dzems med zhabs kyis brdzi ba sogs mdzad kyang 'jam mgon rin po ches de 'dra gtan nas mi mdzad/ skyabs mgon mdun phebs skabs kyang sku pang du bzhes tshe nan tan gnang na las mi phebs shing /phebs tshe yang gusa'adud mdzad pa sogs yab srasaganyis kyi mdzad pa ngo mtshar che ba yod zer/ thugs sras gzhan la bu zhes dang 'jam mgon la rin po che gsung zer/ rje nyid kyi zhal nasakyang / bdag byis pa chung ngu dan tsam dus nas chos kyi bag chags skyon med rgyun chagasasuyod cing / lo gsum bzhi nas lusal gzan dang 'bral med byas/ byis spyod phal cher yang sgrub mchod/ dbang bskur/ sbyin sreg gar 'cham sogasakyi lad mosadusa'ada' zhing / de dag la nyer mkho'i yo byad gang la gang 'os skrus nam ldan pa sha stag7yab rje de nyid kyis stsol bar mdzad do zhesagasungs so/ /

28 'jam mgon kongasbril sku phreng gnyisapa'i rnam thar/yab rje rgyal ba'i dbang po'i spyan snga nas dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa dang zhal gdams zab mo mnos tshul/dbyig gnyen zhabasakyis/ tshul gnas thosadang bsam ldan pas/ /sgom pa la ni rab tu spyor/ /zhesagasungs pa'i go rim ltar/ dgung lo lnga drug skabasagaza' skar bzang ba zhig la 7yab rje rgyal ba'i dbang posadabu skra gtsug phud bzhes te/mtshan la kame dpal ldan chos kyi dbang phyug blo grosadri med pad ma'i myu gu mkhyen brtse'i 'od zer rab tu rgyas pa'i sde zhes dang rab byung gi rtags bstsal nas bla mar mnga' gsol zhing shis brjod mdzad/ 'di skabs yongs rdzogasadage bsnyen gyi sdom pa gnang yod 'dra/ dgung grangs bdun pa nas yi ge 'bri klog sbyong bar mdzad/ de nas rgyal ba'i dbang pos rim par bka' chos bstsal ba la/ sems bskyed lugs gnyisabastsal cing mtshan blo gros dri med ces pa gnang / bka' brgyud gser phreng gi bla ma rnams kyi bka' 'bum deng sang rgyun gang bzhugs kyi lung / bka' brgyud sngags mdzod/ shesabya kun khyab/ 'jam mgon gong ma'i bka' 'bum/ rin chen gter mdzod/ nyang dang chos dbang sogasagater chen yongs grags phal cher gyi gter chos rgyun bzhugs phal mo che'i dbang lung /rgyal dbang bco lnga pa nyid kyi bka' 'bum/ khyad par mgon pod bka' rgya ma'i lung khrid/ gzhan yang risamed skyesachen du ma'i bka' 'bum sogasabod yul grub mtha' so so'i lugs kyi bla ma yi dam chos skyong gi sgrub dkyil rnams kyi dbang lung rjes gnang smin khrid shin tu mang po dang / mnyam med dwagasapo bka'

kun khyabasnyanapa'ib dan/ 29brgyud spyi dang / khyad par sgrub brgyud rin po che kame kai tshang gi nag rgyal phag gsum/ chosadrug phyag chen gyisagatsos gser chos yongasardzogasabum pa gang byo'i tshul du rim par bstsal cing / dgung grangs bcu par rje rgyal ba'i dbang po nyid bsnyen mtshamasabazhugs pa dang lhan rgyas pas bsnyen sgrub thams cad kyi thog mar jo lugs sgrol dkar dang gsang thig phur pa bcas zhag bdun rer bsnyen sgrub mdzad/'jam mgon kong sprul sku gong ma'i yang srid du ngos 'dzin mdzad pa/dgung grangasabacu gcig bzhes pa shing stag gnam lo gsar tshes skabs/ zhag nyer gcig bar sgrol dkar bsnyen sgrub mdzad/ 'di lor mdo khams smad nasaskyabs rje byams mgon rin po che tā yi si tu bcu gcig pa pad ma dbang mchog rgyal po phebasapa mtshur gdan nas thog mar mjal 'phrad thog byams mgon rin po che'i mdun nas sangs rgyas gling pa'i bla ma dgongs pa 'dus pa'i gzhung pod pu sti bcu gsum gyi lung rgyal ba'i dbang pos gsan par mdzad pa'ang lhan cig zhu bar mdzad/ 'di skabs las snga tsam zhig tu rje gong ma'i gdan sa dpal sbungs yang khrod kun bde gling gi mdzod pa tshe ring don grub dpon g.yog rnams kyang sprul pa'i sku zhu zhing gdan drang ba'i ched du 'byor yod pa bcas/ dgung lo bcu gnyisabazhes pa shing yosalo'i sa ga zla ba'i tshes 13 nyin/ gdan sa chen po 'og min mtshur phu'i gtsug lag khang chen por 'jam mgon blo gros mtha' yas kyi sprul pa'i skur mnga' gsol ba ste/ khams dbus kyi dad sbyin slob tshogs dang

30 'jam mgon kong sprulasku phreng gnyisapa'irnam thar/bcas pa yongs su bsdus nas/ bkra shis pa'i dar dang rgyal mtshan sogasamang po ni mkha' dbyings su bsgrengs/ mdzes shing brjed chags pa'i ba dan dang / bla bre/ sa yol/ gnam yol/ ka 'phan/ phye phur/ gdugs la sogs pa'i mchod rdzas rnam par bkra ba rnams kyis ni brgyan/ bro gar dang / rol mo'i bye brag dag ni snyan zhing 'jebs/ snam sbyar gyi rgyal mtshan bklubs pa tshar du dngar ba mang pos ni sngon bsus/ legs par bshams pa'i seng ges btegs pa'i khri 'phang mthon por ni bzhugs su gsol te/ 'bul bar byed pa'i dngos po rnams so so'i go rim ltar bsgrigs pa'i thog mar7rgyal ba'i dbang po mchog gis 'di ltar/༄7/ /khams gsum mtha' dag gi gtsug gi nor bu dran mchog 'khor lo'i mgon po'i sgyu 'phrul gzhen nu rnam par rol pa'i zhabs kyi chu skyesanye bar bstan pa'i chos kyi khri 'phang mngon par mtho ba'i nye drung du/gus pa chen pos btud de legs skyes kyi mchod sprin bstar ba'i tho chung du 'bul/gang zhig bden pa'i sprin las byin rlabs nor bu'i gru char 'bebs/ /srid dang zhi ba gnyis ka mtshan tsam nyid kyi dad pas srung / /'dod pa'i dngos kun 'jo bas skye rgu 'tsho mdzad dpag bsam shing / /rin chen rnam gsum dge legs grib bsil g.yo ba med gyur cig /cesamachod par brjod cing / don gyi rnam thar gyi cha shas phra mor bstod bsngags kyi me tog 'thor bas mdun bdar nas/ gang gi tshe mi mchog semaspodapa' chen

kun khyab snyan pa'ib dan/ 31po rnams gang la 'jug pa'i gzhi lhag pa'i bsam pa dang lam byang chub kyi chos/sadang / pha rol tu phyin pa dang / gzungs dang / spobs pa dang / ting nge 'dzin dang / ye shes la sogs pa rnams la bskal pa rgya mtsho'i pha rol gyi yang ches grangasamed pa rgya mtsho'i snga rol nasabazhugs shing / de dag gi rjesasu 'thob par bya ba'i 'bras bu yang phyogs bcur bzhugs la/ dus gsum bzhugs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa ma lus pa dang mnyam pa nyid du stobs bcu/ mi 'jigs pa bzhi/ ma 'dres bco brgyad la sogs pa'i 'bras chos kyi yon tan rgya mtsho la dbang 'byor ba'i bdag nyid/ zhi ba bla na med pa'i go 'phang chen po mngon par 'du mdzad zin na'ang / zhes pa la sogs pa'i tshigs su bcad pa dang / tshig lhug spel ma dag gi maṇ+ḍal gyi bshad pa/ phun sum tshogs pa lnga'i sgo nas rgyas par so so'i go rim bzhin bla brang khag dang / dad sbyin khag bcas kyisa'abul lam zhus pa lags na/ brtse ba'i 'dzum bag gi dkyus ring g.yo ba'i spyan ras kyi 'bab stegasasu btsa' zhing / me tog mchod rdzasakyi tshul du dgyesabazhes grub pa mkhyen mkhyen/zhesasgrog spyong mdzad/ slar yang lhag bsam rab tu dkar zhing / dam tshig rnam par dag pa'i rten 'byung dang / khyad par phyogs bcu'i rtsa gsum rgya mtsho'i thugasarje'i skul ba sngon du 'gro ba'i brtan bzhugs gsol smon/ shisabarjod su sti/ kā ma la'i phreng ba bcas kyi mjug bsdu grub par mdzad pa dang / che 'don khrir bton pa bcas kar brgyud yab sras che khag gi go sa'i bsko 'ja' dang 'brel/ 7rgyal ba 'jig rten dbang phyug gi sras po de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsang ba 'dzin pa rdo rje chos su bsngags pa'i bka' rtags kyi the ka zhes

32 'jam mgon kong sprul sku phrengaganyispopa'i rnam thar/pa'i las tham bstsal mur/ sangs rgyasakame pa'i rgyal tshab kyi thu bor dbang bskur ba yin no zhes rjes su gnang zhing / de mtshungs byams mgon si tu rin po che/mchod gong rgyal tshab rin po che sogs yab sras skyes chen che rgu yongs kyis gzengs bstod dang dga' ston gyi mchod sprin rab 'byams spros pas mtshon 'jig rten lha dang bcas pa'i mchod sdong gcig pur gyur to/ /rgyal dbang thub bstan rgya mtshos dbu skra gtsug phud bzhes shing rgyal ba'i dbang pos khams phyogs su phebs rdzong gnang ba/tshes 20 nas bka' brgyad bder 'dus kyi tshom bu tshogs sgrub chen mo sman sgrub dang sbrel mar mdzad pa'i 'tshogs phebs dang / mtshur phu'i 'dus sde tshang mar tshe dbang gnang / de nas 'jam mgon khams su phebs skabasabyams mgon rin po che sku 'khor lhan rgyas la bka' las/ nga yi bu 'di pha ma mkhas nasabu sprul sku bzos pa min/ 'jam mgon rin po che'i mchog sprul zhabrul med yin pasanges shes gting nas rnyed rgyu yod pa zhig yin pas 'bral bar mi phod pa'i mig las gces pa zhig yin yang / rje gong ma'i gdan sar ma phebs thabs med lags pasadapal spungs ston 'khor rnams kyis dam tshig 'gal med kyis zhabs tog dgos pa'i bka' slob zhib rgyas su bstsal/ 'og min mtshur phur rje rang gi bzhugs khri'i steng du 'jam mgon mchog sprul rin po cher khri ston gnang skabs 7rje dus mkhyen gyi dbu zhwa dang sku chas gsol/ yum sras mtshur phu'i grwa tshang thams cad/ 'di nga'i bu zhig yin pa'i 'du shes gtan nas ma byed/ 'jam

kun khyab snyan pa'i ba dan/ 33mgon rdo rje 'chang dngos yin snyam pa'i dad mos kyis gsol gdab smon lam gal che zhes gsungs te/ thog mar rje bco lnga pa nyid kyis/ sku yi skye ba thams cad du bud med kyi grogs kyis sems rgyud dkrugs pas bstan pa la me 'byin pa'i lus su mi 'gyur ba sogasakyi smon lam zhib rgyas bstsal ba las dad ldan kun gyi mig nasamachi ma thon pa byung zhes thos/ 'jam mgon mchog sprul rin po che nyid kyi bka' las khong khams su phebasakhar rje bco lnga pas/ pha rgan nga bzang ngan gang ltar mthong yang gu ru rin po che'i sprul ba zhig ni yin/ bu khyod kyisapha nga ma brjed dang ngas bu mi brjed/ tshe 'dir dngos su ma 'phrad kyang phyi mar zangs mdog dpal rir pha bu lhan cig 'tshog par the tshom mi dgos gsungs te/ 'jam mgon zab gter lam zab le'u bdun 'jam mgon dngos las ljags lung gsan pa yin pas 'dis gsol ba thob gsungs/ ljags lung bstsal ba'i nyin nas bzung nyin re bzhin ma chag par 'don gyin yod pas thugs kyi gtad so de yin zhesathos/ bka' slob la/ sku tshe spel bar sgrol dkar/ bar chad sel bar phur pa sogs bka' brgyud gong ma'i thugasadam rnams dus dang rgyun par nyams bzhes mdzod dang / rtsa ba'i thugasadam 'di dgos snyam pa'i yid ches rnyed pa zhig phyis 'byung bas de la gtso bor gsungs pa/ phyis gsar rnying bsnyen pa mang du bskyal kyang bka' brgyud gong ma'i thugs dam rtsa ba rgyal rgyam yin pas/ khyad par7rgyal dbang sku phreng thams cad kyi thugs dam sprul gzhi 'jam mgon rdo rje 'chang yin pa dang / rje bco lnga pas kyang 'di kho na bsngags pasargyal rgyam 'di yi dam byed bsam nges shes 'drongs pa byung bas de'i bzlas pa dung phyur ye 'grub bsam pa yod gsungs/ de rjes lha ldan du phebs nasajo shāka sogs rten mjal

34 'jam mgon kongasbril sku phreng gnyisapa'i rnam thar/mchod 'bul dang / gangs ljongasabastan pa'i mnga' bdag7rgyal ba rin po che sku phreng bcu gsum pa thub bstan rgya mtsho'i sku mdun mjal bcar dang gtsug phud 'bul bzhes zhus/ mtshan thub bstan chos sku bde chen dbang phyug ces pa bstsal/tham ka gru bzhi dang zlum po she bam bcas kyis gzengs bstod dbugs dbyung bstsal cing / dgyes pa'i gsung mchid/ rdor mdud dang lha dar phyag gis gnang /gsol ja dkar spro bcas dang gzhung sa'i sku drag kha shas la tshe dbang sogs mdzad/ de ga'i bzhed don legs par grub nas yar phebs/ mtshur phu nas yab rje rgyal ba'i dbang pos thugs gzigs chen pos rol bsu gnang / yab rje'i zhal mjal byin rlabasazhu bar mdzad/ de nas mi ring bar mdo khams su phebs dgos skor skyabs rje byams mgon rin po che dang mdzod tshe ring don grub lhan rgyas kyis zhus pa ltar7rgyal ba'i dbang pos kyang gnang ba bstsal nas de ga'i grabasayul thogs med du bsgrigs pa dang bstun/ rgyal ba'i dab nga po'i mdun nas rje nyid kyi tshab yin zhes rgyal dbang nyid kyis tsā ri mtsho dkar nas zab gter du bzhes pa'i o rgyan ma hā gu ru'i sku tshab bzo spyong 'jig rten dbang phyug7dpal kame pa bcu pa'i phyag bskrun thub pa'i dbang po'i snang brnyan nor bu chu shel las grub pa srid na 'gran bral/ 7rje bcu bzhi pa'i pur ras la kar rabs rnams kyi shangasakhrag gis rje rgyal ba'i dbang po nyid kyi phyag bris ma mgon dam tshig bris sku gtsosasku gsung thugab(rten khyad 'phagab(du mas sna drangs/ dam rdzas ril nag rin po che/ sgar chen rten 'dus/ gong ma yab sras sogasaris med skyes chen du ma'i dbu lo na bza' sogs rten dam shin tu mang po/ mchod cha/zhwa gos/ gdan chas/ gur sgar gyi yo byad/ gser dngul/ dar gos/ sman

kun khyab snyan pa'i ba dan/ 35rigs/ phrug ther/ rta drel sogasarkang 'gro mang po bcasadangos po'i gnang sbyin tshad lasa'adas pa/ khyad par zhi rgyas dbang drag gi phrin las lhun gyis grub pa'i rten 'brel yin gsungs de dag gi rdzas sne re re bcas gnang nas/ lo de'i zla 1tshes21 snga dror bka' chos thob pa kun gyi mtha' mar zur gter nam mkha'i rdo rje'i tshe sgrub 'chi med srog tig gi dbang bskur brgya dang brgyad bstsal te rgyal ba'i dbang po nyid kyang tshugs sgar gcig gi bar chibs skyel la phebs/ dbu zhwa zhwa nag rgyun bzhes/ bsnyen phreng / gsol zhal/ na bza' bub bcas gnang nas/khyed 'jig rten gyi dbang du byas na sha khrag gi dwangs ma las skyes pa'i bu dang /chos kyi dbang du byas na rdo rje'i slob ma dam tshig dang ldan pa yin pas/ rnam pa kun tu kho bo ma brjed par gyis/ lo gsum nas ngos 'phrad ched ci nas kyang yar bsleb par gyis shig sogs bka' slob zhib rgyas gnang / tshes 27 nyin yab srasazhal gyes pa'i mtha' ma la/ rgyal ba'i dbang pos phyag gis bka' bsgo dang dbu thod gnang zhing rje 'di'i phyag nas bzung ste/ tshe 'dir yang da dung pha bu lan gcig 'phrad pa'i smon lam bya yi khyed nas kyang de ltar mdzod/ lar sngon du kha ta thams cad byas zin kyang / yang bskyar nan zhu rgyur gtso cher 'jam mgon gong ma'i rnam thar ltos/ rang re sgrub brgyud pa 'di yi bstan srog sgrub pa nyams len gyis 'dzin dgos pas mi tshe sgrub pa la 'bungs/ phu dam de mang po'i khar ma nyan/'ur sgrog skad grags can gyi rjes su ma 'brangs/ rang tshugs thub par gyis/ dpe cha 'bri klog la brtson pa dang / sdom gsum/ nang brtag rgyud gsum zhan byung rig gnasadang gzhung phran bu la ltos/ gzhan stong dbu ma chen po'i lta ba la gdeng chos/ tha snyad go ba skam po'i rjes su ma shor bar snying po'i bstan pa la phan

36 'jam mgon kongam+bilasna phrengaganyisapa'irnam thar/thogs par gyis shig gsungs te lha rdzas dri bral dang phrug gi gos gcig gnang nas shin tu thugs 'khreng ba'i nyams dang bcas/ rje nyid nas kyang tshe rabs kun tu thugasarjes 'dzin pa'i smon lam 'debs bzhin so sor gyes/ slar yang rgyal ba'i dbang po ston 'khor gyis dar gyi g.yab mo sogs kyis gdan sar chibs zhal bsgyur ba'i rten 'brel bcas grub nas/ ma yum bde ldan dpon g.yogayang khrod phyag mdzod dpon g.yog rje rang nyid ston 'khor bcas khams phyogasasu chibs bsgyur gnang /gser khrir mnga' gsol zhus te dmangs sems bde la bkod pa/skyabs mgon si tu rin po che de'i gong nas sngon du byon zin pa gsang gzhung du mjal/ lhan rgyas byang lam brgyud de phebs/ lam bar sku zhabs gnyisakar bka' dgon rnams kyis gdan zhu dang / dad sbyin khag gisa'abul bsnyen 'dod skong bcas phrin las rim rgyas kyis byon/ rje rang nyid kyi zhal nas/ 'di skabasarang la dad 'bul re ltos can mang du byung bar dbang rjes gnang / byang sreg sogasarang gis gang shes phran bus 'dod skong byas nas dngos 'bul tshang ma dang du mi blangs ka med byung zhesagasungs/ zur mang rnam rtser gter chen nam mkha'i rdo rje'i tshe sgrub 'chi med srog thig gi sgrub mchod gsar 'dzugs la ma byon thabs med kyi gdan zhu dang 'brel/ rje rang nyid dpon slob ma yum bcas phebasanasadagon par rab gnas/ 'dus sder tshe dbang bcas gnang / tshogs gar chen mo'ang mjal/ gar bstan rol rdor sogasabla sprul che khag rnams dang / khyad par

kun khyab snyan pa'ithodan/ 37rje rang nyid kyi mkhan chen rdo rje la'i drung rin po che thog mar mjal zur mang phyogasa'adir thog ma'i rten 'brel legs pa lta bus phyis mya ngan 'da' kha'i bar lan mang du phebs/ mchod yon bla slob thun mong min pa'i dam tshig sel med byung / mchog gling gter sprul gyis dad gus chen pos rtsi rker gdan drangasabyung ba sogs la/ gang 'tshams kyi phrin las skyong bzhin dpal sbungs dang sa spyod sde dge'i bsu ma ring thung rnams rim gyisa'abyor/ lam 'khod sde dgon rnams la mjal kha sogs gang la gang 'tshams kyis/ zla 11 pa'i tshesamagor rta thabs rol bsu bcasagadan sa chen por phyag phebs/ dpal spungs kyi gtsug lag khang gi khri dmar du byams mgon rin po che dang lhan bzhugs mdzad/ grwa tshang gis maṇ+ḍal dar btang ston mo bcas nyin shas mtshams yang khrod kun bde gling gong ma'i gdan sar rol bsu rgyas pa'i ngang byams mgon rin po che dang lhan rgyas phebs/ rje nyid kyi zhal nas/ de skabs snang ba la dga' skyo zung du 'brel ba zhig byung gsungs/ dpal chen po'i lha khang zhes dus babs sa gnad kyi me btsa' rdo rje'i lung bzhin bsgrubs pa'i gtsug lag khang du 'jam mgon gong ma'i bzhugs khrir zhabs pad 'khod/ sgrub sde'i 'dus pa rnams kyis maṇ+ḍal dar btang bcas grub nas byams mgon rin po che dgon du phyir phebs/ rje rang nyid ma yum lhan gzims chung gsar pa zhes pa phyis mdzod pas gsar brgyab de nang bzhugasanas phyag dpe 'bri 'don sogs sku yon la brtson par mdzad/ de skabs phyag bris sogs ma yum rang nas bslab ston phul/ lo mjug der phur bsnyen dang gsar rnying srung ma'i bskang gso bcas gnang / lar rje 'dis sku chung ngu'i dus nas yar mar tshes bcu sogs dus mchod dang / nyin re bzhin sgrol dkar/ 'ardzam dbyangs

38 'jam mgon kong sprul sku phreng gnyis pa'i rnam thar/dkar po/ gro lod/ phur pa sogs kyi bsgom bzlas/ tho rangs ldang ba'i rnal 'byor nas dgong mo nyal ba'i rnal 'byor bar thun mtshams chos spyod las byung ba ltar rnams dang / rang lugs chos srung gi gtor bsngo rgyas pa bcas rob tsam min pa'i gsal dag go chod nges rnga rol dung gling gi spros pa sbrags chag 'phri gtan nas med par sku ma gshegs bar mdzad pa las phyis nas zhal 'don thugs dam chag med rigs je mang du song ba 'og nas 'chad par 'gyur ro/ /yang khrod 'dir yang rje 'jam mgon gong ma'i dus nas yar mar tshes bcu sogs dus mchod rigs shul bzhugs nye gnas rnams kyis nyams med gtong sgol ltar/ rje 'di nyid phebs nas slar spros pa gang rgyas kyis chad med mdzad la/skabs su mgon po'i skong mdos sogs shin tu spros pa rgya che ba'i sgrub mchod kyang mang du gnang ngo / me 'brug gnam lo gsar tshesaskabs sgrol dkar dang 'jam dbyangs dkar po'i ljags bsnyen mdzad/ zlalte pa'i nang dgon du tshe gar 'cham spros pa gang rgyas dang / phun sum tshogs pa lnga ldan gyi skabasasu mdo khams kar brgyud kyi gdan sa chen po dpal spungs gtsug lag khang du khri ston mnga' gsol skabs/ mtshur sgar gzhung / dpal spungs bla brang / yang khrod bla brang / sa skyong sde dge sde dge'i dbu bla khag bzhi'i bla brang / dpon khag so so'i dngos 'bul rgya che ba dang / khyad par du byamasamagon rin po che/ rdzogasachen lnga pa/ kaḥthog si tu paṇ+ḍi ta/ zhe chen dang dpal yul ba rnams sku dngosasu phebs/gzhan yang rje gong ma'i zhal slob mkhas pa'i dbang po bkra shis chos 'phel dang mkhan chen tshe dbang dpal 'byor/ phyis 'dir mkhas pa chen po rgyal khang gzhan dga' rin po che slob tshogs dang bcas pas gdan sa 'dir 'chad nyan mdzad

kun khyabasnyan pa'ib dan/ 39skabs khel bas/ de'i slob tshogs lasagangs dkar sprul pa'i sku/ zur mang mkhan pad+ma rnam rgyal/ mkhan rin po che stobs bcu rab rgyasasogs mkhas btsun bzang la mang ba rnams kyis maṇ+ḍal rgyas bshad/ mdo sngags gzhung lugs mang po'i bshad pa/ chos kyi 'bel gtam sogasagang rgyas dang / de skabs rgya dpon e bhan gro'o ta zhun zer ba nas bzung yul ldongs 'dir rgya mis dbang bsgyur skabs yin pasade ga'i sa sgo sku tshab sogs rgya bod mi sna mang po/ bdag po sde dge a jo rdo rje seng ge btsun blon 'khor bcas/ rgya/ bod/ 'jang / rgyal rong sogs kyi skad rigs mi gcig pa'i mi sna du ma/ mdo khams stod smad kyi rgyal blon sku drag sku tshab sogs mang po/ yul 'di'i ser skya mchog dman shin tu mang po 'dus pasaso sos khri 'bul bsnyen bkur bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhus shing /de skabs mthong thos 'brel tshad don ldan gyi 'gro don rlabs po che byung yod pa gdon mi za'o/ /'di yi sngon nas lo grangs mang por yul khams rnams la rgya mis dbang bzung / dpon rigs rnams kyis lha sde mi sde kun la khral 'u lag rkang 'gro lag 'don rigasa'aded bskul btsan gnon tshod med dang / lo nyes bstud mar byung ba'i dbang gis tshang ma nyam thag gyur pa'i skabasayin pas/ rgan rgon rigs phal mo ches/ 'jam mgon kong sprul rin po che gdan sa'i khrir 'bod thub pa byung na snyigs dus ngan pa'i sdug bsngal 'di las grol nges pa yin zer ba ltar de lo nas bzung lo legs pa dang / mi ring bar rgya mi phyir log dgosaskor gzhung sachen po'i phrin lasakyisakhyab nas lo grangs mang po'i bar bstan 'gro spyir snyigs dusal dpag pa'i bde skyid ldan zhing sosadal bar byung la/ khyad par risasu ma

40 'ardzam mgon kong sprul sku phreng gnyis pa'i rnam thar/chad pa'i dge 'dun gyi sde rnams ni gzhung sa chen po bka' drin che nges kyis bshad sgrub las gsum shin tu dar rgyas byung ngo / /thos bsam slob gnyer dang 'gro don mdzad tshul/lo mjug der gsang thig phur pa bdun gsum du bsnyen bzlas mdzad/ me sprul gsar tshes kyi dga' ston la rol/ 'di skabs hor ba bla ma sangasakho zhes pa sdom pa gtsang zhing bsnyen sgrub la brtson pa/ sku tshugs shin tu legs pa de yongs 'dzin du bkas gnang ba 'byor/ phyag dpe 'bri klog sogs kyi do dam ma rtsa mdzad/ 'di skabs shig tu ma yum dbus su yar bteg mo rang gisathugs 'breng chen po mdzad 'dug kyang rang nasa'adusabyas kyi mtshan nyid la 'di las ma 'das snyam pa byung zhes rje rang nyid kyis gsungs/ phyag brisasogs sbyong rtsol dang bar mtshams rnams su bsnyen sgrub sgrub mchod kyang mang du gnang / skabs shig dbyar sos shig la skyo sangs su phebs te dpal spungs mthong sa'i nyi mkhar dur khrod der ja bag mang ba dang rtsam pa sgro gang / shing tog sna tshogs/ bu ram dkar dmar sogs shin tu mang po me la bsregs nas bsur mchod gsung bzhed la/phyag dpe med stabs nyi mkhar mtshamasakhang du mkhan chen tshe dbang dpal 'byor mdun dpe cha g.yar du btang / khong la dpe mi bzhugs gsungasate thugasathog der 'phral du phyag bris mdzad nas bsur mchod 'dod yon sprin phung phul byung bsadapon slob kun gyis tshar grangasagasungs/ de nub mun rub skabasaganyan sa gcod pa yin gsungs nas dpon slob so sor rgyang ring tsam bzhugs nas lus

kun khyab snyan pa'i bdan/ 41sbyin gnang / bum sgrub phur sgrub sogs dgon du 'tshogasapa'i rdor slob la'ang phebs/ dge rgan snga ma mtshams sgrub kho nar re ba che stabs dgongasapa 'brol/sde dge'i mdun bskor sa ngan gnas gzhi bla ma sngar dpal spungs sgrub khang 'og ma'i sgrub bla lugs gnyis kyi mkhyen rgya yon tan che stabs dge rgan du 'byor/ si tu rin po che'i drung yig gnasalnga rig pa 'jam dbyangs chos kyi rgyal mtshan nam grong nyin tshe dbang las bod kyi brda sprod sum rtags gzhung mkhas dbang lhag bsam gyi 'grel pa ltar zhib khrid blo 'dzin/ chos 'byung bka' 'bum nang bzhugs pa'i samatha'i rnam dbye shes rab 'od zer gyis mdzad pa de dang / dpang khang lo tsā'i dag yig ngag sgron zhib khrid/ rje 'jam mgon gong ma'i dngos slob mkhasadabang bla ma bkra 'phel las snyan dngags me long ma/ sde dge mchod yon gyi bla sman ske srib bla ma a tshang lasartsa mdo chu mdo zhib khrid/ sngo sman lag sdum sprad pa/ rgyud bzhi sogs sman skor mang po'i bshad lung / mkhas dbang bla ma gser kha chosagrags mdun nasasor mdo/ spyod 'jug dbu ma 'jug pa/ ka ri ka lnga bcu pa bcas mchan 'grel steng nas gsan/ rje nyid kyi zhal nas 'di skabs mos pa dang brtson 'grus zhan pas go chod pa zhig ma byung gsungs kyang /phyis 'dir gsung rab spyi yi go don la tshe gcig thos bsam byed khul rnams kyis kyang rje 'di la nam yang 'gran mi nus par 'dug pas skye bas thob pa'i shes rab sad rkyen spyor byung 'di dag cis kyang yin par mngon la/ bskyed rdzogs zab mo'i don la ni nges par mkhas pa chen po dag gis kyang gting dpog par dka' ba'i mkhyen rab 'di ni sgom byung gi shes rab kyang yin par gdon mi za'o/ /'di skabs shig tu ma yum bde ldan lags kyang dbus nas phyir phebs/ yum

42 'jam mgon kong sprul sku phreng gnyis pa'i rnam thar/sras rgyun ring tsam lhan rgyas par bzhugs/ sa rta lor sde pa gzhung gis sde dge yan chod du dbang bsgyur zin nas/ mdo smad zhib dpyod chen mo dpal spungs dgon du mdzad/ de skabs bod pa'i sku drag sogs 'grul gtug mang ba la mjal kha ngo len dang / rje nyid kyi sku zhang bya rigs mda' dpon kyang byon byung bar zhal rgyas mdzad nas phebs song / mi ring bar sku zhang 'dasasong ba'i gtam ngan 'byor skabs ma yum gyis thugs khral chen po mdzad kyang / rje 'dis yar mar bsngo zhu dge rtsa bkram pa las nyams snang mi 'dug 'di skabasabyamasamagon rin po ches kar dgon phal cher dang dpal spungs grwa tshang la ser zhib chen mo mdzad/ gzhung sa chen mos zhib dpyod skabs/ bla dpon mang pos bar skabs rang 'dod kyisablangs pa'i sa khangazhing samang po phyir bzhes kyang yang khrod bla brang 'dir sor 'jog kho na byung song / skyabs mgon si tu rin po che sngon chab mdor bka' blon bla ma sar sde dge gzhung gi jus 'don la 'byon dgos byung ba dang /rjes su dgon chen du rgyun ring bzhugs dgos song ba bcas bsnyun gzhi babs lcib zhig gis 'dilkor sgrub khang chen mor sku mtshams bcad rgyar bzhugs skabs yin pas/ slar bsnyun tshabs che nasathams cad bag skrag che skabs/ rje 'dis zhabs brtan ched dmigasakyis sgroladakar sku mtshams yun ring bzhugs/ dge rgan gyis sprul sku'i gsung la brtags na skyabs mgon rin po che da res mi skyon pa 'dra zer/ ci gsungs yod ma nges/ salug lo'i tsā 'dra'i gnas 'dusaskabs byams mgon rin po che dang rje 'di lhan rgyasapasadage bskul gyi sgo byang dang skor lam gtod pas mtshon de skor mdzad sgo rigasabaskyangasabastun/ de lo gnasaskor ba mchog dman skya ser shin tu mang po 'dus kyang 'thab rtsod g.yang sar lhung ba

kun khyab snyan pa'i ba dan/ 43sogs med pa byung / rje 'dir zhal mjal mang bar chos 'brel bka' bsgo sogasa'adod skong mdzad/de tsam ma gtogs lo snga rjes 'di dag la sku yon slob sbyong kho nar brtson/7rje mar pa dang mi la'i rnam mgur nyin kha shas gsungs/ de tshe phal cher mos gus kyis spyan chab btang nasagasung 'gag pa mang du yod 'dug pas dge rgan bla ma dga' tshor gyisagazhan la bshad 'dug 'di skabs shig grwa 'khor zhig la thugasakhro tshul gyis gsol dkar bcud ldan nan gyis yang yang brdegs kyang /dkar yol gas chag phra mo'ang med khar gsol ja'ang phran bu las pho mi 'dug zer/ rje nyid kyi zhal nas/ mtshur phu nas rgyal ba'i dbang posadagongs 'dus sgrub dbang gi skabs shig nged la thugasagatad mdzad yod 'dug pas rmi lam du rgyal dbang rin po che bzhugs khrir bzhugs nas dbang bskur zhig gnang ste/gsang mtshan pad+ma gar dbang theg mchog rtsal yin gsungs pa dang / bdud btsan klu gsum yin rgyu'i 'jigs su rung ba 'gas rang sngags phul ba bcas rmi lam gsal po byung bas/ phyis rgyal dbang rdo rje 'chang gis bka' glegs phebs par dgongs 'dus dbang chen gyi dbang rdzas rnams dang gsang mtshan gnang nas khyed la dbang bskur ba'i 'dun pa byas yod gsungasapa'i dbang gnang ba'i lo zla tshes khongs dang rmi lam rmisadus 'grigs 'dug pa sogs nyams mtshar rmi ltas 'ga' re 'ong ba yod kyang / phyis 'dir dam sel dang dkor nag gis bsgribs pas ci yang mi 'dug ces gsungs/ byams mgon rin po ches bka' brgyud sngags mdzod mnyan pa sprul pa'i sku sogs la dbang lung gnang ba'ang gsan/'di skabs rje rang gi zhal nas rgyal ba'i dbang pos lo gsum mtshams nas yar

44 'jam mgon kong sprul sku phreng gnyisapa'i rnam thar/shog gsungs pa snying la bcangs kyang / rang nyid na tshod phra ba dang / 'di skor sus kyang bka' ris su bor bas de don ma byung zhing / skyabs rje byams mgon rin po ches rnam pa kun tu thugs la btags par yod kyang / yul dus rten 'byung gis thugs 'gal dgongs phyogs rim byung thog nged rang lo na ma lon pa dang rna ba srab pas yid chad du gyuranasablasgrob bar dam sel phran tshegs byung shor zhing /phyis su byams mgon mchog nas kyang de don skor bden pa mtha' gsal lta bu'i thugs dgongs rim dwangs thog rang nas kyang byang dag gi thabasal ngo dga' phye gtor tsam min par snying nas 'bad khul dang dbugs dbyung yang thob cing rje pad+ma nyin byed dbang po'i bka' 'bum gyi bklags lung yang mnos so zhes gsungs/ de lta bu ni snyigs dus kyi bla slob gzhan 'gre med pa dam pa'i rang gshis rjen pa dang / rang gzhan rnamasal dam tshig 'da' dka' ba shin tu zhib mor bsrung dgos pa'i brda tshig go /kar rabs lha khang rten brten pa bzhengs pa'i tshul/lcags sprel lor gnas gzhi dge rgan 'das song bas phyag mdzod sogs kyis dge rtsa skyon med byas song / 'di yi snga gong tsam du ma yum dbus su yar thegazla 5 ba'i nang sde dge'i lcang ra bum sgrub gyi dbur gdan drangs pa ltar phebs nas de ga'i bzhed skong rigs grub nas slar phebs/ rgyal dbang rin po che'i phyag bris ched phebasanang bod du yar 'byon 'ong dgosatshul 'byor ba ltar ring min sku bcar zhu rgyu'i thugs 'dun dang zhabs brtan rgya cher bsgrubs/ rje gong ma'i

4—cig rngo ci lko dzi 4༈7 rgyu4tre rjo rdosduchoskecisnye4dhed+ku dzesgyutsho ci tshudz+wa ṅku — tsā tsho phyi lo 1950 nas 60 nang dus 'gyur dbang gis nyams chag shor ba'i dpal spungs yang khrod sgrub khang tsā 'dra rin chen brag slar yang nyams gso 'go tshugs pa'i rnam pa can gyi 'dra par 1995 lor bsgron pa/

kun khyab snyan pa'i ba dan/ 45gzim spyil du phyag chen sngon 'gro 'bum bzhi/ thugs sgrub bar chad kun sel bsnyen sgrub/ pak+shi bla sgrub/ ber can bsnyen sgrub las sbyor bcas grub par mdzad/sgrub sde rnams la pak+shi bla sgrub dbang sogs dbang lung ci rigs mdzad/ lo snga rjes 'di rnams su dbang lung tshur gsan rigs rje nyid kyi phyag tho las/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse dbang po'i sgyu 'phrul karma gzhan phan rdo rje blo gros mi zad byams pa'i go cha'i mdun nas snga rjes jo nang rin 'byung sogs dbang bka' ci rigs zhus shing / khyad par nā ro chos drug yab rje bka' drin can gyi gsung rgyun slar yang zhib khrid zhus te gtum mo sogs la 'brel 'jog byas/ zur mang drung sprul bcu pa karma chos kyi nyin byed mdun nas gdams ngag rin po che'i dbang lung khrid bcas/ skyabs gcig bka' drin mtshungs med ze chen rgyal tshab rin po che'i mdun nas rje gong ma'i zab gter rtsa gsum dgongs 'dus kyis thog drangs/dbang lung rgyud kyi bshad pa bcas shin tu zab rgyas dang / lhag par rdzogs chen bla ma yang tig gi dbang bzhi khrid/ lce btsun snying thig gi dbang khrid bcas zhib rgyas dang / sems don gyi ngo sprod nan chags su zhus pa bka' drin thob cing dgyes bzhin rjes su bzung / ze chen gong sprul rin po che mkhas btsun bzang po'i dpal gyis brgyan par bzhugs pa las smin gling 'chi med yang snying chos 'brel du zhus zhes gsungs pa ltar la zhib par gsan yig ltar ro/ /chu phag zlakhe tshes rkol mtshur phu nas yab rje rgyal ba'i dbang po dgongs pa zhi dbyings su gzhol ba'i gtam ngan 'byor bas/ rje nyi da kyi phyag khar gang bzhugs kyi sku chas na bza'i rigs spang dag dang po mdzad nas bod khams ris med dgon sde kun la mchod 'bul rten dang / 'di ga'i yas phyin dgongs rdzogs shin

46 'jam mgon kong sprul sku phreng gnyis pa'i rnam thar/tu rgya che dpangs mtho dang / rje nyid kyis kyang dpon slob mang tsam gyis rgyud sde rnams kyi dkyil 'khor dang 'brel ba'i bla ma mchod pa rgyun ring mdzad/ rje rang gi gsung las/ bka' drin sum ldan yab rje rdo rje 'chang de nyid kyi dgongs pa rdzogs thabs su rang 'khos gang yod kyis dngos po gtong sgo rigs ser sna dang rlom sems kyi dri mas ma gos par byas yod ces gsungs/ dpal spungs mkhyen sprul rin po ches bka' brgyad sman sgrub btsugs pa'i rdor slob mdzad/ nang dbang khrom dbang bcas grub nas/ dbon stod a bran tshang bu 'chi ba'i gdan 'dren nan zhus kyis phebs/ tshur byon 'phral rdzong dgon sprul sku rin po che'i ma yum 'das par phebs bskul zhus pa ltar gsung chog dang / bla ma nor lha'i g.yang sgrub rten gsar 'dzugs bcas mdzad nas yang khrod du 'byor 'phral sku mtshams bcad rgya dam por bzhugs/ 'di skabs bla ma ral pa can zhig gis rje gong ma'i zhal slob yin zer do gal u tshugs kyis zhal mjal zhus song bas gzim chung rab gsal nas chos 'brel zhig gnang song / 'dan bre mkho'i ma rgan 'chi sar gdan 'dren mi 'dresan ka med kyis zhu nan che stabs phebs dgos byung song ba de ga'i dge sgrub cho ga grub nas/ dran thang dang tshe zle dgon du phebs/'bru bla ma 'jam dbyangs grags pa zhes rje 'jam mgon rnam༄ gnyis kyi thugs sras mkhas grub gnyis ldan de nyid kyi mdun du ched phebs mdzad/ bla ma nyid dgyes tshor chen pos tshe dbang zhig gsan bzhed phul/ tshur la chos 'brel du 'brug pa'i phyag chen dang / lam rim ye shes snying po zhu bar mdzad/ slar phebs lam rnam rgyal gling rab bkram du bla ma dam pa dam chos 'od zer mdun ched du byon nas/ phyag chen/ chos drug mgon po'i rdzogs rim zhib khrid bcas dang / jo

kun khyab snyan pa'i ba dan/ 47nang gsar 'gyur sgrol ma rnal 'byor ma'i dbang / rigs gtad rjes gnang sogs tshang bar gsan/ slar dpal spungs su phebs/ shing glang sa ga zla ba'i nang bum sgrub rdor slob mdzad/ dbang sogs mtha' rgyas legs par grub/ sde dge'i sa spyod mdun nas lcang ra bum sgrub dbur bzhugs gdan 'dren slebs pas der byon/ rgyal blon mi dmangs bcas pa'i bzhed skong mdzad/ slar phebs grub 'phral lha thog chos rgyal gyis gdan 'dren slebs/ 'di sngon nas yab rje rgyal ba'i dbang po'i dgongs rdzogs su kar rabs lha khang bzheng bzhed la/ de skabs zhor stabs mthun rkyen ched phyi 'brog khul du phebs/lam 'bod dgon sde rnams las 'bul bsnyen rgya cher 'byor bzhin so so'i re skong zhib par gnang mur lha thog dkar legs su rta thabs rol bsu bcas phebs/ de ga'i thugs bzhed kyi dbang lung zhabs rim legs par grub nas/zur mang bdud rtsi dil du rta thabs rol bsu bcas phebs/ dgon par rab gnas dang 'dus sder dbang sogs mdzad/ bla ma drung rin po che'i mdun nas sngar rgyal ba'i dbang po'i mdun nas ma thob pa'i rje 'jam mgon gong ma'i zab gter yang dag gi dbang lung khrid bcas gsan/ lam 'khod dgon sde tshang mas 'bul bsnyen 'dod skong rim sel gyis/ zur mang rnam rgyal rtser rta thabs rol bsu bcas phebs/ bla sprul grwa tshang rnams kyi bzhed skong dang / gar dbang sprul pa'i skus7rgyal dbang bco lnga pa'i bka' 'bum pusti bcu skor spar du bzheng bzhin par zhal 'debs su smar zong rgya rdil bcu non nges 'bul bar mdzad/ de nas rim par gdan sa chen po karma dgon du rta thabs rol bsu bcas phebs/kar bstan spyi rim du ring tsam sku mtshams bcad rgya dang / mgon bsnyen las

48 'jam mgon kong sprul sku phreng gnyis pa'i rnam thar/sbyor/ mtha' sdud drag bsreg rgyas pa dang mgon nag dmar/ sbyan gzigs dkor cha/ dgon pa'i nyams gso'i thebs dngos po rkang 'gro sogs brgya skor gnang nas bteg lam 'khod rnams la phrin las gang 'os skyong bzhin karma lha steng du phebs/ sgrub khang gsar 'dzugs gegs chag che bar mgon po'i drag sreg sogs sna sel rim gro dang / sgrub pa po rnams la shangs lugs sogs nyer mkho'i dbang lung rigs mdzad/ de phyin sgrub khang de da lta'i bar rkyen chag med pa'i gang legs byung snang / de nas rim par nang chen ja dgon du phebs/ byon lam rlung lhags che bas sku ngal che tsam gyis dgon du 'byor/ der so so'i 'dod skong rigs dang / sde dgon spyi nas mchog gling yang gsang thugs kyi phur gcig gi sgrub chen 'dzugs dgos zhus pa ltar/ rtsa 'cham bcas spros pa gang rgyas/ zur gter bde chen zil gnon nam mkha'i rdo rje'i gter byon phur pa yang bcud 'dril gyi las byang yang lhan cig btang / sgrub pa gegs med du grub/ 'di skabs dkyil 'khor gyi shar nub lho gsum gyi rgya mchod yan gtor ma thams cad las bdud rtsi ro mngar zhing kha dog ser smug 'dzad med du babs/ kha ba me tog dang rigs lnga'i phyag mtshan gyi dbyibs can babs pas tshang ma ya mtshan dga' spro'i gnas su gyur/ de nas nang chen chab shod nang skor so sor 'dod skong gnang mur nang chen chos rgyal chen po'i gdan zhu 'byor/ dgun du gyur pa dang / thugs brel gyis mi phebs rgyu cha 'jog mdzad nas dgongs 'khrol zhu zhes phab song yang / yang bskyar nan tan chen pos ma phebs ka med kyis rta thabs rol bsu bcas nang chen rgyal khab tu phebs/ bzhed skong rigs grub nas zla chu brgal/ nye bar chags med mchog sprul yab tshang du bzhugs pa'i gdan 'dren 'byor/ der phebs nas mchog sprul la

kun khyab snyan pa'i ba dan/ 49dbang bka' sogs bzhed skong mdzad/ zur mang rnam rgyal rtser slar 'bor nas gter chen zil gnon nam mkha'i rdo rje'i chos skor sngar yab rje'i mdun nas ma thob pa'i rigs gter sras 'od gsal rdo rje las gsan/ rim par sga stod ban chen dang / khra 'gu dgon bcas su phebs/ dbang chos sogs bzhed skong dang /rgyal zla'i mgon po'i dus mchod 'tshogs la'ang phebs/ gar 'cham bcas grub/me stag gnam lo gsar tshes dga' ston dang / 'bum 'gyur nang rgya nag ma ṇi rgya mkhar la zhabs bskor mdzad/ 'dam dkar dgon du bla grwa'i bzhed skong grub/slar khra ban brgyud khra bo la brgal nas zhang 'gu dgon du dbang lung ci rigs mdzad/ dran thang dgon du phebs skabs bre mkho'i bsu ma 'byor/ der byon nas g.yang skyabs sogs rim gro 'dod skong mdzad/ a thub yab gzhis su 7rgyal dbang bcu drug pa dgung lo gsum bzhes pa bzhugs par mjal re che yang de skabs mjal ma thub gsungs/ zhabs brtan rigs grub nas rnam rgyal gling bla ma dam chos mdun phebs/ dgyes bzhin dbang chos gsan res mdzad/ de ltar lho khul nas 'di bar gyi bla sprul dgon sde tshang mar dbang lung khrid gsum/ gson gshin cho ga so so'i ngor bsang gsur/ gsol 'debs/ smon lam sogs gsung rtsom mang du gnang nas gdan sa dpal sbungs yang khrod du phebs/ sga stod nas dngul yod rigs kyis gser dang zangs bsgrubs zin pas kar rabs lha khang rten brten par bcas pa bzheng rgyu'i grabs yul mdzad/me stag zla 2 pa'i mjug lha mgar mi gsum 'byor/ sna sel rim gro rigs rje rang nyid dang gter sras 'od gsal rdo rje gnyis kyis tshad ldan grub/ rje nyid kyi zhal nas yang khrod nye skor gyi bkag shing 'di rnams rje 'jam mgon bla mas

50 'jam mgon kong sprul sku phreng gnyis pa'i rnam thar/dbus skyes chen tshang mas chos srung la gnyer gtad gnang ba yin nges kyang gtsug lag khang gi ched du chos srung yul gzhis gnas kyi bdag por gnang ba zhus pa'i cho ga sogs sngon nas zin pas sgrub gnas yin rgyu'i spros pa ma byas so zhes gsungs/ zla 3 tshes 25 gza' skar 'phrod sbyor dge zhing shis pa'i nyin rmang btings/ tshes 28 nas gyang gtong ba'i ar po gsar bskrun bgyid skabs shing mkhan nyi shu/ mi dmangs brgya phrag yar brgal la yang khrod 'di ga'i 'bor dud kha shas yod pa'i nang nas dud chen rnams zla ba re/ chung rnams zhag bco lnga rer ar po rgyag pa las gzhan tshang ma gla chas yi rangs nges gnang ba las khral ded med par mdzad/ lha sku'i rgyu dang bzo bo byin rlabs rnams gzhung bzhin tshad ldan mdzad nas zla 6 pa'i tshes 6 la dbu btsugs/ gtso bo 7rgyal dbang bco lnga pa chen po'i sku thog tshad gser zangs khri rgyan rgyab yol rgyan drug bcas dang gser dngul spel ma'i 'khor kar rabs bcu bzhi sku tshad mtho brgyad re bcas tshang ma zangs dang gser shas mthug cing gser mdangs legs pa bcas/ lha mgar dbu gu ru dbang rgyal sogs bdun brgyad tsam gyis zla ba kha shas ring brdungs/dgun du song stabs lha mgar rigs la gla ston gyis tshim par mdzad nas rang gnas su slog shing bzo mu mthud bgyid/ ma yum yang bod nas 'di gar 'byor/ rje rang gi zhal nas/ spyir ma thams cad drin che ba gzhir bzhag chung nas gzhan las brtse ba dang / dngos po'i rgyu nor phongs med du byin pa dang / chos dang mthun pa'i lam la dkri zhing / tha na yig bris kyi gzugs dang dag cha tshun bslabs pa sogs drin shin tu che ba lags zhes gsungs/me yos gnam lo gsar ches dga' ston la rol ba dang / sngon gyi shing las

kun khyab snyan pa'i ba dan/ 51sogs mu mthud bgyid cing zla 5 pa'i tshes skor nas slar yang phyi 'brog khul sogs su phebs/ ma yum lags kyang dbus bskyod dang 'grogs nas lhan cig pad+ma skya ka sum mdo bar phebs/ ma yum dpon g.yog dbus lam du zhugs/ so sor khams bde zhu bzhin rje 'di ston 'khor zur mang brgyud lam 'khod tshang mar 'dod skong rim sel gyis snyis sna bar dang / de nas lci stod dgon khag ri ba khagatshang sar gnam dgon dang / mgon po dgon/ byang rta rna/ khyung po gru ya bar dang /ge lcags dgon du phebs/ bla ma bsam gtan rgya mtsho byon pa dang mjal 'phrad kyis chos 'brel gsan/ de dag rnams su rang rang gi 'khos bstun rta thabs rol bsu/ bla sde mi dpon khag so sor dbang bka' sogs bzhed skong bcas dngos 'bul rgya cher byung / ri bo cher rta thabs rol bsu shangs len dpe bral mdzad/yang dgon bla brang du bzhugs/ 'phags mchog sprul pa'i skur tshe dbang sogs bzhed skong dang nang rten mjal kha zhu bar mdzad/ grwa tshang khag tshang ma'i thugs bzhed bskangs/ de nas rim par tsha ba sgang du phebs/ sgrol ma ri yi dgon pa sogs dgon khag yod rigs kyi 'dod skong dang / mi sde dpon khag so sor phrin las kyis khyab par mdzad/ la gong rnga mda' brgyud dom dpal ri rtse'i dgon gnas su rol bsu sogs dang bcas phebs/ dgon pa'i bzhed skong grub nas dpal ri rtse dngos la phebs/ tshogs brgya smon lam mdzad/ chags med rin po che'i sku rab rib tsam mjal ba rmis gsungs/ de nas thang kar gzhung nas brgyud rang gnas su shar skyod mdzad rtsis la/ kar shod phyogs yon bdag cig gi bu shi bas gdan 'dren nan zhus ched phebs/ cho ga sogs re ba bskangs/ zur mang rnam rtser gar dbang brgyad pa sprul pa'i sku rin po che dang rta thabs rol bsus

52 'jam mgon kong sprul sku phreng gnyis pa'i rnam thar/phebs te dpar khang gsar bzhengs kyi gzim spyil du bzhugs/ thugs bzhed rigs grub nas ri khrod gsar 'debs su phebs/ zhag shas dal bzhugs zhor dbang chos sogs mdzad nas slar dgon du phebs/ de skabs zur gter rin po che nam mkha'i rdo rje'i gter byon rdo rje gzhon nu'i sku brnyan rin po che bdud dpung zil gnon dkar chag zur gsal can gter sras 'od gsal rdo rje nas phul zhing / legs so'i gnang sbyin rgya rdil dang rje rang gi na bza' spus ldan bcas gnang / bdud rtsi dil du drung rin po che'i zhal mjal ched phebs mdzad nas shar bskyod kyis gdan sa yang khrod du phebs/sa 'brug gnam lo gsar tshes dga' ston dang dgung lo nyer lnga'i keg sel du jo lugs sgrol dkar bye ba gnyis/ zur gter tshe sgrub 'chi med srog tig gi bsnyen sgrub zla ba phyed gnyis bar mdzad pas gzhung mthun gyi rmi ltas phal cher byung gsungs/ sngon 'phro khang pa phyi khog grub nas nang gi tshon rtsi sogs sgrub/ lha mgar mang 'dus kyis sku phal cher grub/ zur mang bdud rtsi dil nas rin po ches rata gling thugs gsang gi sgrub chen gsar 'dzugs kyi rdor slob ched gdan 'dren 'byor/ thugs spro ba dang bcas bla grwa dpon slob nyung 'dus phebs nas dge tshul slong gi sdom pa chabs cig gsan bzhed ltar/ gdan sa chen po bdud rtsi dil rnam rgyal rab brtan gling gi bkra shis pa'i gtsug lag khang dmar 'ja' ma zhes par brtan mkhas yon tan kun rdzogs mkhas chen drung rin po che sku phreng bcu pa karma chos kyi nyin byed dpal bzang po mkhan por bzhugs pa'i phun sum tshogs pa'i lnga tshogs las/ tshig gsum rim nod kyis bstan rtsa dam chos so sor thar pa'i sdom rgyun dri ma med pa kha che'i paṇa chen gyi brgyud pa ltar bzhes te/

kun khyab snyan pa'i ba dan/ 53mtshan la karma ngag dbang chos kyi nyi ma phrin las kun khyab dpal bzang po zhes gsol/ lar rje 'di sku chung dus nas rang bzhin gyis spyod lam gtsang zhing rnam par dag pa kho nar bzhugs shing / de phyin chad nas zhi bar gshegs kyi bar/phyi ru nyan thos spyod pa bskyangs/ /nang du 'dus pa'i don la dga'/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar rtags dang cha lugs tshun chad dge slong gi dngos po las nam yang mi 'da' ba'i kun spyod gtsang zhing tshangs spyod bslab pa dri ma med pas brgyan bzhin bzhugs nas/phyis 'dir phyogs tha dad kyi kar dgon rnams gtsos ris med kyi dge 'dun shin tu mang po'i mkhan por gyur to/ /mdo las/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la rab tu byung ba'i bsod nams ni bsam gyis mi khyab ste/ mya ngan las 'das pa'i bar du zad mi shes so/ /bdud kyi 'khor med par byed cing /sangs rgyas kyi gdung 'tshob par byed do/ /dge ba'i phyogs skyed par byed do/ /kha na ma tho ba'i dri ma med par byed cing / bla na med pa'i bsod nams kyi las skyed par byed do/ /zhes sogs dang / 'jug pa las/so so skye bo rnams dang gsung skyes dang / /rang byang chub la bdag nyid nges rnams dang / /rgyal sras rnams kyi nges par legs pa dang / /mngon mtho'i rgyu ni tshul khrims las gzhan med/ /ces sogs bka' dang bstan bcos las rgya cher byung ba'i don thugs la bzhag

54 'jam mgon kong sprul sku phreng gnyis pa'i rnam thar/nas/ dang po ma thob pa thob par mdzad pa dang / thob pa mi nyams par srung bar mdzad pa dang / de lta bu'i bka' drin thob pa'i yul mkhan slob 'khor dang bcas pa la dngos po'i yon 'bul rgya cher spro bar mdzad do/ /nyes mang 'dzin 'khris gang ba'i 'khor mtsho las /brgal 'dod rnams kyi dang po'i 'jug ngogs mchog /so sor thar pa'i khrims kyis sdom mdzad gang / /bsil ldan stodangs kyi u pā li gcig pu/ /bgrang yas dus nas thugs brtse'i zhags pa yis /'gro khams ji snyed yongs su bcings zin kyang / /slar yang snying stobs bskyed pa'i brdzu bag gis/ /'dzum rlabs dkar pos srid 'di kun dgar byas/ /rim gnyis goms pa'i rdul mang brtsegs pa las/ /theg mchog sngags kyi mngon rtogs rtse mtho ba/ /ting 'dzin mi g.yo'i lhun po mdzes bzhin du/ /mtshams sprin gsar pa'i bla gos lhag par mdzes /zhes pa ni bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad par bkod pa'o/ /de nas bdud rtsi dil du sgrub chen sta gon nas bzung / dngos gzhi/ dbang bcas shin tu legs lam gong 'phel gyis grub nas shar rgyag tu phebs/ gdan sa yang khrod du 'byor 'phral mgon po'i skong mdos sogs lo bstar sgrub mchod grub/ sa sbrul gnam lo gsar tshes dga' ston dang / gzungs sgrub dang rab

kun khyab snyan pa'i ba dan/ 55gnas ched kai tshang bde mchog lha lnga'i bsnyen pa btang / sgrub mchod mdor bsdus mdzad nas gzungs 'bul sogs tshad ldan yun ring po'i bar phyag bstar gnang /nang bzhugs shin tu rtsa chen po sogs dkar chag zur gsal ltar la rje nyid dbur bzhugs pa'i dpon slob bsnyen song snyishu skor gyis nag pa zla ba'i tshes25nas/ bde mchog lha lnga'i sgo nas 7rje dgu pa'i rab gnas yig cha bkra shis char 'bebs ltar dngos sta nyin gnyis rgyas pa'i sbyin sreg bcas gzhung mthun 7rgyal dbang bco lnga pa dgongs pa zhi dbyings su gzhol ba'i dus chen nyin grub par mdzad/ slar tshes27nyin byams mgon rin po che dpon 'khor bdun phrag gis sgrol dkar gyi bdag bskyed sngon du 'gro bas rab tu gnas pa'i me tog 'thor bar mdzad/ tshes28 nyin dpal sbungs mkhyen sprul rin po ches kai tshang rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dang 'brel ba'i rab tu gnas pa'i cho ga legs par gnang zhing / mar me dang yon chab zhal zas me tog gi phreng ba sogs so sor stong phrag du longs pa bcas gzab spros dang / slar phyis su lcags 'brug lor 7rgyal dbang sku phreng bcu drug pa chen po rang byung khyab bdag rig pa'i rdo rjes lha sku dam tshig sems dpa' ye shes par dngos su bstims shing phyag gis kyang me tog 'thor bar mdzad/ gsang ba gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs pas ye shes kyi sku dang gnyis su med pa'i grol ba bzhi ldan du mdzad par gyur to zhes rje nyid kyis gsungs so/ /dbu zhwa dang khri rgyab yol rnams la mchog gling gter byon mkha' 'gro ye shes mtsho rgyal gyi mgul rgyan gtsos rin thang dang bral ba'i rin po che'i rigs mang po'i phra rgyan gyis mdzes par byas pa deng sang mngon sum mjal du yod pa 'di'o/ /

56 'jam mgon kong sprul sku phreng gnyis pa'i rnam thar/de ltar sku rten yar gyi ngo / /zla ba tshes pa'i grangs ldan ni/ /gser ri sgrig bzhin mdzes gyur pa/ /ngo mtshar mtho ris lhas kyang sgrog /ces pa ni bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /lha ldan phyogs su mchod mjal gnas skor du phebs nas phyir 'khor ba/de nas gong gi 'phro la/ lcags rta gnam lo gsar tshes dga' ston sogs grub rjes zla 4 tshes 24 la dpon slob nyung bsdus kyis lha ldan du phebs rtsis grabs yul rigs grub nas/ dpal spungs mkhyen sprul rin po che dpon 'khor kha shas kyis chibs skyel bcas 'dan brgyud nas phebs/ rgyal ba'i dbang po bcu drug pa'i zhal dkyil hor zla 5 pa'i tshes 10 la mjal/ rten 'byung ched chos rje gling pa'i rtsa gsum dril sgrub kyi tshe dbang phul/ sngon ma chibs pa dge rkyang zer ba zhig yod pa de a thub yab tshang gi 'gram du nyal nas 'gro rogs mi byed 'dug pa rjes su rgyal dbang yid bzhin nor bu der sku 'khrung pa'i rtags mtshan yin pa de skabs zhabs phyi yod pa rnams la phyis su bshad rgyu 'dug rje nyid kyi zhal nas/de skabs dga' ba dang skyo ba'i blo drag po shar bas brjod mi shes pa byung gsungs/rim par zhang 'gur phebs skabs gar dbang sprul pa'i sku dgongs pa gzhan du gzims pa'i zhal chems ltar gdan 'dren 'byor/ khra ban gnyis kyi thugs

kun khyab snyan pa'i ba dan/ 57bzhed bskangs nas sgar gzhis mang ma bzhag dpon slob hrag bsdus kyis zur mang rnam rtser phebs/ mkhan chen drung sprul rin po che mjal/ dgongs rdzogs rigs dang sku gdung zhugs 'bul bcas grub nas yon 'bul rgya cher byung / rtsi khog brgyud phebs/ ge sar 'ben rdil zer bar sgar gzhis kyang 'byor/ dgra jag sogs kyi 'tshe ba med par nag chu kha bar phebs/ nag chu rdzong gzhis su rje nyid kyi sku mched lcang ra sras po bzhugs par zhag shas dal bzhugs mdzad/rim byon gyis mtshur sgar bla brang gi khal bsu 'byor/ seng snar phebs skabs chibs bsu bcas zla 5 tshes gza' skar 'phrod sbyor dge ba'i nyin rta thabs rol bsu sogs kyis mtshur gdan du phebs/ bla grwa tshang mas sku gsung thugs rten dar btang mjal kha zhus/ mi ring bar lha ldan du phebs/ ma yum sku khams dwangs ngos yum sras lhan dgyes tshor chen po mdzad/ jo shāka gtsos pa'i gtsug lag khang rnams kyi rten mjal mchod 'bul mdzad/ 7gong sa lha mi'i rnam 'dren rgyal ba thub bstan rgya mtshor mjal phyag zhus par brtse ba chen pos bka' mchid zhib lhing dang gsol ja bzhes 'bras/ dkar spro bcas lha dar nyin mo bde legs dri ma med pa phyag gis bstsal/ 'di phyi kun tu thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs pa'i zhal bzhes gnang ba bcas thob/ slar mtshur phur phebs/ mgon po'i rnga 'cham chen mo'ang mjal/ mgon khang chen mor mgon gsol nyin kha shas 'tshogs phebs mdzad/ spyan gzigs sna tshogs phul/ lo mjug dgu chen 'tshogs phebs dang / sgar ba/ zur ri/ grwa tshang / 'od ze ra gling bcas 'dus sde yongs rdzogs la mang ja/ ja 'gyed bcas gnang / lcags lug gnam lo gsar tshes kyi dga' ston du phebs/ yab rje bka' drin can gyi bzhugs khrir dar btang gsol 'debs smon

58 'jam mgon kong sprul sku phreng gnyis pa'i rnam thar/lam mdzad/ rgyal tshab pa dang mjal 'phrad bcas grub/ dbu mdzad cig las kar lugs mgon po'i dbyangs gdangs rigs zhib gzigs nges par mdzad/ zla ba 2pa'i nang lha ldan du phebs/ tshogs mchod chen mo mjal/ ra mo che'i jo khang du bskor tshad bzhag chags med mchog sprul shin tu bsnyun tshabs che bar gdan drangs ltar phebs/ sku rim mang du gnang song bas sku khams dwangs/ zla 6 pa'i tshes mgor ma yum lags dngos 'bul dang bcas phebs/ mtshur phur 'byor 'phral yab rje bka' drin can gyi sku gdung rin po che'i mdun mchod 'bul rgya che dang rdo rje phag mo'i sgo nas tshogs 'khor/ lha khang khag la spos mar me snyan shal bcas phul zhing gsol 'debs smon lam rgya cher mdzad/ tshes 15 la mtshur phu nas phebs skyel bcas sgar bteg rim par byon pas thang lha'i nye 'dabs sbas tshang sa tshigs su7rgyal dbang bcu drug pa chen po dang byams mgon bla ma yab sras lhan rgyas pa'i gser zhal mjal/ rim phebs kyis lam 'khod dad sbyin rnams kyi re skong mdzad bzhin ri bo cher 'phags mchog sprul pa'i skus ja 'dren sogs sne len zhabs zhu gang drag mdzad/ karma dgon du phebs/ dgon nag mar bskang gso sogs grub nas lha thog tu phebs/ mkhan drung rin po che dang mjal/ lha thog rgyal po'i zhabs rim gang 'os mdzad nas rim par bteg zla 11 tshes 5 nyin dpal spungs su mkhyen sprul bzhugs pa'i mdun nas rta thabs rol bsu bcas gdan sa yang khrod du phebs/ dgon du 'khyug tsam byon/ zla 1 2 pa'i tshes 7 phyi ma'i nyin mtshams tho bzhag nas kai tshang phag mo lha lnga'i bsnyen pa dbu tshugs/ chu sprel gnam lo gsar du tshes/ phyi nang gsang sgrub sgrub mchod legs par grub nas zla 7 tshes 10 nyin sbyin sreg tshogs 'khor bcas mtha' rgyas
