kun khyab snyan pa'i ba dan/ 59mdzad/ 'di skabs shig sngar ja pa dgon zhabs gter gsar phur pa'i sgrub chen skabs grwa karma tshul khrims zer ba lo chung mthong snang sna tshogs yod pa mtshams sgrub 'dod pa che ba lo chung zhig 'dug pa dgon pa'i bla chos la 'tshogs sgrig dgongs zhus thog mtshams sgrub la zhugs nas dka' spyad drag pos lo 12 tsam mtshams sgrub mdzad nas 'dir byon/ thugs bzhed dbang lung mang du mdzad/yar byon 'phral mtshams sngar ltar bzhugs dgos gsungs nas bstan 'gro la phan nges 'ongs re mdzad kyang sku tshes ma thub 'dug tshes 15 nas rgyal rgyam lha dgu'i phyi sgrub dbu tshugs/ 'di lo zla 10 nang byams mgon rin po che lha ldan nas phyir byon/ ri khrod du ched phebs mdzad nas sku skyes dang dbu thon legs 'bul bcas grub/ rim par nang sgrub/ gsang sgrub/ dril sgrub/ yang gsang sgrub pa bcas grub par mdzad/ chu bya zla 2 tshes 14 gza' skar dge ba'i nyin mtshams tho bsdus nas bcad rgya grol/ zla 3 pa'i nang klu dil steng mkhyen sprul rin po cher gter gsar sme brtsegs kyi dbang dang khyung po'i grwa ba sogs la lam zab le'u bdun ma'i lung gnang / lhan rgyas pas mgon gsol rgyas pa mi nub bstan rgyal nyin gsum btang / skyabs mgon si tu'i mdun sku bcar zhus/ bla rgan rnam rol la 'od dpag dbang gnang nas yang khrod du phebs/ tshes 21 la dpal sbungs dgon du bka' brgyad khro rol gtor zlog gi 'tshogs dbur phebs/tshes 29 la gtor rgyag dang tshogs brgya bsang bcas zla 4 pa'i tshes 1 nyin grol/ tshes 7 la rdzong shod du phebs lam rdzong sar nas mkhyen sprul rin po ches dar gtong dang tshur lam gdan 'dren 'byor/ tshes 9 nyin rdzong shod du skya thabs rol bsu bcas phebs/ tshes 10 la gsang thig yab bka'i tshogs mchod dang /

60 'jam mgon kong sprul sku phreng gnyis pa'i rnam thar/dgon pa'i grwa tshang yod rigs la phyag 'gyed/ dpal chen g.yang skyabs/ sgar bsang bcas grub nas tshes 19 nyin tshur phebs/ rdzong sar du sprul sku rin po che'i thugs bzhed grub rgyal tshe dbang phul/ 'chi med 'phags ma'i snying thig gi byin rlabs sogs tshur zhu bar mdzad nas yang khrod du phebs/ dgon du sku mched mjal 'phrad gnang /a mdo mtsho sngon du bstan 'gror sman pa'i mdzad phrin skyong skabs sku 'bam lta bu'i bsnyun gzhi bzhes pa/zla 5 pa'i nang zi ling phyogs su phebs rgyu mdzad nas zhe rdzogs tshab tsha sogs kyi bla sprul sde dgon tshang ma'i bzhed skong thugs brel rim sel gyis/ rdza rgyud/ mgo log bcas pa'i dad sbyin rnams kyi re ba skong bzhin rma chu brgal nas sog yul gyi mtshams bar phebs/ sog po dud kha shas kyis gdan 'dren dang zla 9 bar rta bsu bcas mtsho sngon du phebs/ mtsho sngon bla ma skal ldan sgar dang / bong stag dpal bzang sogs dad spyin mang po'i 'dod skong dang / phan tshun gdan 'dren rnams la'ang cung zad re phebs/ a lags skal ldan sgar der chos sgar bzhugs nas phyogs 'dus skor gyi 'dod chos dang / khyad par gsung chog skor zla 11 pa'i zhi khro bdun gcig dang / bcu gcig pa'i mar ngor mgon gsol nyin brgyad sogs gson gzhin rnams kyi cho ga sku rim rigs dang / zla 12 pa'i tshes 22nas sgrub bla karma chos 'phel gyis phur pa'i gtor zlog dang rje rang nyid dpon slob kyis mgon gsol tshes 29 bar gsungs/ shing khyi gnam lo gsar tshes la

kun khyab snyan pa'i ba dan/ 61sgyin bdag rigs la dbang rjes gnang rigs dang / mtsho khar phebs te sgar bsang chen mo rgyas par btang / zla 2 tshes 10 nyin gsang thig yab bka'i tshogs brgya dang / byams pa mtha' yas zer ba'i tshe sgrub nyin mang bar gsungs pa tshe dbang bcas kyis grub/ 'di skabs sku 'bam bzhes pa lta bus bsnyun gzhi bab lci ba byung / de phyogs bla ma a dga' zhes pa7rje 'jam mgon bla ma gong ma'i slob gras shig 'dug par brtag pa zhus par/ mkha' 'gro'i sun zlog dang tshogs mchod grangs mang babs pa rnams grwa 'khor rnams gtsos rang gzhan kun gyis grub/ gzhan yang sgrol chog gsol 'phar sogs sku rim zhabs brtan rgya cher bsgrubs kyang dwangs skyed cher ma byung / rje nyid la bka' 'dri zhus pas/ sgar pa sdod gnas spos na e legs gsungs/ de ltar 'phral du sgar gzhis nyin kha shas mtshams bar rim par sbos pas sku khams 'phral du dwangs pa lta bus rim dwangs byung / bong stag ru ba'i phyogs su dad sbyin khag gi re ba skong ba'i phrin las mu skyong gis tshur phebs/ zhabs gras rnams kyis zhu bskul dang bstun gdan sa chen por shar rgyag phebs pa'i lam du/ rma chu shin tu rgyas nas sgar lam bcad pas bcag mal mdzad/ nyin gnyis la skong gso 'phar ma mdzad/ chu glo bur du bri nas phebs chog byung ba mnyam du yod pa'i mgo log pa 'gas mthong nas ya mtshan chen po byed/ kho rang tsho'i yul du phebs skul zhus kyang ma gnang / 'di skabs gzims lam du/ rje rang gi sku lus cha gsum du gyur nas lte ba phyin rgya mtsho shin tu chen por gyur/ snying ga dang lte ba'i bar sa gzhir snang ba/ de yan mgo dang bcas pa nam mkha'i rang bzhin can/ mgrin pa'i thad nas nyi zla gza' skar rgyu ba'i ya mtshan can zhig rmis gsungs/ lam 'khod bla dpon sde dgon tshang mas

62 'jam mgon kong sprul sku phreng gnyis pa'i rnam thar/rang rang 'dod chos gson gshin rim gro sogs gnang bzhin/ zla 11 pa'i nang gdan sa dpal spungs yang khrod du byams mgon rin po che dang mkhyen sprul rin po che bcas pa'i zhabs gras kha shas re'i bsu ma bcas phebs/ sku mched rnams la dngos 'bul bcas mjal 'phrad mdzad/ zla 12 pa'i tshes 12nas mkhyen brtse'i yang gter rong zom pad+ma mkha' 'gro'i bsnyen sgrub dbu tshugs/ shing phag gnam lo gsar du tshes pa'i dga' ston mchod 'bul rigs grub nas/ slar gong gi bsnyen sgrub mu mthud kyis lo de'i dbyar smad nas bsnyen sgrub las gsum rgyas par grub/ 'di nas bzung rang la mi kha byams shing phrin las je rgyas song bas zab chos 'di la yid ches brtan po byung zhes gsungs/slar mkhyen brtse'i 'chi med 'phags ma'i snying tig gi bsnyen mtshams dbu tshugs/ yar mar tshes bcu/ dgu gtor tsam las dbang lung sogs thugs brel che rigs med pas bcad rgya shin tu dam po red song / me byi gnam lo gsar du tshes/ 'phags ma'i snying tig gi bsnyen sgrub legs par grub bo/ /'di lo rgya mi gung khran dmag dpung 'di phyogs su snga ma 'ong ba'i skad grags la brten dgon sde tshang ma bag skrag che skabs yin pas spyi sger nas rim gro shin tu mang ba dang /dpal spungs nas bka' brgyad khro rol gtor zlog bcas sgrub pa'i 'tshogs dbur phebs/ de rjes byams mgon rin po che 'bri nub tu phebs pas rje 'di'ang byon nas 'dzam gru brgal/ sil kho phur chos sgar lhan rgyas rgyang tsam bzhugs/rgya dmag hor khog dang kaḥthog phyogs bar bslebs kyang za cha skor tsam las gnod 'tshe che rigs med cing khyad par 'di phyogs bsleb ma byung / de nas shar rgyag karma lha steng du phebs/ de nas tsha sgang phyogs su sge ru dpon tshang sogs dad

kun khyab snyan pa'i ba dan/ 63sbyin mang pos zhu ngor sgrub chen lan bdun 'dzugs bzhed kyis thog mar sgrol ma lha khang du phebs/ rat+na gling pa'i thugs rje gsang 'dus kyi sgrub chen khrom dbang bcas grub/ de phyogs ris med dad 'dus kyi dge tshul snyong brgya skor bsgrubs/btsun ma mang po rab tu phyung / de skabs bar chad shugs bdo ba lta bus bsnyun gzhi lci bas zin/ zhabs phyi grwa 'khor gyis tshur gdan drangs par jo nang zhes par bsnyun gzhi slar thu tshabs che bar gyur pas/ zhabs phyi budha dang yon tan phun tshogs gnyis kyis zhabs pad brtan thub thabs ci drag zhus par/ khyod tshos nus na sgar gzhi sku chas mchod cha sogs mdor na dngos rdzas yod rigs spang dag byed thub na e phan snyam/ de ma byas na 'chi rgyu yin 'dra gsungs/ de ma thag rje nyid kyi chibs pa sga 'byar/ gzims gur/ na bza' thabs ma chag tsam ma gtogs tshang ma spang dag gis/ gtso cher 7rgyal ba'i dbang po bcu drug pa de skabs karma dgon du phebs yod pa dang / skyabs mgon si tu rin po che bcas rnam pa gnyis la sku chas gang drag nas 'bul chen/ de mtshams rdzong sar mkhyen brtse rin po che dang / mkhan chen rdo rje 'chang drung rin po che bcas la 'bul chen bcas rje nyid kyis bcad/ 'phros ji 'os gyis gsungs pa ltar zhabs gras mdzod rnam gnyis kyis mtshur phu man chad yar mar bla dgon khag la chos rgyab zhabs brtan bsgrubs pas cung dwangs/ drung rin po che gdan drang ched bskyod kyis tshe sgrub bla glud dang / tshe dbang bcas shin tu grangs mang mdzad/ zhabs brtan kyang rje rang nyid kyis tshogs dang yig brgya grangs ci 'gro dgos gsungs pa ltar zhus/bsnyun gzhi tshabs che nas thugs 'khrul ba lta bu'i gsung las sgrol dkar mjal nas sku tshe'i tshad cig gsungs kyang snga ma ma gsal/ rjes su yang mjal nas

64 'jam mgon kong sprul sku phreng gnyis pa'i rnam thar/bgrang bya mkha' klu bdun bcu gsum zhes gsungs byung bas da res mi 'chi bar 'dug ces dang / rgyal ba'i dbang po'i mdun skyabs rten phul ba'i 'byor lan bka' rgya 'dir khyer shog gsungs/ zhabs gras kyis da dung bka' rgya bsleb ma thub zhus kyang / bka' rgya khur shog de nang 'di dang 'di zhes gsungs 'dug ces sogs gsungs pa mi ring bar bka' rgya dngos 'byor bas de kho na ltar 'dug go /'di skabs phebs lam rje nyid gcig pu las zhabs gras tshang mar chibs pa sogs ci yang med pas sde dgon rnams kyis sa tshugs rim par skyel ma zhus/'on kyang rta sga sogs med pa'i 'o brgyal che ba byung yod 'dug kyang / rje nyid sku khams rim dwangs bka' drin gyis mi ring bar sgar gzhis phun sum tshogs pa byung ngo / /de nas drung rin po che bcas lhan rgyas rim par phebs pas karma ri khrod lha steng du zla ba 10 pa'i tshes 25 la 'byor/ der zhabs gras bla grwa rnams gtsos rang gzhan tshang mas sku rim zhabs brtan mang po bsgrubs/ bsnun khams je dwangs gyis lo mjug dgu chen 'tshogs phebs gnang / de skabs nas bsnyun gzhi shin tu dwangs nas/ me glang gnam lo gsar tshes nang gdan sa chen po karma dgon du phebs/ tshes bcu'i 'cham mjal mdzad/ phyogs 'dus dge tshul slong brgyad cu yar brgal bsgrubs/ dbang lung phran tshegs mang du mdzad/rtsi rke nas gter chen mchog gyur gling pa'i sprul sku rin po ches gdan zhus ltar der phebs/ thugs sgrub bar chad kun sel gyi sgrub chen sman sgrub skabs phug gtor rnams las ro bcud ldan pa'i bdud rtsi lhad med 'bab pa kun gyi spyod yul du gyur pa bcas legs par grub/ bla ma bsam gtan rgya mtsho dang /gter sras sprul sku'i mdun nas thugs sgrub bar chad kun sel gyi dbang rtsa ba

kun khyab snyan pa'i ba dan/ 65yan lag dang bklags lung bcas tshang ma gsan/ 7rje bcu pa'i phyag blugs dgu pa dbang phyug rdo rje'i snang brnyan rin po che'ang 'di skabs phyag tu 'byor/ legs gso'i gtong rag rgya cher bstsal/ 'dzi sgar mchog sprul rin po che zhi bar gshegs pa'i dgongs rdzogs su dbon mdzod pas gdan 'dren 'byor/ der byon nas sku gdung bsreg bzhu dgongs rdzogs bcas grub nas gdan sa dpal spungs su phebs/ 'di skabs rgyal ba'i dbang po bcu drug pa gdan sa dpal spungs su bzhugs pas yab sras rnam gnyis kyi mdun mjal 'phrad sogs mdzad/ sa stag gnam lo gsar du tshes pa'i dga' ston sogs dang /bsnyen sgrub ci rigs mdzad pa'i bar mtshams su nye gnas bla ma zla 'od dang dpal 'byor bla ma 'brug rgyal sogs la mar mi'i rnam mgur/ dwags po'i bka' 'bum bcas kyi lung gnang /gnas bza' dam tshig sprul sku'i mdun nas bka' rgya gter mdzod gsum gyi lung gsan/ lo mjug tu tshe tsha stod smad du 'bru sdom du yang phebs par sbyin bdag khag rnams la dam pa'i chos kyi 'brel ba'i phrin las bskyangs/ dpal spungs dgon du 'di skor lo snga rjes mang por bum sgrub rdor sems gnyis kyi rdor slob dang dgu chen la'ang lo gnyis tsam phebs/ sa yos lor lha thog rgyal rgan 'das pa'i ched gdan zhu 'byor/ der phebs nas gsung chog byang sreg sogs bzhed skong rigs grub nas rtsi rke mchog gling gdan sar phebs/ dbang chos bzhed skong ci rigs grub/ mchog gling sprul sku dang lhan rgyas thugs spro dga' ston rgyas par mdzad/ de nas zur mang rnam rtser phebs/ bla grwa rnams kyi bzhed skong dang nang chen phyogs su phebs/ dpal nge dgon sogs gdan 'dren rim byung rnams la phrin las bskyangs/ ja pa dgon zhabs su rata gling thugs gsang sgrub chen mtha'

66 'jam mgon kong sprul sku phreng gnyis pa'i rnam thar/rgyas legs par grub/ sprel tshwa kha nas rim brgyud nang chen rgyal khab tu gdan zhus ltar phebs/ rgyal po yab sras la tshe dbang sogs bzhed skong / dge rgyal smad ma'i ma yum grongs nas gdan 'dren ltar de phyogs stod smad bar gsum gyi dpon sde dgon khag rnams la dbang rjes gnang gshin gson cho ga sogs gang 'dod kyi bka' drin skyong grub nas a khro'i phyogs su'ang dgon khag rnams kyi ngor 'khyug tsam phebs/ phyir phebs lam bo rog gzhung phyogs skor zhig tu khra legs rin po che dbyar sdom phebs pa dang mjal/ khra 'gu dgon du dbyar gnas lha khang gsar bzhengs la rab gnas ched phebs zhus ltar dgon der rab gnas/ g.yang skyabs/ bskang gso sogs dang 'dod chos mang du gnang / ban chen dgon dang zhang 'gu dgon/ dran thang rnam rgyal gling sogs dgon khag rnams dang / lam 'bod mchog dman mang po'i 'dod skong 'brel tshad don ldan du gnang grub nas zla 11 pa'i tshes nang gdan sa yang khrod du phyag phebs/ lo mjug dus gtor sogs snga rgyun rnams legs par grub bo/ /sku gong ma'i sgrub khang zhig gso rgya bskyed mdzad pa/lcags sbrul gnam lo gsar du tshes/ zla 2 pa'i tshes 8 la sngon 'jam mgon gong ma'i dus kyi sgrub khang lo grangs mang bas rnying skyon dang / 'di nas sgrub grwa kha 'phar mang bas ha cang chung skyon bcas gang thad gzhi nas gsar bzhengs mdzad par rnying pa bshigs shing sa rdo khod snyom phyir bshang ra sogs ngal rtsol chen pos rmang btings/ zla 10 pa'i nang lha khang dang mtshams khang phyi khog sdod lo tsam grub/

kun khyab snyan pa'i ba dan/ 67sngar dpon slob bcu yod steng gsar du bco lnga tsam bsnan nas sgrub pa po dngos nyer lnga yod rgyu'i thugs bzhed mdzad/ mgon khang dngos bang khang tshon rtsi bcas grub nas rten gtor dang rtag gtor rnams kyang legs par bkod grub/ lo mjug mgon po'i gtor sgrub skabs kyi gtor chen rtsam 'bo brgyad cu skor gyis bca' rgyu sogs mdor na phyi yi gtsug lag sgrub khang nyer mkho'i khang pa rnams dang / nang gi rten mchod bcas bla nas blar 'degs pa'i mdzad sgo rim skyong dang /'di rigs rdor slob bla ma kar lu rin po ches kyang phrin las kyi rogs ram phul du phyin pa gnang ba bcas kyis mthar phyin par gyur to/ /chu rta gnam lo gsar tshes nas kyang sgrub khang skor gyi shing las tshon rtsi logs bris sogs mu mthud bgyid bzhin/ tshes dus mchod pa 'don pa rnams sogs rgyas par mdzad/ zla 7tshes 4 nyi ma me bzhi'i 'grub sbyor nyin dbu btsugs pa'i sgrol dkar bsnyen sgrub tshad ldan dang gcod kyi tshogs rgya bcas ring sbrel mdzad/ 'di skabs zhe chen kong sprul rin po che pad+ma dri med legs pa'i blo gros mdun nas so lugs yang dag zla gam dgu ma'i dbang dngos sta dang rdo rje 'chang rgyal tshab rin po che'i bka' 'bum pusti bcu po'i lung yongs rdzogs gsan/ gter mdzod dbang lung dang po gsung bzhed/ rje nyid dang bla rgan karma gtsos grwa 'khor mang pos phyag dpe la mchan bu dang gsan yig steng nas dbang lung yod med zhib cha sogs zla ba kha shas mdzad/rje gong ma'i zab gter gsang thig bla sgrub bsnyen rgyas dang / rigs thams cad kyi khyab bdag dpal rdo rje sems dpa' smin gling lugs bka' gter chu bo gnyis 'dres kyi bsnyen sgrub las rung mdzad/ mchod gtor dbang gtor rnams bzo sgros shin tu legs pa bla ma tshe dbang rab brtan dang bkra shis rgya mtsho sogs

68 'jam mgon kong sprul sku phreng gnyis pa'i rnam thar/la bka' gnang ste snga chud mdzad/chu lug zla 2 tshes 25 nyin dbu tshugs pa'i rin chen gter mdzod chen po'i dbang lung dang po gnang bar/ zhu mi slob ma'i tshogs kyang skyabs mgon dpa' bo rin po che/ dpal spungs be ru mkhyen sprul rin po che/ dpal spungs dbon bsam sprul rin po che/ rdor slob bla ma karma rang byung kun khyab/ zur mang 'brug pa sprul sku dang ras chung sprul sku/ tshab tsha sgrub sprul/ nya 'ge sprul sku/ sku skye blo gros/nor sprul/ lha steng 'ja' mo sprul sku/ gter sras mthu stobs rnam rgyal/ ja pa gter sprul/ dad pa dgon sprul sku gnyis/ dbon stod lha 'brang sprul sku sogs dang gzhis byes ris med bla grwa drug cu yar brgal byung / skyabs rje khra legs rin po ches kyang snga rjes rnams su dbang sna mang bar gsan/ thugs rje chen po'i skor sogs khrom dbang rung skabs brgya phrag lhag pa bcas la rgyal dbang mkha' khyab rdo rje'i dbang zin dang phyag bzhes ji ltar dpal rdo rje sems dpa'i dbang khrid bcas nas bzung / rgyud sde'i skor/ bla sgrub nang gses zhi drag skor bcas sgrub sde brgyad spyi dang bye brag skor/ mkha' 'gro dang chos skyong skor/ zhar byung bon lugs kha shas dang las bye brag gi skor/ rdzogs chen sems klong man ngag sde bcas mthar dge tshe gsang dbang chen don dbang bcas dbang rnams la phyag len sogs sla 'chos gtan nas med pa'i shin tu zhib cha mdzad/ khrid lung rnams kyang gsal dag go brda 'phrod nges dang / de bzhin mchod pa spyi bye gzab rgyas/ dbang chen rnams la tshogs 'khor sogs shin tu gzab spros bcas skabs 'dir byas la ma bsags pa min pa'i go chod nges dang phyin chad dbang lung 'chad spel mkhan gyi mig ltos la phan nges mdzad nas/ bklags lung dang bcas pa yongs su

kun khyab snyan pa'i ba dan/ 69rdzogs pa zla 8 tshes 13 la legs par grub/ 'di skabs skyabs rje dpa' bo rin po che sogs zhu mkhan bla chen rnams gtsos 'byor ldan khag gis mang ja phyag 'gyed tshogs 'khor sogs gzab rgyas dang bla ma rin pe rdzoche ka lus phyag rdzas gang yod kyis mchod 'bul rgya che rgyun ring mdzad/ ri khrod bla brang rang nas mchod rdzas rigs gtong sgo rgya shin tu che ba gnang ba bcas 'phros don tsam mo/ /dbang lung grub 'phral yang khrod kar rabs lha khang du rje rang nyid slob tshogs dang bcas pas mchog gling thugs sgrub bar chad kun sel sgrub chen sman sgrub dang sbrel ma mdzad/ legs par grub nas khrom dbang skabs yang khrod gnas khang dog pas ma shong nas tshur rgyab spo gras zhes par gnang / skya ser pho mo stong phrag yar brgal 'dus/ 'di yi dbang lung skabs dus gcig sku khams cung ma dwangs pas nyin bco lnga skor chos mtshams 'jog dgos byung ba dang / sku zhabs mkhyen sprul rin po ches thugs brel skabs sogs nyin re gnyis las bar mtshams med par ring sbrel mdzad do/ /de rjes rje dpa' bo rin po che'i mdun nas kar lugs kun rigs rnam grol sgo chen gyi dbang lung dang mi 'brugs lha dgu'i rjes gnang /chos rje gling pa'i gter chos yongs rdzogs kyi dbang lung gsan/ shing sprel lo gsar du tshes/ 'di skor bka' 'gyur bla ma rin po che'i mdun nas rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur yongs rdzogs bklags lung gsan pa dang khra legs rin po ches zhus ngor/ rje khra legs/ bla ma rin po che kar lu/ lha steng 'ja' mo sprul sku/ go che hor sku sprul sku sogs dpon slob nyi shu skor la gdams ngag mdzod kyi dbang lung khrid dang bcas pa lan dang po bstsal/ shing bya gnam lo gsar du tshes/ khra legs rin po che sogs la mar mi'i rnam mgur/ rje dus gsum mkhyen pa'i

70 'jam mgon kong sprul sku phreng gnyis pa'i rnam thar/bka' 'bum/ dbang phyug rdo rje'i bka' 'bum/ bdud 'dul rdo rje'i bka' 'bum sogs kyi lung dang / gzhan dbang lung 'ga' re gnang / rngog pa'i brtag gnyis 'grel pa rin chen rgyan 'dra lung sogs tshur la'ang 'ga' re gsan/ zla 5tshes 11 la rgyal dbang rdo rje 'chang gis bdag gis gtsos yid can mang po 'khor ba'i mtsho las phyag gis 'dren pa'i bkod pa mthong zhes phyag lir phyag bris gnang 'dug 'di dag gi lo snga rjes gang rigs rnams su bla ma kar lu'i mdun nas shangs pa'i gzhung pod bzhi/ mgon po'i gzhung pod stod smad lugs gnyis bcas lung dang / chu 'gur bla ma bsod nams tshe brtan las bstan bcos chen po shes bya kun la khyab pa'i bshad lung dang sa bdag nyes sel sogs mang po/ sgrub dpon bde legs las zab mo nang don zhib khrid bcas gsan yod 'dug me khyi gnam lo gsar du tshes/ 'di lo khra 'gu nas khra legs rin po ches thugs sgrub bar chad kun sel sman sgrub sbrel ma 'dzugs bzhed kyi dbu bzhugs su gdan drangs ma phebs ka med byung / de gar sgrub chen gtsos pa'i thugs bzhed rigs bar chad med par grub nas sga stod phyogs dgon khag rnams kyis gdan 'dren rim gyis nan tan che stabs so sor 'dod chos dbang lung bar med dang lam 'khod kun la gshin gson cho ga rigs re skong thugs brel rim sel/ karma kai tshang / 'brug pa bka' brgyud/ 'bri gung ba sogs grub mtha' ris med pa'i grwa btsun stong phrag yar brgal rab tu byung ba dang bsnyen par rdzogs pa'i mkhan po mdzad/ btsun ma mang po la'ang sdom pa bstsal ba sogs bka' drin gyis khyab par mdzad nas khra 'gu dgon du slar 'khor/ lo mjug dgu chen 'tshogs dbur phebs/ me phag gnam lo gsar tshes kyi dga' ston dang tshe sgrub dus chen snga

kun khyab snyan pa'i ba dan/ 71'then gyis gar 'cham gzigs 'bul mdzad bzhed/ rje nyid dbur bzhugs kyis tshe sgrub nyin gcig cho ga btang nas gar 'cham la gzigs nas rim par chos sgar bteg ban chen dgon dang zhang 'gu dgon sogs lam 'bod dgon sde sbyin bdag khag la rang rang 'dod pa'i dbang rjes gnang lung khrid gson gshin cho gas re ba bskangs/ rnam rgyal gling bla ma kha shas la ma mgon zhal sbyor gyi gtor dbang gnang nas zla 2 pa'i tshes 7 la dpal spungs yang khrod kyi gdan sar phebs so/ /(mitsho sngon du byon pa nas bzung 'di bar rnam thar rtsa tho zhal gsung med par ma zad/phyag li la'ang phyag tho zhib cha med pa'i hol khongs su song 'dug pas rang gzhan rnams kyi ched phran bu sa bcad ma stong pa'i phyir du bris pa las zhib cha med cing shes bzhin du spyi brtol bskyed nas rdzun lab pa'ang med kyang / cung zad nor zhabrul yod srid na dmigs med thugs rje'i bdag nyid rje bla ma rtsa gsum chos srung dang bcas pas bzod par mdzad du gsol/ da ni 'di nas zhing brje kha bar phyag li las zhib mor 'khod 'dug pa nyid 'bri bar bya ste/)dbus phebs thengs gnyis par bstan 'gror sman pa'i mdzad phrin rgya cher bskyangs pa/me phag zla 2 tshes 1 nas zla bzang sprul pa'i skur nā ro chos drug gi khrid gnang /rdor slob bla ma kar lu'i mdun nas dus 'khor lha dgu'i bsnyen yig gi lung gsan/ bla ma'i chos gos snam sbyar la byin rlabs zhus pa ltar gnang nas hor

72 'jam mgon kong sprul sku phreng gnyis pa'i rnam thar/khog tu phebs/ yang khrod mgon khang du gtang rag gsol 'phar dang spyan gzigs phul/ dam rdzas gzungs gzhug sogs gzhan gyi re skong mang tsam dang rgyal dbang bcu drug pa'i zhabs brtan tshe sgrub bla glud nyin brgyad/ zla sprul la phyag chen nges don rgya mtsho'i khrid lung bcas gnang / sgrub gling du 7skyabs mgon rin po che'i zhal mjal snyan zhu dang / dbus su phebs rgyu'i sna sel tshes 22 nas ma mgon drag mdos mtha' rgyas sgar bsang bcas gnam gang bar bsgrubs/ltas mtshan legs gsungs/ sa ga zla ba'i nang dpal mo'i lugs kyi bsnyung chog tshar gsum re sogs lag len shin tu zhib mo gzhung mthun mdzad nas cha brgyad rjes chog bcas grub par mdzad/ rje nyid kyi zhal nas/ deng sang rang re ser gzugs rnams kyis sdom pa gsum ga zhu bzhin srung mtshams sogs la ji mi snyam pa 'dis/ thar pa lta ci smos mtho ris mi lus tsam yang thob dka'/ de ma thob na 'khor ba mtha' med par srid pa'i duḥkha chen po nyams su myong dgos nges pas/thung 'phral shi 'dra song na mi lus 'thob phyir bsnyung gnas sdod pa yin gsungs/khong la de 'dra'i dogs pa ga la yod kyang grwa 'khor ser gzugs 'chal 'chol rnams la dgongs pa'i gsung yin pa gor ma chag go /mi pham sprul sku la lam zab le'u bdun ma'i lung dang / chab tsha nya sprul sogs kyi bzhed skong / rong bo reb kong sngags chen bkra shis dpal ldan la smin gling rdor sems dbang lung bcas gnang ba grub/ rdzong sar dgon du phebs/ sprul sku rin po che dang lhan rgyas kyis zhal 'phros sna tshogs dang 'chi med 'phags ma'i snying thig tshe yi byin rlabs grangs mang tshur gsan/ phar la'ang thugs bzhed ltar khams bye'i byams chen rab gnas dang 'jam mgon rin po che'i zab gter yang dag gi dbang lung /

kun khyab snyan pa'i ba dan/ 73rgyal dbang bco lnga pa'i bla sgrub bde chen grub pa'i thig le'i dbang lung / karma snyan brgyud kyi bde mchog yab bka' yum bka'i dbang sogs nyin grangs mang bar phul/ tshogs mchod sogs lhan rgyas kyis gzab spros mdzad/ yang khrod du tshur phebs nas rdzong shod sprul sku dang rdor brag sprul sku la dbang lung kha shas/tshes 27 la dpa' bo rin po che'i thugs dam rten mgon srog 'khor rab gnas bcas cho ga rgyas par btang / zla 5 pa'i nang bla ma kar lu hor khog tu yar 'byor/tshes 7 la dbu che rtser lam bsang rgyas pa btang / tshes brgyad dgu rnams la sgrub pa rnams nas lam sel dngos rol/ myur mdzad mgon po'i skong ba bcas gang rgyas/ mgon khang khag la spyan gzigs phul/ dpal spungs dbon rgan sprul sku dang rdor brag sprul sku/ sde zhabs karma sde btsun phyag bris bcas byung bar thugs brel rim sel gyis/ tshes 11 nyin skyabs mgon mdun khams bde zhu bar byon zhor rag nyag pha rgan shi bar byang sreg mdzad/tshes 12 la dbon rgan gtsos pa'i chibs skyel gyis rim par rtsa brgyad thang du sde dge sa skyong dang rdzong sar sprul sku rin po che'i zhu yig rnams slebs/ 'dzam gru brgal te lam 'khod tshang ma'i 'dod don bskangs/ rngog sges su phebs skabs bdud rtsi dil nas gdan 'dren grwa mngags dang khra legs bang mi 'byor/ rta thabs rol bsu bcas bdud rtsi dil du byon/ rol rdor sprul sku rin po che dang drung pa'i yang srid mjal 'phrad la 'jam mgon gro lod bsnyen yig gi lung phul/gzhan yang dgon der rab gnas/ khrom dbang / g.yang skyabs bcas gnang /drung rin po che'i sprul sku gtsos dge tshul dang bsnyen rdzogs so drug tsam bsgrubs/drung rin po che'i yang srid la sku khrus dang 'jam dbyangs smra seng rjes gnang rab

74 'jam mgon kong sprul sku phreng gnyis pa'i rnam thar/byung sogs so byang sngags gsum gyi sdom pa gnang / yer phug sgrub pa rnams la sems khrid/ mang zhig la sgrol dkar rjes gnang sogs dal med mdzad nas bla bro dgon du phebs/ g.yang chog dang / khrom dbang / mgon khang du bskang gso bcas rdo dgon ras chung sprul sku la tshe dbang / ras chung snyan brgyud skor khrid lung mdzad/ mchog gzhung ram mdor khra legs rin po che phebs pa'i bzhed skong dang /lam bar rdo rdo dgon pa/ dga' ldan dgon pa bcas kyis ja zhu dar gtong byung /bla sprul rnams la sgrol dkar rjes gnang sogs mchog dman kun gyi re ba bskangs/ gar sprul rin po che sogs kyis chibs skyel bcas rim par phebs/dad pa dgon du dge tshul zhe gcig bsnyen rdzogs nyi shu skor bcas bsgrubs/ go che dgon du dbang rjes gnang sogs dang mgon po'i bskang gso rgyas pa/ skyo brag tu phebs skabs dil yag dang nang chen rgyal khab nas gdan zhu 'byor/ dgon der grwa nyi shu la dge tshul sdom pa gnang / phebs lam nang chen nas lam yig dang 'brang sar pe hu 'byor/ dil yag dgon du zla sprul sa bcu grwa mang bcas la grub rgyal tshe dbang gnang / rog rgyam gzhung du tshes 29 dus mchod mgon gsol rgyas pa btang / tshugs chags mdzad nas tshes 30 nyin myur mdzad mgon poligasol skong btang / 'brang smad pe hu bla mas mjal/ zla 7 tshes 1 la 'brong bar sges sna dgon du phebs/ na mo cher sgar phab nas gter gsar sgrol ma 'jigs pa kun sel gyi cho ga dang khrom dbang mdzad/ lci stod phrag la mdar chos sgar phab nas de phyogs grwa bcu tsam rab tu phyung zhing bdun la bsnyen rdzogs mdzad/ bla ma lhag bsam sogs bla sprul mang por bla sgrub bde chen grub thig gi dbang lung / sde spyi la khrom dbang bcas tshes 8 la ri stod mtshams sprul byung / sgrol ma 'jigs pa

kun khyab snyan pa'i ba dan/ 75kun sel gyi cho ga btang / rim gyis lam 'bod rnams la khrom dbang tshes bcu sogs dus mchod sngar rgyun rigs ma chag par mdzad nas sog lcag zam khar sku mched bsod stobs dang mjal/ sog g.yang can thang nas rta shad gdong bod du zhu yig btang /tshes 29 la spyang ki la'i tshur nang phebs/ dus chod gsol 'phar dang gnam gang nyin phyag drug pa'i bskang gso rta glud bcas btang / sdom pa'i ma rgan 'chi bar 'pho lung gsungs/ rim phebs kyis zla 8 tshes 16 nyin rta thabs bsu ma bcas lha ldan ra lcang du phebs/ ma yum sras rnams dang dgyes mjal thog jo shāka rnams zhal mjal/ nyag rong gter sras bsnyun tshabs che bas tshe dbang dang 'das rjes 'pho lung mdzad/ gzhung sa'i sku drag khag la dbang khrid dang / gzhan mchog phal mang por 'dod skong mdzad/ 7dga' ldan khri rin po che mjal gsung 'phros zhib mo mdzad/ zla 9 tshes 8 lha ldan nas bteg tshes 10 nyin 'og min mtshur phu'i gdan sar thog rol bsu ma bcas phebs/ kha ba me tog gi dbyibs can sa dkar tsam babs/ 'di skabs7rgyal dbang bcu drug pa chen po rgya gar dang stod gangs ri'i phyogs chos sgar bteg skabs yin pas gdan sar mi bzhugs/ tshes 11 nyin 7yab rje rdo rje 'chang gi gdung rten mjal/ mtshur sgar gzhung zur nas chas gso phul/ ri khrod du mkha' 'gro chen mo mjal/ sgrub sde la rdo rje 'chang thung ma'i khrid gnang / sku mched thugs sras mdzod pa dang mjal/tshes 22 la sku gdung rin po che'i mdun stod mchod dang 'brel bla sgrub bde chen grub thig gi tshogs mchod smon lam yid tshim par zhus pas byin rlabs kyi babs kyang thob snyam gsungs/ thub chen gtsos lha khang khag la snyan shal mar me'i phreng

76 'jam mgon kong sprul sku phreng gnyis pa'i rnam thar/ba phul/ gsol smon zab rgyas gnang / tshes 25 la dus mchod dkon spyi'i tshogs dang nyer dgu'i gsol 'phar rgyas pa/ zla 10 pa'i mgor gnas nang du rta bsu/ thog rol/ mdun bsu bcas bdag rgyan gus zhabs tshad med kyis dpa' bo rin po che dang mjal/ grwa mang gis dar btang / de skabs mdo khams nas yang khrod bla brang rgyal tshab bla ma kar lu'i yi ge 'byor/ tshang ma khams bzang yin 'dug nyin kha shas lhan du 'dzoms nas lha ldan ra lcang gzim shag tu phebs/rgyud stod mkhan zur/ ja sprul/ bon shod phog dpon sogs la zhal mjal/ tshe dbang / lung phran tshegs bcas bzhed skong mdzad/ tshes 10 la tshogs btang /ru thog rim bzhi/ bla ma ye shes snying po/ rgyal dbang lcam sring dbyangs can bcas la zhal 'phros lung khrid sogs mdzad/ tshes 15 la zhi khro lha khang 'dus sdes gdan drangs khong tsho'i lugs ltar kar gling zhi khro'i cho ga btang / 'dus par phyag 'gyed gnang / dpal lha'i ri rab gtor rgyag lha mo'osku gsob dang karma shag gi chos skyong bcas gzigs/ dga' ldan khri rin po che'i mdun nas dga' ldan lha brgya ma dang / 7rje tsong kha ba chen po'i bde smon zhing mchog sgo 'byed ma'i ljags lung gsan/ zhi khro lha khang du gcod tshogs rin phreng / klong snying rigs 'dus tshogs skong bcas dngos 'bul dang blangs mdzad/ ru thog rim bzhi par byab khrus dang ma mgon gsol 'phar nyin kha shas gnang / zla ba 11 pa'i tshes mgor mnyan sprul rin po che'i phyag bris dang rgyal dbang rdo rje 'chang gi 'dra zhal phyag bzo 'byor/ thugs dgyes tshor chen po mdzad/ mtshur phu nas mdzod bud+dhā 'gyed sogs grub nas phyir bslebs/ ru thog rim bzhi la g.yang chog 'bras mo ljongs kyi dge slong sngags 'chang bcas mang ba la chos 'brel/ gsang thig phur pa'i

kun khyab snyan pa'i ba dan/ 77gtor zlog smin gling rdor sems sgo nas byang sreg phur tsha sprul sku/ ra shag dmag spyi me nyag kun bzang sprul sku sogs phyogs 'dus mang bar thugs sgrub bar chad kun sel gyi dbang lung spyi bye brag rtsa ba'i dbang chen/ bka' srung tshe dbang sogs dbang lung tshang 'dril nyin grangs mang bar gnang / 'bul bsnyen rgya cher byung / bdud 'joms rin po che dang ra sa rgya rgan/ ru thog rim bzhi/ shag lho'i rgya mi sras sku zhabs/ 'brug lo phyag pa sogs mang po'i bzhed skong grub nas gnas nang du phebs/ dpa' bo rin po che dang lhan rgyas thugs bzhed dbang lung bskangs/ tshes 27 la skar 'dzin mdzad/ lha sa nas bud+dha dpon g.yog kyang 'byor/ yongs dge'i gro lod lde mig kun khyab nyi ma sogs lung tshan kha shas dang dkon spyi'i rdzogs khrid khams gsum yongs grol bcas grub/ nyer dgu'i dus mchod chag pas yin nam rmi ltas cung 'khrugs gsungs/ zla 12 pa'i tshes mgo nas zhi phreng / drag phreng / chos skyong glog phreng bcas tshes 10 la grub nas dkon spyi'i tshogs 'khor mdzad/ chos drug bdud rtsi nying khu'i khrid lung dang dogs sel bka' mol zhib rgyas mdzad/ dpa' bo rin po che'i mdun nas tshe sgrub thabs shes kha sbyor dbang / pad+ma badz+ra dbang / cha lag lnga/ dbang chings gnyis kyi yig chung lung bcas tshur gsan/gdams mdzod tsaka dkyil mtshur phu nas g.yar bo zhu dgos stabs rje nyid der ched du phebs/ tshogs chen rdor slob 'od zer la mgon pod bka' rgya nang gi bsnyen yig chos skyong tog gi rgya mdud lung gnang / zur ri drung pa'i thugs bzhed rigs dang 'du khang chos spyod gnas brtan phyag mchod bcas bstan pa rgyas pa'i smon lam mdzad/ tsaka dkyil bsnams nas gnas nang du phebs/ tshes 17 nas

78 'jam mgon kong sprul sku phreng gnyis pa'i rnam thar/dpa' bo rin po che gtsos 'dus pa sum cu skor la gdams mdzod gnyis pa dbu tshugs/ zhen pa bzhi bral khrid nas bzung tshes 20 la rab bdun cho ga rgyas pa dang dbu ma lugs kyi sems bskyed phul/ bdag don zhen med khrid/ phyi nyin nye sras brgyad chog btang nas sems tsam lugs su grags pa'i sems bskyed 'dzin med bzhi khrid bcas grub/ blo sbyong don bdun ma'i khrid nas bzung dga' ldan phyag chen 'bru lung bar dbang khrid lung bcas grub nas tshes 25 la chos mtshams mdzad/ tshes 26 la mtshur phur phebs/ dgu chen tshogs dbur bzhugs/ 'cham mjal bcas grub nas sa byi gnam lo gsar tshes mtshur phu'i mdzad chen dga' ston dang rgyalatshab rin po cher byab khrus sogs grub mtshams gnas nang du phebs/gzim chung chos dbyings dga' tshal du lhan rgyas thog dpa' bo rin po ches rje 'di la sku gsung thugs maṇ+ḍal gyis mtshon brtan bzhugs dang gsol ston phul/rje 'di nyid kyis skyabs mgon dpa' bo rin po che 'di lo dgung grangs so bdun gegs sel zhabs brtan tshe sgrub thabs shes kha sbyor nyin bdun 'tshog rgyu mdzad nas/ gnas nang grwa tshang dang rje nyid kyi sgar gras dpal spungs grwa tshang bcas pas tshe sgrub sun bzlog bcas tshes 14 la grub nas brtan bzhugs dang tshe dbang phul/ tshes 15 nyin grwa bcu bzhi tsam bsnyen rdzogs btsun ma mang por rab byung gnang / 'bul chen byung ba dang blang mdzad/ tshes 16 nas gdams mdzod 'phros lung dang / phyi nyin nas sa skya'i kye rdor man ngag lugs kyi sta gon/ de'i phyi nyin sa lugs kye rdor dbang slob ma nyer lnga'i grangs bcad kyis nyin gnyis su bskur ba sogs nas bzung / zla 2 tshes 24 la khrid brgya'i pod dbang / sems khrid yid bzhin nor bu/ tshe khrid zhag bzhi pa bcas kyis gdams mdzod rin po che

kun khyab snyan pa'i ba dan/ 79dbang lung khrid yongs rdzogs/ shing rta kun 'dus bla ma mchod pa sogs grub/tshes 25 la rat+na'i che gsang don dbang / sgrol dkar tshe khrid/ slar tshe gsang las byang btang nas gnas nang bla brang gis brgya mchod khag sogs mchod pa gzab spros dang tshogs 'khor dngos 'bul rgya che ba mtha' rgyas mdzad nas legs par grub bo/ /tshes 27 la gnas nang mgon khang du myur mdzad mgon po'i gsol kha rgyas par btang / ring min mtshur phur phebs/ rgyal tshab rin po che'i thugs bzhed zhabs brtan tshe gsang sun zlog dang rje rang gi zhabs brtan bcas mtshur phu'i rdor slob sogs dpon slob bcu skor gyis nyin brgyad/ rtsa gsum dril sgrub tshogs stong rtsa bcas grub/ zla ba 3 pa'i tshes 8 nyin dpa' bo rin po cher brtan bzhugs/ 'dus sde la tshe gsang don dbang las byang skor gyi lung gnang / gzhan yang mchod gong 'dir/ g.yang skyabs/ rab gnas sogs kyis bzhed pa bskangs/dngos 'bul dang len mdzad/ mtshur sgar grwa mang gis zhus ngor/ 'du khang chen mor 7rgyal dbang bcu bzhi pa'i bka' 'bum yongs rdzogs kyi lung nyin bzhi'i khongs su grub par mdzad/ gzhan yang sgar gzhung grwa tshang la nyer mkho'i dbang lung khrid gsum gnang / mchod gong grwa tshang / zur ri/ sgar gzhung rnams la rtsa gsum dril sgrub bsnyung gnas rjes gnang 'don cha phan yon sogs kyi lung / ma mgon sogs chos skyong bdun po'i rjes gnang / 7rgyal dbang bco lnga pa'i bka' 'bum a pa phal cher gyi lung sogs nyer mkho'i dbang lung mang du gnang / 'bul tshan dang bzhes mdzad/ sgrub khang chen mor sgrub bla rnams la rgyal rgyam lha lnga/chos gling phur pa'i dbang dngos sta/ 'ja' tshon dkon spyi zhi drag seng gsum/ tshe

80 'jam mgon kong sprul sku phreng gnyis pa'i rnam thar/dbang / yang gter dri med rgyal rgyam/ tshes rdor j-i dkar rnams kyi dbang / jo lugs sgrol dkar rjes gnang / de dag gi yig cha tshang ma'i lung / rgya chen spyod rgyud dang zab mo lta rgyud kyi sems bskyed 'jam mgon mkhyen brtse'i yig cha ltar dang / kun rig bsnyen yig sogs dbang lung mang po gnang / phur pa'i sgrub chen skabs rtsa 'cham sogs rdo rje gar gyi cho ga rnams dang rgyal tho sogs gzigs/tshes 26 la yab rje rgyal ba'i dbang po'i sku gdung mdun brgya mchod snyan shal bcas bla sgrub tshogs mchod mdzad/ bar mtshams rnams su dbang lung zhu mkhan mang bar re skong dang dge tshul slong mang du bsgrubs/ tshes 27 la gsol 'phar/gnam gang nyi 'dzin la yab rje rgyal ba'i dbang po'i sku gdung mdun mchod 'bul gzab spros dang / yan lag bdun pa/ byang sdom len pa/ bla ma rang sems dbyer med mnyam bzhag bcas yun ring mdzad do/ /de nas phyogs 'dus dbang lung zhu mkhan mang por mkha' 'gro gsang ba kun 'dus dbang so so/ khrid lung sogs phyag len gtsang dag tshul mthun/ gsang thig phur pa'i gter dbang / 'jam mgon bla ma'i rtsa gsum dgongs 'dus/ tshig bdun bla sgrub/ dbang spyi bye rnams dang klong chen snying thig gi skor/ mchog gling thugs sgrub rnam gsum/ rat+na'i tshe gsang dbang chen/ dkon spyi'i khrid skor/ phyag chen sngon 'gro/ thun mtshams chos spyod sogs kyi lung / sems khrid kyang mang du gnang bas mtshon mtha' yas pas zhib par 'bri ma nus/tshes 12 nyin lha mo'i rten mkhar la rlung rta dang bsang mchod mdzad nas gnas nang du phebs/ nyin gnyis gsum ring dgon de'i bla grwa rnams la khrid bslab bya sogs phran tshegs zhu mkhan mang bar 'dod skong dang / stod phyogs 'brog pa skya

kun khyab snyan pa'i ba dan/ 81ser mang tsam la ma ṇi'i sgom lung sogs chos spyin bar med du bstsal nas dpa' bo rin po che dang nyin shas dal bzhugs mdzad rtsis kyang / shangs zam phu'i mtshams bla kha shas dbang lung ched 'byor bas/ dung mtsho ras pa'i rdzogs chen yang tig nag po gser gyi 'bru gcig gi dbang lung khrid bcas dang / dpa' bo rin po che'i zhabs brtan tshe lha rnam gsum sku la rab gnas/ dge tshul so gsum/dge slong nyi shu bcas sgrub par mdzad/ 'ga' zhig la gcod lus sbyin sogs kyi lung / phyogs 'dus mi dmangs rnams la zhal mjal phyag dbang gnang / tshes 18la lha ldan du phebs/ ma yum gcung gsum lhan rgyas mdzad/ 'bras spungs tshogs chen me nyag sprul sku/ rgya mi sras sku zhabs/ ru thog rim bzhi/ rdzogs chen phur tsha sprul sku/ ge cag sprul sku bcas la mjal 'phrad gnang / 'brug pa'i grwa pa 'brog rgan/ dpa' bo'i lcam sring rnams la lung phran tshegs gnang / gsang thig yum bka'i tshogs mchod dang nyer dgu'i gsol 'phar rgyas pa btang / zla 5 nang lcang ra gzim shag thugs bzhed ltar dpal chen ma'i g.yang skyabs/ gter gsal sgrol ma 'jigs pa kun sel gyi cho ga nyin mang du gsungs/ brag g.yab ma dgon grwa pa la mtshan brjod lung / don gnyer can mang por bsnyung gnas rjes gnang / yan lag brgyad pa'i sdom lung / rgyal thang lugs kyi gcod dbang khrid sogs gnang zhing skabs skabs su ma yum gcung rnam pa bcas kyis dbang chen gling khar thugs spro btang / mkhyen mdzod kar phun 'brug yul nas 'khor ba dang / dpal spungs zhabs gras dpal 'byor gnyer tshe dbang rnam gnyis phyir bskyod rgyu'i mjal kha zhus/ 29la mgon phrin mi nub bstan rgyal gtong gnang mdzad/ zla 6 tshes 2 nub rgyal dbang rdo rje 'chang gis byin rlabs dang dbugs

82 'jam mgon kong sprul sku phreng gnyis pa'i rnam thar/dbyung bstsal ba'i rmi lam byung gsungs/ phrodibar mdaṣ+perowāsazhisamalubod masnyeb/)mtshur phur rgyal dbang rdo rje 'chang gi sku gdung mdun mchod 'bul/ byang sdom len pa gsol 'debs smon lam bcas sngar rgyun bzhin mdzad nas gnas nang du phebs/ dpa' bo rin po ches phyag dpe dogs gcod skor zhus pa dang bka' mol mdzad/ lha ldan du phebs/ ma yum sras lhan rgyas su bzhugs/ rgyal ba'i dbang po stod phyogs su phebs pa'i mdun zhu yig phul/ gsang thig yab bka' yum bka'i yar mar tshes bcu dang / bar mtshams su ru thog rgyal po'i sku rim/ 'brug lo phyag par tshe dbang / shel dkar gling pa/ mi rje rtsis dpon rnam sras gling pa/gzhan skya ser mang por dbang lung sogs bar med mdzad/ sger skyid smad nas zhus pa bzhin jo khang bar khang 31 rgyan mdun bsam yas rab byung grwa tshang gi tshogs dbur phebs/ dkon spyi'i tshogs brgya dang / jo shag sogs rten rnams la snyan shal mar me phul/ nyer dgu'i gsol 'phar/ nyin grangs mang por mgon phrin btang / gzhung gi bla rtsis pa dang gzhis sde'i dpon sogs phyogs 'dus rnams la thugs sgrub cha lag sgrol ma 'jigs pa kun sel spyi sger rnams kyi dbang dang lung bcas bstsal/ mkhyen mdzod karma phun tshogs 'byor ba la 'phros mol mdzad/ zla 1 tshes 10 nyin rje nyid ma yum sku mched rnams 'bras spungs su mchod mjal du phebs/ dga' ldan pho brang sde pas gzhis len mdzad/ grwa tshang khang tshan khag spyi bye'i 'du khang steng shod rnams mjal/ phyag mchod thugs smon gnang / gnas chung du phebs/ mtshur phu nas budha 'byor/ gzim shel dkar gling pa'i thugs bzhed dkon spyi'i tshogs 'bum ther rje rang nyid gtsos dpon slob mang tsam gyis nyin gsum dang / gsang thig phur zlog nyin gsum bsgrubs/

kun khyab snyan pa'i ba dan/ 83dngos 'bul dang bzhes mdzad/ tshes 21 la gnas bskor ched dbus ri bar skor du phebs par lhas gdong shan nas gtsang chu brgal sbrag la brgyud phebs skabs sa lam rgyus med stabs lam nor khur bas rje 'dis/ bya rog cig 'phur song bas der phyin na chos skyong gis lam ston yin 'dra gsung bzhin rjes su bskyod pas sbrag la phyi rgyab lam chen nang 'byor 'dug de nas sbrag la brgyud phebs lam ye shes mtsho rgyal bla mtsho'i mchod mjal/ bla sgrub bde thig tshogs mchod bcas mdzad/ de nas bsam yas su phebs te nyin gsum bzhugs ring /mchod mjal tshogs brgya sogs mchod 'bul zab rgyas gnang / has po rir lha srin dam bsgrags dang bod khams bde ba'i thugs smon bden gsol/ gzhan de phyogs sgrub gnas rnams su mchod mjal zhib cha/ lam 'khod dgon sde rnams la'ang gsol ras gnang ba sogs zhabs 'degs zhus/ ris med bstan pa rgyas shing rgyal khams bde ba'i thugs smon zhal bskul mdzad/ ('di skor dbadz+walung chud speldospyon spom sogasakhomaltod med/) de nas 'on lung mnga' ris grwa tshang dang nye bar bsam 'grub khang zhes pa'i tshe smon gling gi gzhis kar sne len dang / mnga' ris grwa tshang gi gtsug lag khang du phebs/ lha ldan nas yum gyis bskur ba'i phyag bris la lan gnang / gdan sa mthil du phebs nas gser khang du bzhugs/ gtsug lag khang gi lha sku'i rigs dang 'jag spyil 'dra zhal mdun snyan shal mchod 'bul/ bla sgrub bde thig tshogs mchod mdzad/ nang rten zhib mjal gyis phebs lam stag tshang sprul skus shangs len zla med mdzad/ zangs ri mkhar dmar du lab sgron yum sras 'dra zhal gsung 'byon mdun bla sgrub bde thig tshogs mchod/dge 'dun par 'gyed/ skya ser mang por chos 'brel mdzad/ phebs lam lha

84 'jam mgon kong sprul sku phreng gnyis pa'i rnam thar/rigs kyi gzhis kas sne len dang / skya ser bzhi bcu skor la blo sbyong don bdun ma'i khrid gnang / rtsed thang brgyud phebs/ pho brang sne'u gdong rtse'i rten mjal/ khra 'brug tu sku gnyer dpon gyis sne len zhus te bzhugs/ thugs sgrub bar chad kun sel gyi sgo nas bdud rtsi sman sgrub mdor bsdus mdzad bzhed gtor bzo sogs grabs yul/ g.yo ru khra 'khrug gi gtsug lag khang du phebs/ snyan dar mar me sogs phul/ zla 11 tshes 11 la sna sel rigs grub skabs 'tshub slong lta bus sku khams ngan tsam 'oXgrags pas zhabs gras rnams bag skrag ci cher byung yang nam gung tsam nas dwangs/ nam langs pa dang khams dwangs yag red 'dugatshes 12 nas tho 'dzugs rgyan bkod bcas dpon slob dgus las byang 'bring bsdus nyin mtshan dus drug dang sngags rgyun ma chad pa bcas/ tshes 15 la dngos grub len chog tho 'grol/ mar me smon lam bcas grub/ sman legs po langs 'dug g.yog rigs rnams tshe chu 'bum pa sogs mjal bar btang / chos sgar bteg lam grwa phyi tshong 'dus 'tshogs par rnam gling zhwa dmar mchog sprul kyis sne len/ gtsug lag khang dang rten rnams la mjal kha mdzad/ rim gyis phebs lam skyid shod 'bod sno gzhis kar dgun nyi zlog khel bas 'chi bslu tshar kha shas btang / ban dzar gru brgal nas rim gyis tshes 25 la lha ldan du phebs/skyes yum dang gcung rnam par mjal 'phrad gnang / tshe 'das 'ga' re'i byang sreg bcas grub nas gnas nang du tshes 29 la phebs/ gsol 'phar chag song bas mgon khang du yon gnang / skyabs mgon dpa' bo rin po che dang lhan rgyas nyin gcig ring dal bzhugs mdzad/zla 12 tshes 1 snga char mtshur mdo'i gdan sar thog rol sbos sna sogs

kun khyab snyan pa'i ba dan/ 85bdag rgyan chen pos phebs/ rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa bcu drug pa'i gser zhal mjal/ bka' mol zhib rgyas dang / tshes 3 nyin rgyal ba'i dbang po'i mdun skyabs rten skor dang yab chen sogs kyi ched phyag rten phul/ skyabs mchog chen po rje 'di nyid bzhugs sar yang phebs/ 'brug pad+ma rnam grol la chags med ri chos kyi lung gnang / skyabs mgon chen pos gangs ri phyogs nas phebs pa'i phyag rtags gnang / tshes 7 nyin skyabs mgon rgyal ba'i dbang pos rin gter dbang lung gsan bzhed 'bul dgos pa'i bka' phab la re zhig dgongs zhu mdzad song / gtsug lag khang la zhabs bskor/ rgyal tshab rin po cher mjal 'phrad/ sku gdung rin po che'i mdun snyan shal brgya mchod byang sdom len pa skye kun rjes 'dzin gyi smon lam bcas sngar bzhin mdzad/ rgyal ba'i dbang por thon phyag phul te mtshur phu nas bteg gnas nang du dpa' bo rin po che mjal nas lha ldan du phebs/ 'brug dkon mchog dbang mos mi ched btang dang / nyag rong mtsho kha'i bla ma/ rtogs ldan ye shes snying po/ dwags po ba kha shas bcas la 'dod chos 'ga'i lung mdzad/ stag lung ma sprul rin po che phebs pa dang mjal 'phrad thugs bzhed ltar g.yu thog bla sgrub kyi lung / gzungs 'jug dam rdzas rigs bcas gnang / tshes 29 la dus mchod bskang gso rgyas par btang /mtshur rtsis zla 1 tshes 1 khel kyang phug lugs zla 12 pa'i tshes 1 brtsis pas 'dir lo gsar dga' ston ma grub/ 'di yan gshin po'i bsngo zhu sogs kyi snga rjes su smin gling rdor sems sgo nas byang bsregs rgyas par mdzad/ yon tan phun tshogs 'byor/ rgyal ba'i dbang po dang dpa' bo'i phyag bris phab/ 'brug yongs 'jin phebs par zhal 'phros mdzad/ dpa' bo rin po ches tshe sgrub kyi dmigs

86 'jam mgon kong sprul sku phreng gnyis pa'i rnam thar/skor dogs gcod bka' 'dri'i lan gnang / sku ngo rnams la mi la'i bla sgrub/ mar mi dwags gsum gsol 'debs lung / 'brug lo phyag nor bu la sgrol dkar rjes gnang / 'brug yongs 'dzin zhabs gras bzhi la dge tshul gyi sdom pa sogs mang du gnang / smin gling mkhan chen/ khra 'gu bla rgan sprul sku/ mdzod rdo rje tshe ring /lcang lo can lha lcam sku zhabs sogs la mjal 'phrad gnang / yongs 'dzin rin po ches 'od srung 'phel gdung 'khrul med rdog brgya phrag lhag phul bar thugs dgyes tshor chen pos 'jam mgon gong ma'i gter rdzas 'ga' re gnang / rgyud stod grwa tshang gi drug cu'i gtor rgyag gzigs/ ma mgon mchod gtor gzab spros bcas ser ma'i gzhung btang / 'brug nas bud+dha'i g.yog gnyis yig bris bcas 'byor/ nyer dgu'i gsol 'phar rgyas pa gnang / phug lugs sa glang gnam lo gsar tshes dga' ston skyes gcung rnams kyi dbur phebs pa'i bzhugs gral dar gtong len/ jo mjal/ sgrol dkar mchod chog gtong ba bcas mdzad/ tshes 2nas shag lho'i sras sku zhabs la thang rgyal tshe dbang brgya brgyad/ lha ldan gzhi sde grwa tshang dang bde chos grwa'i grwa bcu gcig dge tshul/ drug bsnyen par rdzogs pa'i bka' drin bstsal/ la dwags dge slong sogs la 'dul ba'i las chog lung sogs dbang rjes gnang sgom lung sogs mang bar gnang / bde chos yongs 'dzin rin po cher chags med ri chos them med bka' rgya ma'i lung gnang / tshes 6la dpal spungs mkhyen sprul yang srid 'brug yul du 'khrungs pa'i mtshan dang zhabs brtan 'bri bar mdzad/ tshes 14 la skyabs mgon dpa' bo rin po che phebs par mjal 'phrad dang / khams zhe chen dbon sprul phebs par 'phros mol mdzad/ bco lnga mchod par grwa g.yog tshang ma mjal bar btang / lha rgyal rigs

kun khyab snyan pa'i ba dan/ 87kyi rje btsun mar lung tshan mang zhig dang / gzhan phyogs 'dus rnams la sems khrid/ thugs chen bsgom bzlas 'gro don mkha' khyab ma'i sgom lung sogs dal med mdzad/ mtshur phu nas sras mo nges don lags la mjal 'phrad/ gshin khag mang por byang sreg stod lha rtse'i sgrub pa dpon g.yog mang por 'jam mgon gsung bsnyen sgrub spyi gces sogs kyi lung gnang / bde chos yongs 'dzin rin po cher mi la'i rnam mgur lung gnang zhor smon lam gtor rgyag sogs la gzigs mo'ang mdzad/ lung rnams grub pa dang yongs 'dzin rin po ches dngos 'bul phul/ 'brug lo phyag pas zhus ngor/ mtshur rtsis zla ba gnyis pa rjes ma'i tshes mgor dpal chen mo'i g.yang skyabs nyin gsum/ tshes 10 la kun bzang rtser rje btsun ma sogs sku ngo rnams dang lhan rgyas kyis dgon spyi'i tshogs brgya btang /tshes 16 la bud+dha dpon g.yog 'brug yul nas 'byor/ chos mgon rin po cher phebs rdzong gnang / shag byang gzim shag gi sku rim 'ga' re gnang / 'di skor 7gtsang paṇa chen yab dang sku mched bcas la 7'jam mgon bla mas mdzad pa'i bla ma rgyang 'bod lung sogs dbang lung zhu mkhan mang / dus mchod rnams rgyas par mdzad/ tshogs mchod ser phreng mjal/ rdzogs chen gling sprul dang stag tsher mdzod pa'i khye'u sprul sku rnams kyis mjal/ ma yum gyis chos gos kyi rgyu dang snam sbyar phul/ snga rjes ra lcang gzims shag gi sku rim mang tsam bsgrubs/ de skabs dpal chen mo dang rnam sras nor bu mchog rgyas bcas g.yang chog nyin kha shas gsungs/

88 'jam mgon kong sprul sku phreng gnyis pa'i rnam thar/rgyal dbang bcu drug par dbang lung man ngag phul ba/zla 3 pa'i tshes 4 la bud+dha mtshur phu nas khams bskyod sta gon bgyi bar theg ma yum tshang nas dngos 'bul phul/ tshes 7 nyin mtshur phu nas rgyal tshab rin po che bsnyun gzhi lci ba'i skyabs rten 'byor/ rgyal ba'i dbang pos 'di lo khams su phebs rgyu bgol dgos pa'i bka' rgya'ang 'byor ba'i nang / snga ma dgongs 'khrol zhus pa'i rin gter dbang lung don slar bka' nan lci bas thung gis yar slebs dgos phab/ tshes 10 la ma yum gyis mchod 'bul gzab rgyas dkon spyi'i tshogs brgya btang / ma yum sras bcas kyis tshe sgrub bla glud tshogs brgya nyin kha shas bsgrubs/ bla lug brtags pa dang sha rdil tshang ma rgyal bas legs gsungs/dngos 'bul phul/ tshes 17 la yum sras rnams la khams bde zhus nas sgar bteg gnas nang du dpa' bo rin po che dang mjal 'phrad mdzad/ kar chung bar thugs sgrub chos sku'i chog dbang sogs grub nas tshes 23 la mtshur mdo'i gdan sar rgyag spos bsu ba bcas phebs/ rgyal ba'i dbang po'i gser zhal mjal bas thugs dgyes tshor gnang / rgyal tshab rin po cher bsnyun 'drir phebs/rdo rje 'chang gi sku gdung la mchod smon sngar bzhin mdzad/ tshes bcu'i 'cham 'chag gzigs/ kun dga' bde gling du nges don lags sar phebs/ dus mchod rnams rgyas pa dang ngag dbang chos grub sogs la mgon po yab rkyang yum rkyang rjes gnang sogs dbang lung ci rigs mdzad/ rgyal tshab rin po che'i zhabs brtan mchod gong du tshe sgrub bla glud nyin lnga grub/ sku rkyang la tshe gsang don dbang

kun khyab snyan pa'i ba dan/ 89phul/ dngos 'bul dang bzhes mdzad/ grwa tshang rnams la lung tshan mang tsam dang phyag chen nges don sgron me'i khrid sogs gnang / lha chen dbu rtse gzhal yas lha khang du lho brag nyi lde dgon gyi grwa drug rab byung dang / bzhi bsnyen par rdzogs/tshes 8 la tshes bcu tshogs dbur lhan rgyas phebs/ tshes 9 lhan rgyas zhing skyong gtor rgyag la phebs/ tshes bcu 'cham mjal mdzad/ gos sku chen mo/ 7rgyal ba'i dbang po'i dbu zhwa bcas mjal/ dwags po rab brtan gling pa sogs phyogs 'dus rnams la phag mo'i rnam bshad tshan gnyis sogs kyi lung / rta phyag khyung gsum sogs dbang rjes gnang mang ba mdzad/ rgyal ba'i dbang po'i bka' bzhin bsang dang gsol kha/ sgrol ma lha khang la rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sgo nas rab gnas nyin gnyis/ gzim chung rnams la'ang phyag nas 'thor/ gzim rgyal mtshan ngor dgongs 'dus btags grol sogs lung mang po dang / btsun ma kha shas la rab byung sdom pa gnang / do skya sprul skur chos 'brel gnang / rgyal dbang chen po'i bka' bzhin smin gling rdor sems byang chog nyin gcig rgyal gsol don bcu ma sogs btang / skyed tshal bsam 'grub chos gling du lhan rgyas phebs/ stod brang lha brag gi bla ma dbyings rig byang chub la byang gter phag mo zab rgya'i dbang khrid sogs mang bar gnang / mtshur phu'i rdor slob la ma mgon man ngag bka' rgya'i lung bcas grub/ zla 5 tshes 1 nas rin gter dbang lung gi sna sel rigs dang / dbang chas dpe tsag bsgrigs/ gtor bzo bcas dbu tshugs/ grwa lding po che'i gcung rin po che'ang rin gter gsan ched phebs/ de skabs tshes bcu dgongs 'dus me tog phreng mdzes btang / 'bor ba dong sprugs byang sreg dang /rje gong ma'i yig cha ltar bsnyung gnas rjes gnang sdom lung sogs dbang lung mang

90 'jam mgon kong sprul sku phreng gnyis pa'i rnam thar/du gnang / rnam gling zhwa dmar sprul sku/ rim baspyir sa rgya rgan sogs la bzhed skong / tshes 21 la bud+dhā lha ldan nas 'byor/7skyabs mgon rgyal dbang rin po che'i bka' bzhin rje nyid skyed tshal bsam 'grub chos gling du phebs/ tshes 23 nas mtshur phu'i rdor slob gdan zur rnams gtsos dpon slob nyer lngas zab bdun phur zlog 'tshogs te nyer dgur gtor rgyag dang drag sreg gnam stong la phur ba'i tshogs brgya bcas btang / rje nyid tshes 24 la dgon du yar phebs nas dus mchod dang rab byung bsnyen rdzogs mang du gnang / bud+dha khams bskyod kyi rim gror mgon phrin mi nub bstan rgyal nyin gsum/ myur mdzad mgon po'i gsol skong nyin gcig la btang / zla 6 pa'i tshes 1 nyin lha ldan nas yig bris khag dang khams nas sde btsun yig bris 'byor/ tshes 2 nyin 'brug nas mkhyen sprul yang srid phebs pa'i chibs bsur yon tan phun tshogs song / bud+dha'i rim gror tshe sgrub bla glud nyin lnga/ bud+dha dpon g.yog tshang mar tshe gsang don dbang gnang / lha khang khag tshang ma dang rdo rje 'chang gi gdung rten la mchod mjal zhus/ tshes 7 la lam bsang rgyas pa btang nas khal ma bteg tshes 10 nyin mgon khang chen mor mar me snyan shal phul te bud+dha dpon g.yog khams phyogs bteg skyabs mgon chen po dang lhan rgyas kyis 'du khang du mkhyen sprul khrir bkod/ tshes 11 nas mtshams tho bzhag ste rje gong ma'i zab gter gsang thig bla sgrub kyi bsnyen pa kha gso mtha' rgyas tshe sgrub bcas tshes 21 la grub nas mtshams tho bsdus/ 'di ga'i tho rangs byin rlabs tshan kha'i rmi ltas legs pa byung gsungs/ thun bar rnams su rgyal ba'i dbang po phebs nas rin gter zhu mi slob ma'i grangs dang tshes cha bcas bka' thag bcad/ mkhyen

kun khyab snyan pa'i ba dan/ 91sprul rin po che'i yang srid kyi ma yum dang sku mched rnams la tshe dbang / lung tshan kha shas kyi yig lan sogs grub par mdzad/ bde chos chos mgon rin po che/tshang sar sprul sku karma o rgyan rnams byon pa la sne len/ ri bkod bya bral dpon slob la bka' brgyad gsang rdzogs 'gyogs dbang bum rgya can dang / byang gter thugs chen 'gro ba kun sgrol grub thob thugs thig grub thob bka' brgyad bcas kyi dbang lung / rgyud bshad khrid bcas grub par mdzad do/ /tshes 27 nyin rgyal ba'i dbang po gtsos bla sprul bzhi bcu skor la rin gter 'bul rgyu'i dbu 'dzugs rten 'brel ched rje gong ma'i zab gter gsang thig bla sgrub dbang dang zab khrid song / de'i phyi nyin nas smin gling rdor sems dbang dang khrid rnams kyis dbu bzung / rje mkha' khyab rdo rje'i dbang zin gyi phyag bzhes ji ltar rang bzo dang sla chos su ma song bar shin tu phyag len zhib mo'i sgo nas zla 7tshes 3 la rgyud sde'i skor gyi dbang dang zab khrid rnams grub ste/ sangs rgyas bla ma'i rtsa gsum dril sgrub sogs spyi sgrub skor/ 'dod 'bum gsang 'dus zlum po bzhi dbang nas bzung tshes 21 la 'jam mgon bla ma'i tshig bdun rigs drug gu ru yan khrid bcas zhib rgyas grub nas chos mtshams mdzad/ tshes 20 nyin rgyal ba'i dbang po skyed tshal dar rgyas chos gling pho brang gsar par phebs/ rje nyid mtshur ri'i sgrub khang du phebs/ sgrub dpon la 'od chog dbang gnang / phyi nyin rgyal ba'i dbang po'i mdun zhal dro'i mjal dar phul/ nyin kha shas su ri bo che ba dang snye mo bas lha mo 'khrab pa'i gzigs phud du lhan rgyas phebs/ dus mchod dgu gsol rgyas par btang / tshes 30nas tshig bdun yab bka' nas bzung zla 9 pa'i tshes 11 nyin mchog gling gtor bsngo bla ma yi dam ma'i bka' gtad lung

92 'jam mgon kong sprul sku phreng gnyis pa'i rnam thar/bcas kyi bar dbang khrid rnams legs par grub/ tshes 12 nas bklags lung rigs snga dgong chos thun gnyis rer nyin bstar chag med dang / bar gseng rnams su phyogs mtha'i yi ge 'byor klog dang / bde chos chos mgon sogs dad 'dus rnams la 'dod chos re skong mdzad/ 7skyabs mgon rgyal ba'i dbang por phyag chen nges don rgya mtsho zhib khrid 'bul ba'i dbu tshugs/ skyabs mgon chen pos kyang dmigs thun rnams rim par nyams bzhes kyi bka' drin bskyangs/nyin nyer lnga'i khongs su phyag chen khrid rnams grub/ zla 10 tshes 15la rin gter pod thugs chen skor yan gyi bklags lung grub nas re zhig chos mtshams mdzad/de nas mchod gong rgyal tshab rin po che'i zhabs rim gshed dmar/ tshe dbang brgya brgyad/ mgron shag tu yongs dge'i pak+shi bla sgrub sogs dbang lung kha shas/mtshur bla rnams la blo sbyong khrid/ rab byung bsnyen rdzogs dang byang chub sems sdom sogs zhu mkhan mang ba'i re skong dang / dpa' bo rin po che'i sku mched rje btsun ma gshegs pa sogs tshe 'das rnams kyi don du byang sreg mu mthud mdzad/tshes 29 la gnas nang du phebs/ zhabs brtan tshe gsang dang bla glud sbrel ma nyin gsum don dbang bcas phul/ nyer lnga'i dus mchod tshe sgrub tshogs kyis 'thus par mdzad dgos byung song gsungs/ gzhan yang 'du khang du smin gling rdor sems kyi byang sreg nyer dgu'i mgon gsol rgyas pa/ sher snying bdud zlogadakon spyi'i tshogs brgya dang sun zlog sbrel ma/ nyi zlog mtshon byed bcas grub nas sku gshegs ma'i bdun tshigs la pad+ma badz+ra dang / dpal chen mo'i g.yang skyabs nyin bzhi/ dbang rjes gnang mang ba bcas gnang / tshes 12 nyin skyabs mgon dpa' bo mchog gi thugs bzhed bzhin gzim chung chos dbyings dga'

kun khyab snyan pa'i ba dan/ 93tshal du rje dpa' bo'i mthong grol dbu zhwa rje 'di'i dbur gsol zhing / rje btsun gshegs ma de nyid sogs mkha' khyab yid can rgya mtshor bsngo ba dang smon lam shin tu rgyas par mdzad pas mtshon thugs bzhed mtha' dag re zhig grub par mdzad nas mtshur phur phebs/ rgyal yab sku gshegs pa'i bdun tshigs dang po kar gling zhi khro 'du khang chen mor tshogs phebs bsngo ba yon bshad bcas mdzad/'di skabs rgyal ba'i dbang por thugs gso mtshon byed phul/ yon tan phun tshogs lha ldan du song / bdun tshigs gnyis par sgrol ma lha khang du smin gling rdor sems gsungs/ dpa' bo'i sku mched 'das ma'i rdzogs pa khel bas 'khor ba dong sprugs cho ga'ang btang / bdun tshigs gsum par gzim chung ka bzhir pad dzar/ yon tan phun tshogs yar 'byor gdong skyes gcung rnams kyi zhu yig kyang 'byor/ nyer dgur zhwa nag rnga 'cham gzigs/ gsol 'phar dang pad dzar snga dgong gtong bar mdzad/ zla 12 tshes 2 la rgyal yab gdung sbyong ba'i rgyal rgyam tshogs dbur phebs/ phyi nyin nas 'du khang du gnam chos 'od chog nyin bdun tshogs phebs gnang 'phros gsang thig rdor sems/ 'khor ba dong sprugs sogs bdun lnga ba yan rdzogs par cho ga dang byang sreg bcas rgyal ba'i dbang po'i thugs bzhed bskangs/tshes 20 nyin rgyal ba'i dbang po bcu drug par rdo rje 'chang gi bka' 'bum nas mgon pod bka' rgya skor 'bul rgyu'i ma mgon zhal sbyor dbang rdo rje spyi blugs sku rkyang la phul/ mdzod nag mgon khang gi rten gtor rdo rje 'chang gis gsar bskrun mdzad pa zhal mjal zhib mo dang gur gdan 'khor sogs dpe ris zhib mor bris/ dkar chag dpe bshu bcas pa zhib cha mdzad/ des phyis gdan sa

94 'jam mgon kong sprul sku phreng gnyis pa'i rnam thar/dpal spungs su phebs te steng gi mgon khang gi rten gtor gsar bzhengs skabs sogs su phan cha bla med byung 'dug tshes 23 la rgyal ba'i dbang po sku rkyang du ma mgon zhal sbyor dbang chen bka' rgya ma phul/ dgu chen gos 'cham rgyal ba'i dbang po dang lhan rgyas pas gzigs/ dngos gzhi nyin sku khams cung 'khrugs pas ma phebs/ gsol 'phar mtshon byed mdzad/ gnam stong nyin sku khams dwangs/ 'du khang chen mor pad dzar tshogs phebs gnang / rgyal yab kyi dgung zhag rdzogs/ lcags stag gnam lo gsar tshes skabs skyabs mgon chen po rgyal ba'i dbang po'i gzim chung sbug tu mjal dar 'bul bzhes dang / gzim chung sngags khang gi rten 'byung gral du'ang phebs/ zhal ras lha khang du bzhugs gral chen mo'i skabs gnas nang nas lo gsar mjal dar dkar spro sogs 'byor/tshes 6 nyin rgyal dbang rin po cher mgon pod bka' rgya'i bsnyen yig man ngagaskul byang le tshan/ bzhes 'bod/ man ngag gab yig bcas phul/ 'brug yongs 'dzin pas zhu yig dang tai lo pa'i rus rgyan bcas 'byor/ tshes 10 dus mchod la 'phags ma'i snying tig gi tshogs mchod btang / 'brug yongs 'dzin la yig lan/lha ldan du skyes mar mjal dar/ dpa' bo rin po cher zhu yig lo gsar mjal dar/ shing 'bras bcas phul bar mdzad/ mtshur sgar rdor slob sogs bla grwa brgyad kyis zhabs brtan tshe sgrub bla glud gsungs pas sha rgyal ba sogs rtags legs/ rje nyid kyis tshes 4 nas tho btsugs pa'i sgrol dkar bsnyen mtshams mdzad rgyun 'char can ltar tshes 15 la grol/ bar gseng 'dod chos skor zhu ba 'ga' la re skong mdzad nas tshes 19 la mtshur gdan dpon slob khri pas dbus bla grwa bcu skor gyis rin gter chos rim zab bdun phur pa'i gtor zlog nyin

kun khyab snyan pa'i ba dan/ 95bdun btang / tshes 27 nas rin gter dbang 'phros pad+ma gsung drag sgrub skor las skyer sgang rta mgrin gsang sgrub dbang nas bzung / zla 9 ba'i tshes 5 la zur mkhar phyag rdor dbang bar phul/ sku khams cung ma bde bas skyabs mgon chen po dbur bzhugs kyis rtsa gsum tshogs brgya dang brtan bzhugs/ slob tshogs spyis sgrol chog nyin gnyis/ tshes 8 nas sku khams cung dwangs pas g.yu thog snying thig gi rtsa dbang dang tshe dbang nas bzung zla 3 pa'i tshes 24 nyin khrid brgya'i pad+ma'i lam rim ngo sprad/ phyag rdzogs nor bu mthong grol khrid yan chad legs par grub ste gzims shar gling pas thugs sgrub bar chad kun sel phrin las rgyas pa bcas tshogs 'khor bsnyen bkur zhus/ zab bdun phur pa'i sgrub chen gyi 'cham chags dang / sa ga zla ba'i tshes 1 nas sgrub chen rtsa 'cham rgyal tho bcas la lhan rgyas tshogs phebs mdzad/ tshes 10 la 'cham dngos gzhi gzigs/ skyabs mgon chen po gser skyems kyi 'cham dbur phebs/ phyi nyin 'du khang chen mor rin gter mthar dge'i tshe sgrub gsang 'dus don dbang dang / rgyal tho bsdus pa/mar me smon lam bcas legs par mtha' rgyas kyis sgrub chen grol/ bka' dbang phul zin pa'i dga' ston lha mi'i gzigs phud bzhes/ phyi nyin nas spro khang du phebs/ lha mo 'gro ba bzang mo dang chos rgyal dri med kun ldan nyin gnyis 'khrab par lhan rgyas kyis gzigs/ gcung rtse mgron lags sngar nas 'dir bzhugs pa theg skyed ma lags kyis kyang snga rjes kun tu phyag bris chad med lta bur bskur ba dang lan bstsal/ tshes 16 la dngos rol btang ba'i gtor gshegs bcas grub par mdzad/ phyi nyin mgon khang chen mor bstan dgon spyi'i zhabs rim du mgon gsol mi nub bstan rgyal btang / de'i phyi nyin tshes 19 la

96 'jam mgon kong sprul sku phreng gnyis pa'i rnam thar/skyed tshal dar rgyas chos gling du phebs nas rin gter 'phros kyi 'bru lung dang phyag khrid 'phros rnams phul/ zla 6 pa'i tshes 14 nyin rin gter lung yongs rdzogs dang phyag khrid legs par grub/ dga' ston du tshe gsang tshogs 'khor zab rgyas/ mthar dge tshe gsang don dbang bcas phul grub/ rgyal ba'i dbang pos gtang rag gi maṇ+ḍal dang gsol ras rgya che ba/ slob ma so sos yon 'bul bcas phul/ grwa mang gis lhan rgyas la zhabs brtan maṇ+ḍal mjal dar bcas phul bar mdzad do/ /rgyal bstan yongs rdzogs mdzod lngar 'dus pa'i chos/ /thugs chub kho nas yon tan rgya mtsho dang / /mnyam pa min yang 'chad dang spel ba yi/ /phrin las rgya cher skong ba 'dis kyang ngo / /'di skabs gcung blo bzang snyan grags phebs/ sems bskyed dang yan lag brgyad pa'i sdom dbang lung khrid sogs zhu mkhan mang ba so so'i re skong mdzad/'ga' zhig la rin gter dbang chad rigs rnams kyang gnang bar mdzad/ tshes 28la gnas nang du phebs/ skyabs mgon dpa' bo dang mjal 'phrad thog bla brang gong mar bzhugs/ 29la gsol 'phar btang / phyi nyin lha ldan ra lcang du phebs/ma yum sku mched lhan rgyas re zhig dal bzhugs mdzad/ ra shag sa dbang thugs bzhed nyang gi sku lnga'i srog gtad dang thang lha'i bka' gtad mdzad/ bya rigs gzim shag tu phebs/ skyabs mgon 'brug chen rin po che dang mjal 'phrad mdzad/ sger rgya mkhar nang pa sogs dang 'brug pa bcu skor la 'ja' tshon ngan

kun khyab snyan pa'i ba dan/ 97song rang grol sogs kyi dbang lung 'ga' re gnang / stag sna'i grwa la phyag khrid nges don sgron me sogs zhu mkhan mang ba'i re skong mdzad/ ra che'i jo khang la zhabs bskor bsags/ rgya ston sprul sku/ rim bzhi ru thog 'bras ljongs btsun mo dang 'bang nyag a ting sras/ phyi gling pa sa heb sogs mjal mi mang yar mar tshes bcu/ nyer dgu'i gsol 'phar rnams rgyas par mdzad/zla tshes 8 la khams nas phyir gdan 'dren gyi bsu mar bla ma zla 'od sogs mtshur phur 'byor pas tshes 9 la yon tan phun tshogs der song / ra lcang shag tu dpal chen mo'i g.yang skyabs kha gso nyin gsum gsungs/ khams nas 'ongs pa'i bsu ma rnams dang yon phun bcas tshes 20 la lha ldan du 'byor/ zla 9 pa'i tshes 10 nyin chos sgar lha sa nas bteg gnas nang du dpa' bo rin po che dang mtshur gdan spro khang du rgyal ba'i dbang po bcas la mjal 'phrad mdzad/ rdo rje 'chang gi gdung rten mdun mchod 'bul gsol smon sngon rgyun bzhin mdzad nas tshes 17 la gnas bskor du dpon 'khor mdor bsdus phebs/ yon tan phun tshogs rgya gar du 'gro rgyu mdzad/ kar khang nas rim phebs kyis dbu ri 'bum par rgyal ba lo ras pa'i sku gdung mdun gsol smon btab cing zhu lcags khom gzhis ka'i bsu ma bcas phebs/ lcam sring sras mo nges don lags kyis mjal/be+e ro'i sgrub phug la mchod mjal dang a ne'i dgon gyi 'du khang du rab gnas mdzad/ mchod gong ma ṇi gzhis ka sogs nas rim phebs lcang ra dgon zhes pa'i lha khang la khrus gsol rab gnas mdzad/ lam zhor rgyal tshab rin po che'i bzhugs sgar du'ang 'khrug tsam phebs nas g.yu lung dgon du spos rgyags bsu ba bcas phebs/ phyi nyin nyer lnga'i dus mchod khel ba dang sde spyi'i 'dod skong sogs

98 'jam mgon kong sprul sku phreng gnyis pa'i rnam thar/tshugs chags kyis gsang thig bla sgrub tshogs dang dgra chos btang / khrom dbang gnang / g.yu lung sprul skus skyel ma bcas byon lam rgyal yum mkha' 'gro chen mo mjal/ nges legs nyer mkho be'u bum gyi lung gnang / rim bteg gis lam gseng zhar byung jo mo gangs dkar sogs la ri khrus mdzad/ ma ra la zhes pa brgal nas gu ru'i sgrub gnas ma ra ti ka'i phug par grags pa'i zhol du bzhugs/g.yog grwa rnams mjal du btang / tshe chu ngo mtshar can 'dug pa blangs/ rim par 'o yul rdza rar phebs/ sgrub phug tu lce btsun snying tig tshogs mchod dang / mchod 'bul gzab rgyas/ sgrol chog nyer dgu'i gsol 'phar bcas btsun ma rnams la chos 'brel gnang / rje 'bangs nyer lnga'i gras 'o bran dpal gyi dbang phyug gi gdung rgyud du grags pa 'o bran nang pas gdan drangs par phebs/ mi ngo rnams la rta phyag khyung gsum dbang dang dkon spyi'i tshogs brgya/ gzhan yang so so'i bzhed skong mdzad/ 'o bran gyi thugs dam rten gnubs kyi phyag bzor grags pa lha mo'i sku nang rten gnam lcags kyi rdor phur dang tsan+dan phur pa bcas mjal rim par bteg ste 'o yul gos sngon lha khang gi thog rol ser phreng bcas phebs/ gtsug lag khang gi yang rtser bzhugs/ bla grwa kun gyis mjal dar phul/ dgon gyi bla grwa rnams kyi zhus ngor smin gling gshin rje dregs 'joms kyi cho ga zab rgyas tshogs brgya dang smin dbang bskur bar mdzad/ bla ma rgyang 'bod/ sngags srung phrin las sogs lung mang ba dang rat+na'i dam can gsol mchod rgyas par gnang / lar 'o yul phyogs bzhugs ring dam can gsol 'phar mdzad/ rten rnams la mchod mjal/ dge 'dun rnams la mang ja phyag 'gyed bstsal/ dngos 'bul byung / dam can brag nas bla rdo blang bar mdzad nas phebs/ stag rtse 'dod gling zhus ngor

kun khyab snyan pa'i ba dan/ 99dkon spyi'i tshogs stong tshogs/ gnyen po gsum dbang / bla ma rgyang 'bod lung sogs 'dod chos zhu mkhan so so'i re skong mdzad/ lam 'khod rnams la phrin las rim skyong gis snang dkar gzhis su phebs/ ches 10 la dus mchod dkon spyi'i tshogs btang / rgyal ba'i dbang po'i bang mi ched bstsal dang skyes gcung rnam pa yon phun bcas pa'i yi ge rnams 'byor/ 'khor ba dong sprugs kyi byang sreg dang / sgar sde'i 'brog pa kha shas la tshe dbang / gzhis gnyer mi ngo rnams la gnyen po lha gsum gyi dbang sogs 'dod skong grub nas rim par 'brug ra lung du phebs/rol bsu sogs sne len byung / rten gsum rnams la mchod mjal/ gtsang pa rgya ras pa'i 'dra zhal khams gsum zil non mdun mchod 'bul/ dkon spyi'i tshogs gnang / der 'bod kun la mang ja phyag 'gyed bstsal/ rgyang rtser phebs nas snang dkar grwa shag tu bzhugs/ grwa tshang nas gsol ja dang ston mo phul/ bkras bder gdan drangs ltar phebs/ nyer dgu'i gsol 'phar btang / rje 'jam mgon bla ma gong ma'i zhal slob bla ma nyi 'od rin po ches dngos 'bul sna tshogs phul/ dkon spyi'i tshogs stong mar me stong phul/ bkras bde'i mi ngo rnams la thang rgyal tshe dbang dang byang gter le'u bdun ma'i lung gnang / lam bar gtsang sde'i ngor dkon spyi'i tshogs brgya dang tshe dbang grub rgyal ma gnang / der 'bod sogs la chos 'brel dang bcas snang dkar gzhis su phebs/ sgos gzhis kyis zhus ngor tshes bcur gsang thig bla sgrub dang 'brel ba'i tshogs mchod stong phrag gzhi gter nyi ma dgra 'dul sogs la 'gro don mkha' khyab/ bde smon lung / sger kha rta ra'i sar gnyen po lha gsum dang thugs rje chen po'i dbang tshe dbang bcas gnang / mtshams pa bla rgan zhig gis maṇ+ḍal rte/gas 'bul mdzad/

100 'jam mgon kong sprul sku phreng gnyis pa'i rnam thar/lha ldan nas skyes gcung rnams kyis 'phral phebs zhu yig glog phrin 'byor/snang dkar gzhis ka'i mi ser sde spyir gsol ras dngul rdil bcu gnang nas phebs lam pad sde nas gcung rtse mgron gyi kha par glog phrin 'byor/ rgyal rtse nas bteg ra lung dgon gyi grwa shag tu bzhugs skabs/ smad nas rgya mi gung khran tang gi gsar brje'i bcings bkrol dmag dpung 'byor ba'i dus zing gis 7gong sa skyabs mgon bcu bzhi pa chen po mchog rgya gar du phebs rtsis sku bcar zhabs gras gcung blo snyan dang mjal 'phrad mdzad/ dpon g.yog tshang mar slob ston zhib rgyas thog rim gyis phebs/ gam pa la brgal lcags zam gru brgyud zla 11tshes 23 nyin lha ldan du phebs/ yum sras lhan rgyas zhal 'dzoms/ 'di skabs mdo smad sa dbang nga phod ngag dbang 'jigs med sogs gzhung gi sku drag las sne khag ma nyung tsam rgya nag pe cing du byon/ ma'o kru zhi gtsos krung go gung khran tang gi krung dbyang u yon hus dang gros mol thog bod ljongs zhobs 'ching 'grol 'byung thabs kyi chings yig bris pa sogs re zhig bde 'jags grub pas/ 7gong sa skyabs mgon chen po'ang rgya gar du chibs bsgyur gnang ma dgos par pho brang po ta lar zhabs pad 'khod pa'i skal bzang byung ngo / rta drel rnams mtshur phur yar btang / rgyal ba'i dbang po dang dpa' bo sogs kyi sku mdun la zhu yig phul/dbu mdzad sogs lho gnas bskor bar btang / hor sbub sbus legs dang / khyad par thub dbang sku rgya gar nub li phyag tu 'byor/ rgyal ba'i dbang po sogs kyis bka' rgya phab/ rim bzhi ru thog la thang rgyal tshe dbang / phyogs 'dus bla grwa 'ga' la tshe gsang dbang chen/ skyes gcung rnam par tshe dbang dang sgrol chog sogs mu mthud/ dus mchod rnams rgyas par mdzad/ khams nas rdzong sar mkhyen brtse rin

kun khyab snyan pa'i ba dan/ 101po che'i phyag bris 'byor/ skyabs mgon rgyal dbang rin po cher lo gsar mjal dar dang rten gsum dod bcas phyag bris phul/ nyer dgu'i dus mchod du gsar ma'i gzhung rgyas pa gtong bar mdzad do/ /lcags yos gnam mas gsar tshes la yum sras lhan rgyas rten 'byung dga' ston dang / 'brug pa kha shas la sne len/ bdud 'joms sras la tshe dbang / stod pa kha shas la gnam chos 'od dpag dbang dang dkon spyi'i rdzogs khrid khams gsum yongs grol gnang / yon tan phun tshogs rgya gar nas rgyal rtser slebs pa'i kha par 'byor/ mi ring bar gnas ra dge legs 'byor gdong rgya gar ca ga rgyab kha shas sngon du 'byor/ dbu mdzad dang gnyer pa sogs 'byor gdong rgyal ba'i dbang po'i bka' rgya dang gnam lo gsar tshes kyi mjal dar maṇ+ḍal rten gsum gsol ja bzhes 'bras kyi dod sogs dang / thugs sras byams pa rin po che'i gsung bris mjal dar rnams 'byor/ ra lcang gzim shag gi g.yang skyabs kha gso nyin gsum skabs yon tan phun tshogs rgya gar nas mgo thon gang legs kyis 'byor/ 'bras ljongs nas yig bris 'ga' 'dug rgya yi sras sku zhabs sogs la gar gling bar do drug khrid/ rgyal po lugs kyi thugs chen khrid sogs dbang lung mang po zhig gnang / 'brong dpon bla ma gshegs pa'i thugs dam ngo sprod mdzad/ smon lam gtor rgyag sogs la'ang gzigs/ 'brong dpon bla rgan sogs gshon khag mang por rdor sems nyin bdun tsam gnang / snga dgong dus mchod rnams ma chag par mdzad/ jo mjal mdzad nas sgar bteg gnas nang du dpa' bo rin po che dang mjal 'phrad mdzad/ chos gling phur par 'brel ba'i sri mnan 'don dgos phab pa bzhin zla 2 tshes 3 nas dbu bzung / sri mnan/

102 'jam mgon kong sprul sku phreng gnyis pa'i rnam thar/gtor rgyag rgyal dbyangs sogs mtha' rgyas nyin bdun gsungs/ tshes 11 nas rat+na'i tshe gsang dang bla glud sbrel ma btang ste tshes 15 snga char grub par mdzad/yon 'bul rgyas pa 'bul gnang dang len mdzad/ dpa' bo rin po cher gzim chung gsar pas zhal dro phul/ mgon khang nyams gso gnang rgyu'i ar gha'i cho ga bsdus pa btang nas mtshur phur phebs/ rgyal dbang rin po che'i gser zhal mjal/ 'dir yang mgon khang nyams gso'i ar gha'i cho ga thugs sras rin po che'i rkyen sel dbang bka'/ tshong dpon kar tshul nad babs lci ba'i rim gro tshe sgrub bla glud btang / mjal mkhan mang bas thugs brel je che la thugs dam mgon khang chen mor yang bskyar rten rnams sgul skyod dgos gshis ar+gha'i cho ga shin tu rgyas pa dngos sta sbrel ma mdzad/ tshong dpon kar tshul la tshe dbang dang /rgyal ba'i dbang po'i zhabs brtan rata phur gtor zlog dbal mdos zor thabs su gtong tshes 23 la dbu tshugs/ 29ra gtor rgyag dang gnam stong phur pa'i tshogs brgya btang nas grub/ thugs sras rin po ches mang ja phyag 'gyed phul zhing rje 'di dbu bzhugs kyis thugs sras sku rim tshe gsang bla glud sbrel ma dang / nyin gung tshogs bar du skyabs mgon chen po rgyal ba'i dbang por nā ro chos drug bdud rtsi nying khu steng nas zhib khrid phul/ zla ba 3 pa'i tshes 3 la dbu btsugs/tshes 5 la bla glud btang / tshe rdzas phul cing tshe sgrub grol nas zab mdo bdud zlog btang / tshes 7 nas rgyal ba'i dbang po'i zhabs brtan rat+na gling tshe gsang bla glud sbrel ma tshes 14 bar btang / sha rdil lan dang por rgyal ba dang / bla lug lan gnyis par 'a31ra lugs shin tu legs gsungs/ rgyal mchog mdun tshe rdzas sogs phul/ tshes drug chos thun re re nyin ltar phul nas bar mtshams su/

kun khyab snyan pa'i ba dan/ 103mchod gong rgyal tshab rin po cher rta phyag khyung gsum dbang dang / bla grwa gsum la kai tshang rdo rje rnal 'byor ma lha lnga'i dbang chen/ 'brug pad+ma rnam rgyal sogs la bskyed rdzogs gnad bsdus gsung mgur thor bu'i lung sogs mang du gnang /tshong dpon rda kar tshur 'chi ba'i 'pho 'debs/ gson gshin cho ga thugs sras rin po cher rkyen sel dbang rjes gnang sogs dang / yab rje rgyal ba'i dbang po'i dus mchod bla sgrub bde chen grub pa'i thig le dang 'brel bka' brgyud mgur mtshor tshogs mchod rgyas par mdzad/ zur ri drung pa rke rong zla 'phel ma yum 'das par smin gling rdor sems nyin chog dang 'pho 'debs mdzad/ tshes bcu'i 'cham chag mjal/ lho sgo'i grong nang nor bu sar gnam chos 'od chog dang dus mchod gsol 'phar btang / phyag mdzod dam chos yongs 'du'i shag tu phebs/pak+shi bla sgrub dang ma mgon zhal sbyor gtor dbang bskur/ thugs sras rin po cher gcod thun gnang / gzhan dgon gyi bla grwa kha shas la thun bzhi'i lung sogs gsungs/ zla 4 tshes 2 nyin yon tan phun tshogs ma yum phebs bsur thegamagon khang chen mo'i gser phru ja thug rnams la khrus chog zla ba'i bdud rtsi'i sgo nas sbyong 'khru rab gnas/ thugs sgrub bar chad kun sel phrin las btang / byin 'bebs sogs nan tan mdzad/ tshes 5 nyin skyabs mgon rgyal dbang rin po che'i zhabs brtan sher snying bdud zlog gsungs/ gson gshin 'ga' rer 'pho 'debs byang sreg tshe dbang sogs mdzad/ zhing skyong gtor zlog 'tshogs la'ang phebs/ tshes 8nyin 'du khang chen mor rgyal ba'i dbang po dang lhan cig dur khrod gsang mchog 'tshogs thengs gcig la phebs/ 'dus tshogs rnams la mang ja dang phyag 'gyed gnang / zhing skyong gtor rgyag la'ang lhan rgyas phebs/ tshes bcu'i

104 'jam mgon kong sprul sku phreng gnyis pa'i rnam thar/'cham gzigs/ rgyal dbang rin po che'i dbu zhwa dang gos sku'i zhal mjal mdzad/tshes 15 nyin ma yum lags kyis rgyal dbang rdo rje 'chang gi sku gdung la mchod 'bul mdzad pa'i tshogs dbur phebs/ bla sgrub bde chen grub thig tshogs mchod bcas btang / sru mo kar chos 'das pa'i 'pho 'debs byang sreg sogs mdzad /'di skabs khams nas byams mgon si tu rin po che yi phyag bris dang yang khrod nas bud+dha'i yi ge 'byor gdong yon tan phun tshogs kyi pha rgan grongs 'dugam yum gyis sku rdzong phul/ gcung rnams bcas bteg yon phun phebs skyel du song / nor bu'i bu sprul 'das pa'i byang sreg dang gsol rab sgrub la gsang thig rdor sems dbang sogs 'dod chos re ba skong bar mdzad/ tshes 22 nas rgyal ba'i dbang por nā ro'i lus sbyong las rlung skyon sel ba nas bzung rim par slob ston phul/ yon phun pha shi ba'i byang sreg ngag phrin sprul skur zhabs brtan smon tshig mgul srung sogs gnang / rgyal ba'i dbang po gtsos mtshur phu'i bla grwa tshang mas bka' brgyud sngags mdzod dbang lung gnang dgos nan tan zhus kyang skabs su ma babs par dgongs te dgongs zhu mtha' skyel dang / slad nas kyang gdan sa chen por phebs rgyu'i rten 'brel 'phro can du bzhag gsungs/ lus spyod phul grub pa'i gtang rag tu rgyal ba'i dbang pos yab rje rdo rje 'chang gi phyag bsnams sman thod gnang / dge mtshan che zhing spro ba rgyas byung gsungs/ thugs dam lha khang gi rten gsum spo skya la zhabs zhu/ tshes 29 dus mchod mgon phrin mi nub bstan rgyal rgyal ba'i dbang po dang lhan rgyas pas gtong bar mdzad/ gcung thugs sras bsnyun babs je lcir gyur stabs 'du khang chen mor stong mchod dang 'brel 'ja' tshon lhung bshags cho ga btang bar rgyal ba'i dbang po dang lhan rgyas

kun khyab snyan pa'i ba dan/ 105'tshogs dbur phebs// dil yag sgrub dpon bstan 'dzin mdun nas zhwa dmar mkha' spyod dbang po'i chos drug chen mo'i lung gsan/ rdor slob la phyag chen gang gā ma'i lung dang / slob dpon khri par nā ro chos drug khrid sogs mdzad/ mgon khang chen mor phag mo'i sgo nas rab gnas rgyas pa bkra shis char 'bebs dngos sta nyin gnyis lhan rgyas kyis mdzad/ zur ri zla sprul ma yum dgung rdzogs khel ba'i byang sreg dang nor bu'i bu sprul 'das pa'i gdung bsreg cho ga bsgrubs/ rab byung bsnyen rdzogs zhu mkhan sogs mang / bye ma reg grol dang 'pho rdzas mchog gling ngan song dong sprugs pad 'byung ltar nyin gsum bsgrubs/ thugs sras rin po cher gnam chos 'od chog dbang tshar grangs/ 'du khang du pad+ma badz+ra nyin 'tshogs 'phar ma'i dbur lhan rgyas phebs/ thugs sras mchog gis rgyal mchog gong mas bsgrubs pa'i ma mgon srog 'khor byin ldan phul/ skyabs mgon rgyal dbang rin po che skyed tshal dar gling du phebs te lhan 'dzoms gnang / gcung thugs sras bsnyun bab je lod las med stabs gnam chos sman bla'i dbang brgya/gshed dmar rjes gnang / smin gling rdor sems cho ga bdun dbang byang sreg kar gling zhi khro gtor dbang bcas nyin kha shas grub mtshams zla 6 tshes 7 la sku gshegs/ nges par ngo 'phrod rtags dang thugs dam legs por bzhugs song 'dug de skabs mtshur gdan rdor slob khri ba gdan zur sogs bla grwa rnams kyis rje 'jam mgon bla ma 'di nyid kyi zhabs brtan tshe gsang bla glud nyin bdun sgrub song / zhag gsum/ mtshams gcung thugs sras rin po che thugs dam grol rtags gdung la dbu skra lud pa sogs byung / gdung bkrus nas longs sku'i chas 'jug gdung mchod bcas sngar rgyun zhi khro'i cho ga la sbyar/ zla 6 tshes 11 tho rangs nas

106 'jam mgon kong sprul sku phreng gnyis pa'i rnam thar/rje nyid dbur bzhugs kyis smin rdor bdag mdun bum sgrub/ bdag 'jug dang sku pur la gnas lung gi cho ga bcas nam langs chu tshod yos steng rol bsu ser phreng gis gdan drangs/ rje 'di nyid dpon slob rnams kyis rdor sems/ gdan sa chen po'i slob dpon sogs kyis kun rigs/ rgyal rgyam/ 'od dpag bcas cho ga khag bzhis sreg sbyong zhus/ dud bkra dang gnam gshis legs shing skad cig gis me bzhes pa sogs legs pa'i mtshan mar snang gsungs/ phyi nyin nas bzung rdor sems sngar bzhin nyin bdun gsungs/ skabs su rgyal dbang rin po ches gnang sbyin legs skyes spam mtho gnang / gzhan mang por 'dod chos skor thugasare rim skong mdzad/tshes 15 nyin rgyal ba'i dbang po dang lhan rgyas pas dbyar bsang btang / slob dpon khri par chos drug khrid thun re gnang / sgar mdzod bu lags phebs nas slar gdan sar gang mgyogs phebs dgos tshul sogs zhus song / tshes 23 nyin mtshur gdan dbu chos grwa mang rnams kyis mjal dar rdzong ba phul/ thugs sras rin po che'i dgung zhag ched pad+ma badz+ra dbu tshugs nas nyin bdun bar gsungs/mtshams rnams su rgyal dbang rin po cher sku gsung thugs rten gtsos skyabs rten phul/ mgon khang du gsol 'phar/ mchod gong bla brang pas phebs rdzong / stag sna bla brang pa'i gnyer pa ched bskyod kyis phebs rdzong / kun dga' bde gling du lcam sring dbyangs can dang mdzod nges can bcas par tshe dbang / lde 'chang bstan rgyas la rta phyag khyung gsum dbang sogs mchog phal mang po'i re skong grub nas zla 7pa'i tshes 9 la dpon 'khor stabs bdes phebs/ skyabs mgon che dang lhan du 'dzoms/ mkhyen sprul 'brug nas phebs pa der bzhugs dang yang mjal/ dpa'
