kun khyab snyan pa'i ba dan/ 107bo rin po cher grub rgyal tshe dbang dang sems don skor zhal 'phros zhu 'bul zhib par mdzad/ lhan rgyas gling khar lhan rgyas thugs spro dang / rje 'dis dpa' bo rin po cher skyabs rten khams bde zhu rten bcas phul/ rje dpa' bo'i thugs bzhed bzhin khrus chog zla ba'i bdud rtsi'i rab gnas gzim chung 'du khang sogs phyi nang kun tu 'thor bar mdzad/ sku rdzong dang skyel ma bcas tshes 8 la mtshur phur phebs/ ri khrod pad ma khyung rdzong / skyid phug dbang phyug phug spyi khang rnams su mkha' 'gro chen mo dang sprul sku o rgyan sogs rang rang bzhed skong / sgrub grwar chos 'brel bcas grub/ 'di skabs nas bzung gcung thugs sras zhi bar gshegs pa'i dgung zhag ma rdzogs bar 'khor ba dong sprugs sogs byang chog ma chad par mdzad/ gzhan yang gcung zhi gshegs gdung rten gzungs 'bul dang sku 'dra mang por gzungs gzhug kai tshang bde mchog lha lnga'i bdag bskyed sngon du 'gro bas rab gnas cho ga rnam dag dgongs gsal bde mchog tshogs bcas dang / 'di skabs sngon zla 6 pa'i tshes 27 la skyabs mgon 7rgyal dbang rin po che gong sa chen po gro mo nas chibs bsgyur gnang ba'i mjal 'phrad du phebs par mdzad sgo lam legs kyis mtshur gdan du zhabs 'khod pa'i sku bcar mdzad/tshes 15 nyin gling kha bsam 'grub chos gling du bsang dgra bla lam lha bcas dang /dgon du lha khang khag la mar me snyan shal/ rdo rje 'chang gi sku gdung mdun mchod 'bul thugs smon rgya cher gnang / skyed tshal dar gling du rgyal ba'i dbang po'i gser zhal mjal/ lhan rgyas thugs spro nyin gnyis btang / de skabs rje 'dis zhal nas rgyal ba'i dbang por gang dran slob ston zhus pas thugs mnyes tshor cher gnang zhes dang / rgyal mchog chen por mjal dar dang rten 'byung dge ba'i rdzas

108 'jam mgon kong sprul sku phreng gnyis pa'i rnam thar/su dung dkar g.yas 'khyil zhig phul zhes gsungs/ de nas dgon du phebs te mgon khang chen mor gser skyems snyan dar bcas phul bar mdzad/khams phyogs su phyir phebs pa/mtshur mdo'i gdan sa chen po nas zla 7 tshes 19 nyin rta thabs skyel ma dar g.yug chibs bskor dang / mtshur mdzod nas gong mo chu mig tu tsha phog brgyab cing brag nag gzhung bar skyel ma zhus/ kar thang grwa gsum kyis bsu ma sogs lam bkra rten 'byung spyir legs/ mtshur phyag nas mjal dar btang / kar khang bkra shis yar rgya gtsos mi tshang bcu skor gyi 'dod skong / lam khel gdan 'dren pa rnam par ngo ma ldog tsam du dpon slob nyung shas phebs/ sgar gzhis mang ma dang sil kho chu khar bsdad nas rim par dga' lo dgon du rol bsu ngang phebs/btsun ma rnams la bla sgrub bde thig dbang dang / ma mgon gtor dbang / gtsug lag phyi nang kun la rab gnas/ gzhan dad sbyin mang po'i re ba skong bzhin ski chu zhal ngo sba khar sgar babs nyin gcung thugs sras rin po che'i dgung zhag rdzogs pas sgar gyi bla grwa zhib bsdus kyis 'khor ba dong sprugs cho ga byang sreg mchod 'bul mang ja phyag 'gyed bcas zab rgyas mdzad/ tshes 28 la 'dam chu brgal nas rgya rgan mdo/ bkra shis dbu ma thang sogs su rim phebs skabs dus mchod gsol 'phar dang / tshes 30 nyin mkhyen sprul tshang gis sku chas zla thog btang rigs sgug zhor nyi 'dzin yod gshis mchod 'bul gzab spros thog thugs dam rigs gsungs/ zla 8 tshes 1 nas 'dam lcog rtse la dang 'du nag chu bo brgal

kun khyab snyan pa'i ba dan/ 109nas rim par phebs/ nag chu 'khor chen du sgar par byang spyi ras rgya rgan gyis gdan 'dren ltar thugs bzhed skong ba sogs lam 'khod rnams kyi re skong / rang gzhan sku 'khor rnams kyi rkyen sel sogs mdzad mur shag karma sku 'bum du thugs bskyed sgom lung sogs dang / nag shod sog ru a 'jig sogs la zhi khro'i gto ra dbang / ri khrod pa kha shas la dkon spyi'i lung dang gcod kyi tshogs las lung /sog ru a 'jig gis gsar bskrun ri khrod theg mchog rnam grol gling gi grwa gnyis la rab bsnyen dang btsun ma bdun la dge bsnyen sdom pa gnang / ri khrod yun gnas kyis phyag bris dang o rgyan gser sku gnang / nag shod dbon rgan sogs la 'gro don mkha' khyab ma'i sgom lung / mchog gling thugs chen 'gro 'dul dbang lung / 'pho lung / sems khrid bcas mdzad/ 'di skor gshin po mang po'i bsngo zhu la 'khor ba dong sprugs byang sreg skyabs rten 'bul mi mang por sgrol chog gsungs/ 'di skabs phyag lir tho rangs zhig rmi ltas legs pa byung zhes dang / gangs che tsam babs pa'ang legs pa'i mtshan mar mngon zhes bris 'dugade rnams la nyin mang du tshugs chags gnang nas chos sgar rim par btegade nas gdong chu shag chu sogs brgal te tshes 29 la 'dam chu brgal zin nas mgon gsol rgyas pa btang / zla 9 tshes 1 la 'brong stod dpon tshang ru sgar du phebs/ 'dam gzhung rdo ring chu brgyud nas khal pa sngon btang dang 'dzoms/'brong dpon gyis dar gtong byung / 'brong stod dpon tshang sar khrus dang rab gnas mdzad/ mtshur sgar bla brang khal skyel dpon g.yog rnams la lam chas gsol ras sba dar g.yogs nas yar btang / 'di skabs bcings bkrol rgya dmag thog mar gzigs nas rim par sgar bteg sgis sprul dang sprul sku dmar

110 'jam mgon kong sprul sku phreng gnyis pa'i rnam thar/dmar 'das pa'i sras sogs la chos 'brel tshe dbang so so'i 'dod skong / ag na mo cher zur ri sprul sku ched bskyod kyis mjal/ zur dgon du gdan 'dren zhus nas sngon la theg bye ma la sogs rim brgal gyis sgis sna dgon du phebs/dgon pas dar gtong dang dgon du rol bsu ngang phebs/ sprul sku gnyis kyi gtsug phud bzhes shing mtshan btags/ grub rgyal tshe dbang gnang ba dang gzhan mang por re skong mdzad/ 'di skabs dpal spungs klu dil bang mi 'byor te dpal spungs phyogs kyi gnas tshul zhib par gsan/ tshes 15 la gshin khag mang por zhi khro'i cho gas byang ba bsregs shing zhar byung khrom la gtor dbang sogs grub/zur dgon sprul chung bla grwa rta drel bsu ma bcas 'byor/ sgis sna nas bteg wa rad la brgyud zla chu'i rabs brgal nas thabs bsu ser phreng rol bsu 'byor/'du khang du maṇ+ḍal gsol ston zhus/ khrom 'tshogs mang bar thugs chen dbang dang dgon spyir g.yang chog sgrub khang du bla sprul sogs la tshig bdun bla sgrub dril sgrub kyi dbang / phyag chen nges don sgron me'i khrid/ dge tshul slong lnga bcu nga grangs bla sprul grwa tshang la rgya chen spyod rgyud lugs kyi byang sdom/ gtsug lag sogs la rab gnas dang khrom dbang bcas mdzad/ dngos 'bul rgya cher bstabs/ nyin gsum bzhugs nas bla sprul yul mi'i skyel ma bcas slar sgis snar sgar mang mar phebs/ ri pa khag nas dar gtong dang gdan 'dren pa slebs pas phebs rgyu mdzad/ mkhyen sprul sgar sngon du bteg zur dgon bla sprul rnams la srung byin mgul dar sogs gnang nas phyir theg rje nyid lci chu brgal nas ri stod sprul sku gnyis sogs rta thabs rol bsus dgon du phebs/ 'du khang du maṇ+ḍal dang gsol ston zhus/ mtshams pa zhig 'das 'dug par 'pho lung / 'du khang du

kun khyab snyan pa'i ba dan/ 111g.yang chog lha khang du phyag nas/ khrom dbang bcas grub/ rta skyel thog phebs/ ri ba bar ma'i dgon du rta thabs rol bsu 'du khang du maṇ+ḍal sogs dang / gter gsar sgrol ma 'jigs pa kun skyob kyi maṇ+ḍal bzhi chog bkra shis char 'bebs/nyer lnga'i dus mchod gsang thig yum bka'i tshogs/ zab tig sgrol chog tshar grangs/ dpal chen mo'i g.yang chog sgrub khang du rdo rje 'chang thung ma'i khrid/ lha khang mgon khang rnams la phyag nas khrom dbang bcas grub/ 'di skabs 'brong dpon nas 'bul ba byung / ri ba bar mas chibs skyel dang / ri smad pas rta thabs ser phreng rol bsu bcas phebs/ sgrub khang du nā ro chos drug las gtum mo zhib khrid dang / rje gong ma'i zhal gdams sogs lung tshan mang ba/ 'du khang du gtor bsngos phyag nas 'thor bar mdzad/ skyel ma mnyam lci chu brgal nas yug la chen khar dgu gsol 'phar ma btang ste rim par phebs/ sbam phyag sum mdo'i chos khrir dil yag dgon gyi chos khrims pa dar gtong dang gdan 'dren du 'byor/ dgon du sa bcu sprul sku sogs kyis rta thabs rol bsus phebs grub nas bla grwa skya ser tshang mar pad gling tshe sgrub rdo rje phreng ba'i dbang gnang / phyi nang kun la phyag nas/ sgrub khang du phyag khrid sogs 'dod skong mdzad/yang khrod nas bsu ma sngon ma rnams 'byor/ lam zhor bla chab dgon gyi gnyer pa/ rab 'byor dgon pa'i 'bul sne sogs la rang rang bzhed skong / sbyin bdag khag mang por phrin las gang 'os khrom dbang sogs mdzad nas skyo brag dgon du rta thabs rol bsus phebs/ zla 10 tshes 8 la sgrol dkar zla ba 'dod 'jo'i bdag mdun bum sgrub sngon du 'gro bas dung dkar sprul pa'i skur bkru byab srung gsum mdzad de gtsug phud bzhes/ mtshan btags nas rjes gnang khrir 'god

112 'jam mgon kong sprul sku phreng gnyis pa'i rnam thar/mnga' 'bul shis brjod sogs gzab rgyas mdzad/ dgon der dge tshul zhe brgyad/ bsnyen rdzogs nyer gcig bcas bsgrubs/ zla chu pha khar dbyis chos 'bum par 'bor ba dong sprugs byang sreg yang tshur phebs nas dgon du thang rgyal tshe dbang / g.yang chog rdor sems byang chog mdzad/ de bar phyogs 'dus bsnyen rdzogs bcu bzhi bsgrubs/ khrom dbang grub nas skyo brag bla sprul rnams kyis phebs skyel ngang lam khel dad sbyin rnams kyi yid tshim par mdzad/ 'di skabs tshes bcu'i dus mchod gu ru bdud 'dul rgyal po'i tshogs mchod mdzad song /thas khe tshang sar dpal chen g.yang chog sogs grub ste go che dgon pas rta thabs rol bsu ngang phebs/ dpal chen g.yang chog dang grwa bco lngar dge tshul/ btsun ma gcig la sdom pa gnang / dad dgon sprul sku dang khra 'od gnas dgon sprul sku bcas byon te bzhed skong mdzad/ go che dgon pa'i bla sprul rnams kyis rta thabs phebs skyel gyis rim par zur mang rnam rgyal rtser gar dbang mchog sprul rin po che gtsos bla sprul grwa tshang rnams kyis rta bsu thog rol bcas sgo dmar khang du dar btang maṇ+ḍal bshad pa gsol ston sogs gzab rgyas thog dpar khang du bzhugs/ gar dbang sprul pa'i sku dang zhal 'phros dal bzhugs nyin gcig mdzad/ rin gter dbang lung dgos zhes nan tan mdzad par mgon khang du lhan rgyas dbur bzhugs kyis gsol 'phar dang brtag bsgril mdzad song bar bar chad med ces babs pas dbang lung mdzad rgyu thag chod nas phyi lo yar phebs rgyu dang / 'brug sprul bla brang / bkra shis lha khang / bslab grwa khang / yos gshis dbu pha tshang gi grwa shag bcas so so'i bzhed skong rigs grub/ rdo dgon chos khrims dar gtong du 'byor/ tshes 18 la gar dbang sogs la tshe dbang gnang ste chos

kun khyab snyan pa'i ba dan/ 113sgar bteg chos gling rdo dgon ja zhus dang ras sprul bcas byung / rim par bdud rtsi dil du rta rol bsu ma bcas phebs/ bla brang drung pa'i gzim chung du bzhugs/mkhyen sprul sgar sngon phebs dang mjal 'phrad mdzad nas phebs/ mkhan chen drung rin po che'i gdung rten mdun mchod mjal smon lam mdzad/ dgon spyir khrus rab gnas/ bla khang spyi 'thus su dpal chen g.yang chog grub rgyal tshe dbang /khrom dbang bcas grub/ yang khrod du bang mi ched gtong mdzad/ rol rdor dbus bla grwa rnams kyis chibs skyel gyis bteg dpon nag dbon po tshang sar byang chog mdzad/ shangs dgon dang dpal spungs chos zur dar btang yang khrod nas mi gnyis 'byor/ srib mdar rgya tshong mgo len mkhan 'dug kyang zag zan che ba ma byung / kha yag po 'dug to mdar phebs/ nyer lnga'i dus mchod mdzad/ stag lung dang ban chen sprul sku gnyis byon/ lam zhor 'brog dud rnams la khrus rab gnas dang skyabs che dgon pa'i dar gtong 'byor/ khro ru dgon pas dbu 'don ja zhus/skyabs che dgon sprul sku bkra nor kyis gsol gdan zhus/ g.yu la brgal nas phebs lam gter dgon dang gnas dgon so so'i mjal kha/ rdis mdar 'dzi sgar phyag dpon gyis mjal zhu ched btang mi gnyis 'byor/ o mda' sde nas rta bsu dar btang / mdo srib dgon pa'i dar btang / yar mgo'i a ne sogs so sor re skong mdzad/ gnam brag dgon gyis dar btang ste zla 11 pa'i tshes 5 la 'dzam gru bud/ bla ma kar lu dang bud+dha dpon g.yog rnams khal bsu bcas 'byor/skyid mtsher nas sgar bteg dpal spungs dgon gyi ring bsu rnams 'byor/ tshes 7nyin dgon nas dbon rgan sprul sku rin po ches gtsos rta thabs bsu ma dang dar btang / yang khrod bla brang gis thabs bsu ngang gdan sa chen por rol bsu ser

114 'jam mgon kong sprul sku phreng gnyis pa'i rnam thar/phreng maṇ+ḍal dar gtong bcas grub cing / skyabs mgon si tu rin po che dang mjal 'phrad mdzad/ yang khrod du rol bsu bcas phebs nas dar gtong sogs grub bo/ /tshes 8 la dil yag zla sprul dpon g.yog rnams byung / rim par sde zhabs karma 'byor gdong sde btsun gsung bris phebs zhus dang nang chen btsun mos de mtshungs byung / rdzong sar nas mkhyen brtse rin po che'i gsol dpon dang rdzong sar grwa mang chos khrims bcas kyis dbu 'don dar 'bul/ be ru dpon dbang 'dus dpon g.yog mnyan sprul rin po che/ ri ba bag sprul sogs mjal mkhan mang / so sor bzhed skong mdzad/ tshes 11 nyin sgrub gling du byams mgon rin po che'i mdun du phebs/ dbus kyi phyag rtags phul nas lhan 'dzoms gnang / rdzong sar mkhyen brtse rin po che'i mdun yon tan phun tshogs khyim nang 'gro zhor phyag rtags phul/ sgrol ma gsung 'byon mar na bza' gsar sgron/ bla ma kar lu sogs la dbus kyi phyag rtags rim par gnang / sde mdzod rong rgyab bsod dga' grongs pa'i gdan 'dren snga rjes nan tan u tshugs che stabs tshes 18 la yang khrod nas bteg zhe dgar gsol tshigs skabs sde mdun dar gtong ngang dgon chen du phebs/ sde dge yum sras/ dpar khang bcas kyi dar gtong mdun bskor sogs la bzhed skong mdzad/smin gling rdor sems byang sreg nyin gsum btang / sde dge yum sras blon 'khor gyis dar gtong phebs skyel bcas gdan sa yang khrod du 'byor 'phral skyabs mgon si tu rin po che phebs pas lhan 'dzoms gnang / rdo brag sprul sku/ ri pa bag sprul sogs la mjal 'phrad mdzad/ tshes 28 nyin mkhyen sprul yang khrod du thog mar phebs/ rgya gling spos bsu mjal 'phrad mdzad/ bla ma kar lu sogs dang

kun khyab snyan pa'i ba dan/ 115thugs spro nyin gnyis btang / mtshur rtsis zla 11 bgol zla phyi ma'i tshes mgor/ bla ma kar lu yid lhung du phebs pa'i skyel mar zhabs grwa gnyis ka btang /snang bar byas so nam mkha'i nor bu yis/ / mun par gyur pa'i 'jig rten mtha' dag te/ /'jam mgon sprul pa'i sku 'dis sgrub brgyud pa'i/ /ring lugs che brgyad chos tshul mtha' dag go /zang zing nor la rngam pa'i grong chog mkhan / /mang mod bstan 'gro kho nar sman bzhed pa'i/ / dbang lung 'chad spel gson gshin cho ga yis/ /brel 'di byang chub sems dpa' chen po'i tshul/ /'jig rten dbang phyug rgyal dbang sarga dz+nyar/ /sgrub brgyud snying po'i thabs grol lam zab mo'i/ /dbang rgyud man ngag rgya macesa'i skyes phul bas/ /bka' rgyud gser gyi phreng ba mdzes par byas/ /zhes pa ni bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /sku che'i mtha' mjug gi mdzad pa phrin las/tshes 3 nas mtshams tho bzhag rje gong ma'i thugs dam 'ja' tshon dkon spyi tshe sgrub/ drag seng / gtor 'bul/ tshogs mchod rnams rgyun khyer mdzad rgyu'i dbu

116 'jam mgon kong sprul sku phreng gnyis pa'i rnam thar/tshugs/ 'di yi bar thugs sgrub bar chad kun sel rgyun khyer mdzad/ mgon khang du ser ma'i gzhung dang / phyag drug pa/ dngos ro la bcas gtang rag gsol 'phar dpon slob mang 'dus kyis gsungs/ me mda' bzang gnyis/ 'phrul mda' gcig ral gri gcig gzig lpags/ dar sna bcas la spyan gzigs/sgrub bla rnams la 'bul bsnyen gzab nan mdzad/ rten gtor sgam la byi ba sogs kyis gnod yod med zhib gzigs/ khang steng rnga thug rnams bla ma kar lus gtsos gzhis sdod rnams kyis legs par bsgrubs 'dug pas gsar rnying so so'i srog 'khor rje gong mas sgrub gnang pa rnams so sor bzhugs par mdzad do/ /de nas gong smos dkon spyi'i bsnyen sgrub mdzad/ dbon rgan sprul sku sogs gal chen 'ga' rer mjal 'phrad sna len tsam las bcad rgya dam po'i ngang bzhugs te dus mchod rnams rgyas pa gnang / rje gong ma'i gzim spyil du 'dra zhal snyan shal phul/ lo bstar sku mchod rgyas spros mdzad/ dil yag zla sprul dang sga stod zur sprul la mjal 'phrad/ zla 12 pa'i tshes 15 la zla 'dzin skabs sgrub bla rnams kyis sgrol chog gsung sar mang ja phyag 'gyed mchod 'bul gzab spro mdzad/ lo mjug mgon po'i gtor sgrub skabs 'tshogs phebs nyin kha shas dang / dgon du 'dus pa lnga brgya yar brgal la thong snam mtshal kha bzhi dum re phyag 'gyed dang / bzang gos ta zhun gyi khebs cha rten 'jog bcas mdzad mkhan btang / yon phun pha rgan ched pad+ma badz+ra nyin chog mdzad/ chu 'brug gnam lo gsar tshes dga' ston dang tshes 8 nyin sgrub dpon bla mas sman chog 'tshogs pa'i dbur phebs/ 'di skabs rta ra nas rta gnyis rkun pos khrid 'dug pas 'dan gter dz+nya na gling pas dgra chos btang song / rje nyid la zhabs gras rnams kyis

kun khyab snyan pa'i ba dan/ 117dgra chos sogs thugs gtad zhus kyang ngas ci yang mi shes gsungs nas ma gnang yang / bskang gso'i mchod gral nas thun gtor rgyang ring tsam 'phar 'dug zer bas mi ring bar rta rkun rtsad chod nas rta phyir 'byor byung ngo / /'dan gter gyi zhabs brtan tshe sgrub/ lo dar rtsis gto rnams grub/ sgrub sde rnams la rgyal thang lugs kyi gcod dbang mdzad/ zla 2 pa'i tshes 1 la dgung lo zhe dgu'i keg sel sgrol dkar sku tshad skya ris dang / rje rang nyid gtsos bla grwa bcu phrag yar brgal gyis dpal chen mo/ bla ma nor lha bcas kyi g.yang chog btang / tshes 5 snga char grol/ dkon spyi'i mtshams tho'ang bsdus nas dgon gyi dbu chos rnams kyis zhus pa ltar bka' brgyad khro rol gtor zlog tshogs dbur phebs/ zhor stabs skyabs rje si tu rin po che dang mjal 'phrad mdzad/ tshes 7 nas dbu bzung gtor rgyag gter gsar rgyag brngan bcas nyin bcu'i khongs su grub nas yar lam si tu rin po che dang mjal 'phrad kyis gdan sa yang khrod du phebs/ zhe rdzong lcags mdud sprul sku/ ban chen 'brong sprul blo gros rab gsal sogs mjal mkhan rnams kyi re skong dang / dge tshul slong 'ga' re bsgrubs/ zur mang rnam rtse nas bang mi gnyis gdong phebs bskul zhus 'dug zla 3 pa'i tshes 1nyin zhabs brtan sgrol dkar lus tshad grub/ bka' 'gyur bla ma phebs/ thang rgyal tshe dbang tshar grangs mang bar gnang nas dbus kyi phyag rtags bstsal/ zhabs brtan tshe gsang bla glud bcas bla grwa bcu skor gyis btang / sgrub pa rnams la shangs lugs bde mchog lha lnga'i dbang dngos sta nas bzung ni gu chos drug bka' bcu tshang ma gnang / rdzong sar nas mkhyen brtse rin po che byams mgon bla ma'i zhabs brtan 'bul ched phebs pa'i chibs bsur yon phun dpon g.yog song / tshes 11 nyin

118 'jam mgon kong sprul sku phreng gnyis pa'i rnam thar/dgon du mkhyen brtse'i mdun mjal dar 'bul bar phebs/ skyabs rje si tu rin po che'ang mjal nas yar phebs/ tshes 18 nyin rdzong sar mkhyen brtse rin po che yang khrod du phebs shing rgya gling spos bsu bcas mjal 'phrad mdzad/ mkhyen brtse mdun nas thugs bzhed ltar sgrol dkar rjes gnang phul/ mkhyen brtse'i yang phur sbrag ma dang / 'jam mgon gter byon tshe rta/ gsang thig skor bdun srung ma sngags srung ma'i dbang rnams mkhyen brtse'i mdun nas tshur gsan/ lha khang rnams la phyag nas zhus shing mkhyen brtse'i mdun rgya rdil lnga bcu yar brgal non nges kyi dngos 'bul phul nas dgon du phyir phebs skyel zhus/ tshes 22 la zur mang rnam rtser rin gter dbang lung gnang bar phebs dgos kyi lam sel sgar bsang chen mo yid bzhin dbang rgyal btang / skar 'dzin mdzad/ dbon rgan tshang dang klu dil mkhyen sprul phebs par shangs len mdzad/ rdzong mkhyen chibs skyel yon phun song / tshes 24 nyin sgrub gling du skyabs rje si tu rin po che'i mdun phebs/mjal 'phrad bsnyun 'dri zhib rgyas mdzad/ yar phebs skabs grwa 'khesar rnams la nged mar bsleb dus skyabs rje rin po che'i sku gdung las sku dngos mjal mi thub 'dra lan mang du gsungs/tshes 25 la yang khrod nas sgar bteg dpa' 'og tu dus mchod dang / mdzes mda' nor ma'i thog khrus rab gnas/ sbyin bdag kha shas kyi 'dod skong mdzad/skyel mkhan bud+dha dpon g.yog rnams phyir log tshos la brgal rim phebs kyis rnam rgyal gling du bla brang la g.yang chog sde spyir gnam chos 'od dpag dbang /dgon gsar sprul sku sogs la ma mgon zhal sbyor gtor dbang / dge tshul mang tsam la sdom pa bcas gnang / lam khel sde dgon rnams kyis rta thabs bsu ma

kun khyab snyan pa'i ba dan/ 119dar gtong sogs dang 'dod chos rigs bzhed pa rim skong mdzad nas ban chen du dge tshul slong brgya dang bzhi bsgrubs/ lam bar rtse sprul gyis gsol gdan phul/ khra 'gu dgon du phebs/ der khra legs sku rim tshe sgrub bla glud gsungs/gter ston 'od gsal rdo rje byon/ rje rang gi zhabs brtan yon dar/ dngul rdil gcig rta pho/ che khal phyi mda' bcas gnang nas khong rang gi gtor byon phur pa'i gtor zlog mdzad dgos zhes gsungs/ nang chen rgyal po'i mjal dar dang /bu chen pe khus 'bul tshan rnams la so so'i 'dod skong mdzad/ bslab grwa khang dang / sgrub khang gnyis/ zur sprul/ grwa shag khag 'ga' re bcas par 'dod chos dang rab bsnyen mang du bsgrubs/ zla 5 pa'i gnam gang nyin khra legs rin po che chibs skyel du phebs/ lam 'khod sde dgon rnams kyis rta thabs rol bsu dar btang sogs bsnyen bkur dpe bral dang / so so'i re 'dod yid bzhin du skong bar mdzad nas tshes 8 la gar sprul rin po ches dbus rta thabs rol bsu ngang rnam rgyal rtser phebs/ tshes 9 nyin zur mang 'dus spyi/ sgrub khang khag mgon khang khag bcas so so'i rin gter lung sna sel dang / dgung grangs zhe dgu'i gegs sel sogs chos rgyab gang babs mdzad/ tshes 10 mtshams tho bzhag nas dus mchod gsang thig bla sgrub tshogs mchod bsnyen sgrub kha gso mdzad/ de bar mchog gling yang srid rin gter gsan ched phebs pa dang mjal/ rab bsnyen brgya skor gnang / btsun ma bcu skor la'ang sdom pa gnang / bcad rgya grol nas 'du khang khra 'khyil mar ser phreng bsu bas phebs/ sna sel du rje 'di nyid dang gar bstan gtsos dpon slob mang tsam gyis dngos rol nyin gsum/ dkon spyi'i tshogs brgya bcas grub/ zla 6 pa'i tshes 23 nas bla sprul mtshan thob can nyi shu

120 'jam mgon kong sprul sku phreng gnyis pa'i rnam thar/skor gtsos bla grwa drug brgya yar brgal/ btsun ma brgya lhag khrom dbang bung ba stong phrag lhag tsam re 'dus pa rnams la rin gter gsum pa'i dbang lung dbu tshugs/ zla ba phyi ma'i tshes 10 la zur mang bla brang gzhung nas tshogs 'khor gzab spros dang / bde chen rtser dbyar gnas kyi dge 'dun don bdun tsam la chos 'brel/ yang gur drag skor nas dbang khrid rim gnang gis tshes 10 la ban sar phyogs med 'jam dpal rdzogs chen sogs 'jam dbyangs skor gyi dbang sna gsum grub/ de lor char shin tu dkon par phyogs tha dad nas 'dus pa'i bla ma grwa pa nus ldan rnams kyis chu mig so sor char slong mang du byas kyang char ma lon pas/ thams cad kyis rje 'di la char slong zhus bskul ltar lcang rtsa chu mgor char slong du phebs/ nyin gsum tsam bsang gsol klu mchod mdzad de dgongs pa la rtse gcig tu bzhugs nas da phyir phebs gsungs nas phyir phebs/ slar zhang khrom tshe bdag gi sta gon gnang / de nyin dgong mo nas char cher babs pas der 'dus thams cad ngo mtshar gyi gnas su gyur/ de nas bzung char rgyun sil mar babs/zhang khrom tshe bdag dbang dngos gzhi nas bzung rim par gnang / tshes bcu nyer lnga sogs dus chen rnams kyi skabs bla khag che gras rnams kyis mchod pa tshogs 'a khor rgyas spros mdzad/ tshes 19 nas zhabs brtan bla sprul 'dus pa zhib 'tshogs kyis zab mdo bdud zlog btang / mang ja la 'gyed rje rang nas gnang /nyin gsum tsam nas bsnyun gzhi dwangs te dbon a chos sar byang chog gsungs/de nas smin gling a ti zab don sogs kyis zla 9 pa'i tshes 1 snga char mthar dge tshe gsang dbang chen/ zur mang gter chen nam mkha'i rdo rje'i gter byon tshe sgrub 'chi med srog thig gi dbang chen gyis mjug bsdu bcas dbang khrid yongs rdzogs

kun khyab snyan pa'i ba dan/ 121grub/ lung gsung mkhan 'brug sprul rin po ches kyang dpe pod a yan grub/ rje nyid dbur bzhugs kyis dngos rol nyin gnyis btang ste gtor gshegs bcas grub bo/ /de nas 'dam dkar sprul sku'i zhabs rim cho ga bla glud/ sdom mdo skor nas gdan zhus ngor sdom mdo'i sde spyi'i g.yang skyabs byang chog bsang gsol dang /gsu shod rgan chung tshang gi 'dod skong / nyag stod smad sogs sbyin bdag rnams kyi sar dbang bka' cho ga sogs thugs brel rim chod mdzad/ 'di skabs dpal spungs nas skyabs rje si tu rin po che gshegs pa'i skad ngan bang mi 'byor/lam 'khod rnams la 'dod chos ci rigs gnang thog tshes 9 nyin rta thabs ser phreng rol bsus nang chen ja dgon du phebs/ kar lhun bla brang du g.yang skyabs/ dgon gyi bla grwa tshang mar sgrol dkar rjes gnang / sgrub khang du kar lugs rdo rje phag mo'i dbang sogs mdzad/ kar rgyam/ sangs rgyas bstan 'dzin/gter spru la rnams kyis gso la gdan phul/ sprel tsha'i spyi rim/ sde dgon la khrom dbang bcas gnang / tshes 12 nyin snga 'tshogs kyis tshes bcu btang / nyi shar du rje nyid gser skyems gar 'cham la phebs/ lha steng 'ja' mo sprul sku byon par thang rgyal tshe dbang sogs grub nas phebs/ lam bar dbu pa yab tshang sogs dud khag mang po'i 'dod skong / sde spyir bsang ri khrus grub nas rnam rgyal rtser slar phebs/ sngon nas sgrub chen sman sgrub sogs shin tu rgyas spros kyi chas bsgrigs yod kyang / byams mgon rin po che'i dgung zhag ma rdzogs pa'i nang du phebs thub dgos rgyu'i thugs brel gyis/ thugs sgrub bar chad kun sel sgo nas sman sgrub rkyang pa mdzad rtsis/ tshes 18 nas rgyal tho rgyan bkod bcas dbu tshugs/ nyin bdun gyi khongs su dngos grub len chog tshogs 'khor bcas grub nas gzhung

122 'jam mgon kong sprul sku phreng gnyis pa'i rnam thar/zur kun gyi mkhan 'chi med rab brtan gyis legs bshad 'bel gtam gyis sna drangs dngos po'i maṇ+ḍal brgya 'bul phul/ phyi nyin rgyal tho bsdu ba dang mar me smon lam khrom dbang bcas legs par grub bo/ /bar skabs rnams su bde chen rtse/ bla ma tshang / ra shul bla brang / 'brug pa bla brang / bslab grwa khang / mgon chen sogs la dbang khrus rab nas sogs bzhed skong mdzad/ tshes 25 la rnam rgyal rtse nas chos sgar bteg 'dzi la dpon tshang sar nyin kha shas 'dod skong khrom dbang gnang ste rim par phebs/ ram mdo'i sgar du ras sprul byon lung sogs kyi bzhed pa bskangs/ gar dbang rin po che'i sgar pa'ang 'byor/ lam bar rol rdor chang nor mar khrus sogs mdzad nas bdud rtsi dil du phebs/ drung rin po che sogs kyi bzhed skong grub ste mdzo bdun la brgal nas rim par byon/ lam bar dad spyin khag gi re 'dod bskangs te dbon stod gru brgal/ mkhan po mkhyen rab sogs kyis ja zhus mjal dar byung /rmog la brgal nas rim par zla 10 pa'i tshes 10 la yang khrod gdan sar phebs/ dpal spungs mkhyen sprul/ ze chen kong sprul sogs phebs par mjal 'phrad mdzad mtshams dpal spungs sgrub gling du phebs/ gar dbang rin po che dang rdzogs chen rin po cher mjal dar 'bul bzhes/ rdzogs chen rin po cher tshe dbang phul nas yang khrod du'ang mchod mjal du phebs/ skyabs rje si tu rin po che'i sku gdung mdun snyan shal brgya mchod gsum sogs phul nas bde mchog lha lnga gdung chog sbrel ma btang / dgung zhag gsung mkhan gzhis byes tshang mar dag gor re'i phyag 'gyed dang / gdung rten thebs/ zhabs gras rnams la sems gso bcas gnang / tshes 15 la dgung zhag rdzogs/ dngos 'bul dang bzhes dang /

kun khyab snyan pa'i ba dan/ 123klu dil steng 'khyug skor byon nas yang khrod du phebs/ rdor slob dpal bzang /dpal spungs chos khrims/ gter sras mthu stobs rnams byung bar gsung mol gnang / tshes 20 la rdzong sar nas gar dbang rin po che yang khrod du phebs/rgyags bsu bcas gzim chung nub bang du bzhugs/ gar dbang rin po che dpon slob rnams kyis yang khrod lha khang khag la mchod mjal mdzad/ gar dbang rin po che'i zhabs grwa yar 'gro rnams la srung byin dngos po'i gnang sbyin mdzad nas theg zla 10 pa'i tshes 24 res gza' lhag pa nyin ja pa dgon gyi grwa bsod nams nyi ma zhes pa lha bris mkhas pa 'dug par kai tshang zung 'jug bla brgyud zhal thang 'bri dbu tshugs/ tshes 20 nyin gar dbang rin po cher bstan bcos chen po shes bya kun khyab lung 'bul ba'i dbu bzung / ches 29 la dus mchod mgon phrin mi nub bstan rgyal btang / zla 11 pa'i tshes 5 la shes bya kun khyab grub/ tshes 6nas 0mas cad mkhyen gzigs 'jam mgon blo gros mtha' yas kyi bka' 'bum dbu tshugs/ 'di skor nas dpal spungs byams khang steng mgon khang gsar bzhengs kyi rten gtor sogs tshe dbang 'gyur med kyis bsgrub rgyu'i snyan 'bul thog thog ma'i sta gon dgos rigs bca' bkod mdzad/ tshes 9 la sher snying bdud zlog dang / tshes bcu dus mchod dang sbrel 'di yan gshin khag mang ba'i bsngo zhu la byang chog rgyas par mdzad/ mgon po'i srog 'khor gtor ma'i gur gdan 'khor zung 'jug sogs 'bri mkhan la zhal bkod dang lung lag len zhib mor bstsal/ bka' 'bum lung mu mthud mdzad/ tshes 25 nyin skyabs mgon si tu rin po che'i sku gdung mdun mchod 'bul gzab rgyas/ rdor sems cho ga tshogs mchod/ thugs smon zhib rgyas mdzad/ rten gtor gzung rnams la sbyong khrus sngon

124 'jam mgon kong sprul sku phreng gnyis pa'i rnam thar/du 'gro bas rab gnas cho ga mdor bsdus gzungs sgrub mi mang gis 'bum phrag 'gro nges mdzad/ phyi nyin tshe 'gyur shag tu phebs nas gtor rgyu byin rlabs/gzungs rnams sgril tshal sogs tshad ldan bgyis/ zhar byung dkar chag mdzad/yar phebs/ tshes 28 nyin ling khrus sngon 'gro'i gtor bsngo bskang gso gzab rgyas dang 'brel ba'i gdan 'khor rnams la bsdu spyad bsgrag khro sogs dang /'gugs bstim lha dbye'i bar shin tu grangs mang mdzad/ tshes 29 la mgon phrin mi nub bstan rgyal btang / ma mgon yang gsang srog gi 'khor lo rab gnas dang / sdong po nags dang re mtsho khar ma mgon bla rdo len mkhan rdor slob bla ma ye 'byung btang / bar mtshams kar 'bum lung phran bu gnang / gsang rten/yang gsang srog 'khor/ gri snying dngos/ gri snying sogs bsres pa'i 'dag gzugs so sor gzungs bcug zla 12 tshes 1 snga dro khrus bum sgrub nas dgon du phebs/ phyi dro rten gtor bsgrigs/ 'jam mgon bla ma'i na bza' bub tshang /stag sham bsam gtan gling pa'i phyag dril byin ldan/ mkhan chen drung rin po che'i bsnyen phreng / thod pa mtshan ldan zungs bcud kyis gtams pa bcas rje 'dis rten sgrom du rten bzhag mdzad/ sbyong khrus rab gnas mdzad/ tshes 3 nas bsnyen song dpon slob sum cu yar brgal gyis gtor sgrub gzhung mthun dang / skong rgyun sngags rgyun chad med bcas tshugs/ yang khrod bla brang nas 'phrul mda'/ ral gri/gzig lpags sogs la spyan gzigs/ mang ja phyag 'gyed brgya mchod bcas mdzad/ de mtshungs bla brang khag gzhan rnams kyis kyang mdzad song / tshes 10 la gtor sgrub legs par grub nas yar phebs/ bka' 'bum lung dbu tshugs/ lo mjug mgon sgrub tshogs dbur nyin kha shas phebs/ 29 nyin mgon phrin mi nub

kun khyab snyan pa'i ba dan/ 125bstan rgyal btang / chu sbrul gnam lo gsar du tshes/ gshin khag mang bar dpal chen lha khang du rdor sems sgo nas byang sreg mdzad/tshes 6 la bka' 'bum lung grub/ khra legs rin po che bsnyun bzhes kyis gdan 'dren bang mi 'byor/ tshes 7 nyin gar dbang rin po cher khro chu dug sdong srog dbang bka' rgya can phul/ 'di nyin khra legs rin po che tshes gcig nam gung tsam la sku gshegs pa'i skad ngan 'byor/ gar dbang rin po cher chos drug khrid lung phul/ tshes 13 la gdan sa yang khrod nas gar dbang rin po che dang lhan du sgar bteg 'di skabs nye gnas bud+dha chibs skyel phebs lam da res phyir 'ongs rgyu e yod ci shes/ a cang ku re yin gsungs yod 'dug rim par lha lung khug nas gar dbang rin po che zhe chen du byon pa'i mjal dar 'bul gnang rjes sgar so sor gyes/ rje 'di nyid kyi chos sgar rnam rgyal gling / ra ri/ bre mkho bcas pa'i 'dod skong mdzad/ tshes 22 la khra 'gu dgon du phebs/ khra legs sku gdung mdun bla sgrub tshogs mchod dang / smin gling rdor sems gdung mchod bcas tshes 29 bar btang / tshes 30 nas pad+ma badz+ra dang dkon spyi gdung mchod bcas btang / bar bar du myur 'byon gsol 'debs/ bla chos dang bu chen pe hu 'brong sprul bstan dga' sogs la bka' mol gnang / drung sprul gsung chog grub nas phebs/ nang chen 3(la mda' pe hu pha bu la tshe dbang mdzad/ khra dgon bang mi dbus bskyod gdong rgyal ba'i dbang po dang ma yum bcas la zhu yig phul/ zla 2tshes 7la bdun tshigs lnga pa rdzogs/ pad dzar dkon spyi gdung chog sogs sngar bzhin mdzad/ tshes 10 la rten gtor gtor sgrom bong ba bzhag par gzigs zhib mdzad/ tshes 14 gsol dgung bdun par kai tshang rgyal rgyam lha dgu dang

126 'jam mgon kong sprul sku phreng gnyis pa'i rnam thar/gdung chog bcas btang / srog 'khor sogs 'bri dbu tshugs/ tshes 20 la dgung zhag rjogs/ phyi nyin dpal chen g.yang chog rgyas par btang / gshin khag mang por 'khor ba dong sprugs byang sreg rgyas par mdzad/ khra 'gu ban chen/ zhe 'dzang / sga stod gnas bzang / spu rong lha khang dgon/ 'dam dkar dgon sogs kyi phyogs 'dus dgu bcu skor bsnyen rdzogs dang / drug cu re gnyis la rab byung /yang ban chen grwa lnga la rab byung tshar gcig bcas sgrub par mdzad/ sde dge karma bzod pa la thang rgyal tshe dbang / chos drug sgrub khang nang pa la kar lugs rgyal rgyam dbang dngos sta sbrel ma/ zur mang bdud rtsi dil gyi grwa gcig la rab byung dang bsnyen rdzogs sgrub par mdzad do/ /de nas rten gtor skor bca' bzo sogs legs par sdi/ba/bsnyun gzhi lci bzhes bab bstun yang srid gang du 'khrungs min zhal chems lta bu gan+da/ngas pa/tshes 23 nas gtor sgrub nyin gcig dbu tshugs nas bsnyun gzhi lci tsam bzhes/de yang dus rgyun du rang re spyi nam 'chi'i nges pa med/ sgos rgan bu rang 'chi 'gro shas che bas chibs rgan dang / gzim khyi ha pā zhig yod pa gnyis la khyed tshos byams po gyis zhes nye gnas rnams la rgyun du gsungs/ lhag pa ra 'brug 'ordzo dgung keg thog bag skrag che nas nye gnas rnam pas sku rim sogs bka' 'dri zhu skabs/ 'di lo mi skyon sang lor bya grags skabs 'gro ran zer ba'i rmi lam byung gsungs/ yod tshad ha las nas ci drag zhus pas/ nga yi rmi lam gyis thig mi dar/

kun khyab snyan pa'i ba dan/ 127skrag gar dgos sogs phebs yod 'dug 'di skabs bsnyun gzhi'i bab sogs gang cir bag skrag che nas zur ri drung ba dbur bzhugs kyis zhabs brtan tshe sgrub bla glud bdun gcig khra 'gu dgon gzhung nas sgrol chog tshogs brgya sogs ring sbrel/ nye gnas yon tan phun tshogs kyis rta drel sogs byes sgar dngos rdzas phyag khar bzhugs rigs nas bsal 'thus lta bu rnams/ sga stod/ zur mang lho rgyud nang chen khul/ dge rgyal man dgon sde yod rigs la sku rim chos rgyab tu snga phyir mang du phul ba dang / rang sgar bla grwa rnams kyis kyang zhabs rim lhod med zhus kyang bsnyun babs je lod gyur pas de tshul dpal spungs yang khrod gzhis sdod bud+dha sogs la skye rgu mdo nas glog phrin btang / zla bzhi pa'i tshes gnyis gsum skor nas dbu bla ma kar mjal la zhal chems su/ spyir 'dus byas thams cad mi rtag pa dang thams cad 'chi ba'i rang bzhin las ma 'das tshul dang / lhag par rje rang nyid kyang bla ma lha yi lung gis 'di skabs sku tshe zad med 'dra yang /bar chad bcos su med pas ci bya bral tshul/ dgongs pa rdzogs pa'i gnas kyang rang yul gzhan yul blos brtags la khyad med tshul dang / sku gdung ro gog la rtsis che mdog gis phyir gdan drang rgyu sogs dgos pa med nges ma zad/ 'phral du bsreg sbyong dgos tshul/ sku tshe 'dir rgyal dbang rdo rje 'chang gi bka' che rigs ma ldog pas bstan 'gro'i don lhag bsam lhad med snang dang mi snang bar dngos brgyud nas cung zad grub tshul/ da dung skye 'chi rang mtshan gyis ma grub pas phrin las 'gag pa med tshul/ mchog gi yang srid kyang rje nyid las lhag pa zhig 'ongs nges dang / de'ang bod yul dbus lha ldan phyogs su 'byung ba 'dra zhig bcas zhib mor phebs 'dug dbu mdzad bla ma rang gis kyang de skabs khas len zhus yod

128 'jam mgon kong sprul sku phreng gnyis pa'i rnam thar/tshod kyis 'phral der bsnyung gnas brgya cha grub par mdzad song ngo tshes 4 phan chad khra dgon khra legs bla brang du bzhugs bzhin de nyin gza' ci yin sogs dris nas/ khra legs kyi ri khrod gsar rgyag sngon chos rje paṇ+ḍi ta mi pham rnam rgyal gyi sgrub gnas sa dpal bzang bas der phebs dgos gsungs shing chibs thog nas yar phebs/gdul bya rtag 'dzin can chos la bskul phyir gzugs sku'i bkod pa zhi dbyings su bsdu tshul mdzad pa/tshes 5 nyin sku khams ha cang bltams pas yon tan phun tshogs kyis da ni bsnyun tshul la dpyad na shin tu bag skrag che bas/ rje nyid bstan 'gro spyi dang bye brag nged cag grwa 'khor la thugs rjes dgongs te yun ring por zhabs pad brtan dgos/gal te yun ring por brtan pa'i gdul bya'i bsod nams med na'ang gdan sar ma phebs bar cis kyang zhabs pad brtan thub dgos zhes u tshugs chen pos zhus shing / de phyir zhabs brtan rigs kyang tsha sgang nas spang dag ltar rang re ltos bcas kyi lus longs spyod gtong ba la phongs pa med pas ci bsgrub bka' 'dri zhus par/ sngar dbu mdzad la phebs sgo'i gsung rnams rob tsam gsungs shing / lhag par rang cag la skye 'chi'i rang dbang med/ nam 'chi nges pa med pas nyin gcig thog bab du 'ongs zhes sngon nas rna ba 'gras 'gras bar lab pa de da res rang re la mngon du gyur pa red/ khyed tshos kyang 'chi ba thugs la bzhag nas las 'bras la yid ches kyi dad pas dge sgrub sdig spong lag tu lon nges dang /

kun khyab snyan pa'i ba dan/ 129sdom pa dang dam tshig la bag yangs rnam g.yeng med pa'i bag yod dran shes gyis/kho bo rnam pa bzang ngan ci mthong ma nges kyang smin grol gdams ngag mang du 'brel bas dag snang sgoms la gsol ba thob dang shi gson gang gyur kyang bslu ba med do zhes rdo rje'i bden tshig bka' yi mtha' mar bstsal/ thog mar gsol ja/de nas 'o ma/ de rjes bdud rtsi bcas phyogs bcur mchod pa'i tshul gyis 'thor bar mdzad de cung zad re gsol/ thugs dgyes nyams dang bcas zhal 'dzum dmul ler bzhugs so/ /sngon nas gdan zhus ltar sangs rgyas mnyan pa rin po che yang phebs/ nam gyi gung tsam la sngon ltar zhal 'dzum zhing sku drang por bsrangs nas mtha' ma'i mdzad pa mi g.yo chos sku'i dgongs pa la snyoms par bzhag par gyur to/ //shul bzhugs nye gnas thugs sras bu slob rnams kyis 'das mchod rgya cher bsgrubs pa/de nas sngon zhal chems skabs/ tshe gcig la bla ma rdo rje 'chang dang thugs yid dbyer med du mnyam par bzhag khul bgyid pas 'chi dus kyang ngo sprod 'pho 'debs sogs 'a 'ur mang pos dgos med phab pa ltar thugs dam gsol 'debs sogs kyi spros pa bskyungs nas/ mnyan sprul dbur bzhugs kyis grwa 'khor rnams kyis rgyal rgyam cho ga gsungs/ zhag gsum nas thugs dam grol ba'i rtags byung bas/ mnyan pa rin po ches phyag bstar gyis sku gdung rin po che khrus nas bton pa dang / gnas yig ras dkar dri bzang gis sbag pas dril ba

130 'jam mgon kong sprul sku phreng gnyis pa'i rnam thar/longs spyod rdzogs sku'i chas su zhugs/ mdun du mchod pa'i rigs gzab rgyas/chos sku las gzugs skur bzhengs su gsol ba sogs rgyal rgyam sgo nas gdung chog rgyas par dgu tshugs dang po ma rdzogs bar btang zhing / mnyan sprul rin po cher 'di yi sngon tsam du chibs pa dge rkyang gtsos dngos 'bul phul 'dug de rjes khra 'gu sprul sku dang zur ri sprul sku gnyis dbur bzhugs bla grwa mang tsam gyis rgyal rgyam gdung chog sogs gong ltar gsungs/ sku gshegs 'phral gdan sa dpal spungs yang khrod du bud+dha dang dpal spungs sku mched rnam par snyan gsan zhu phyir bang mi btang / tshes 10 nyin gdan 'dren zhus pas zur mang rol rdor dang drung pa rin po che gnyis phebs/ so sor gdung mchod mdzad/ sgar gzhis dngos rdzas phal cher yas phyin dgon sde rnams dang bod phyogs man chod chos rgyab dgongs rdzogs sgrub ched 'gyed gtong grwa mngags bang mi so sor btang / tshes 11nyin zur mang drung sprul/ rol rdor/ kha sprul/ zur sprul sogs dbur bzhugs so sor chog rogs bcas pas rgyud sde bzhi yi dkyil 'khor zhal phye ba'i sgo nas/sngon gyi zhal chems ltar sku gdung ri khrod de ga'i dbus nas gdung khang mchod 'bul gzab rgyas bcas zhugs su phul/ de nyin 'ja' tshon sprin ris sogs ya mtshan pa'i ltas dpag tu med pa kun gyi mthong snang mthun par byung ba dang / khyad par smad phyogs 'grul pa zhig gis/ de ring nam mkha' nas khang khyim yul bkod lta bu mang po'i dkyil du bla ma na bza' ser po bzhes pa zhig je mthor phebs song ba mthong bas ci red ces dris 'dug pa gzhan kha shas kyis lab byung /'di skabs gdan sa dpal spungs phyogs su kha ba shin tu chen po babs tsā 'dra'i gnas nang kun tu shug pa dang swā la'i shing sdong mang du bsgyel 'dug pa rje

kun khyab snyan pa'i ba dan/ 131rin po che 'di sku gshegs pa'i ltas su mngon no/ /zhag gsum mtshams nas gdung sgrom zhal phyes/ gdung rus gdung thal bcas legs par bsdus/ de phyogs skya ser kun gyis mchod 'bul dang der sgar shul bzhugs ring cho ga gdung mchod sngon bzhin rgyas par btang / tshes 18 nyin sgar gzhis grwa 'khor rnams khra 'gu nas bteg ban chen dgon pas gdung rus sgrom bu thog rol ser phreng gis bsus nas 'du khang du spyan drangs/ mnyan pa dbur bzhugs pa'i bla grwa kun gyis gdung mchod rgyas par phul/ zhabs gras rnams la'ang sne len dpe bral mdzad/ de bzhin rim par zhang 'gu dgon sogs lam 'bod sde dgon kun gyis gdung rus la mchod 'bul byin rlabs zhu ba sogs gdung mchod mdzad mkhan mang / yang khrod nas bsu ma 'byor ba bcas zla tshes nyin gdan sa yang khrod du gdung rus spyan drangs/ der skya ser tshang mas gdung sgrom la phyag 'tshal byin rlabs zhus dar btang / mchod gral gyi dbus su bzhugs su gsol nas sgrub mchod gdung chog mchod 'bul sogs rgyas par byas so/ /gdan sa yang khrod du sngar bsnyun yod pa'i glog phrin dang rjes su bsnyun tshabs che ba'i bang mi btang ba zla 4 tshes 9 dang 11 snga rjes su 'byor 'dug bud+dhas rang dgon sku mched grwa tshang sgrub sde tshang mar zhabs brtan rigs dang rdzong sar mkhyen sprul mdun skyabs rten chibs drel a mi ri ka sogs phul nas bka' brtag zhus pa'i rtags babs yod rigs dpal spungs grwa mang / sgrub sde gsum/ mgon khang khag dang / dgon chen/ rdzong sar sogs sa dgon rnams/ kaḥdapal zhe rdzogs sogs rnying dgon/ dpal 'byor dgon sogs kar dgon bcas nye 'bor dgon khag yod rigs la chos rgyab rta drel dngos chas spus nam ldan pa sha stag zhabs rim

132 'jam mgon kong sprul sku phreng gnyis pa'i rnam thar/zhu bskul du 'bul bar bang mi so sor btang / khra 'gu nas chos sgar gdan 'dren zhu mi rnams dang / sgrub gling bla ma lco ga dpon mdzod karma nor bu sogs kyang phebs nas sku chas rigs bod khams dgon sde bla sprul kun la mchod bsngor bkram rgyu'i yi ge 'bri mkhan mang pos nyin kha shas su bris nas bang mi lag khyer sogs phyogs so sor rim gtong mdzad/ dgung tshigs kyang de nas dbu bzung pas gling kha gzim spyil phyi 'khyams su rdor slob bla ma dpal bzang sogs kyis bdun dang por rgyal rgyam gdung chog gnyis par phag mo/ gsum par bde mchogabazhi par pad+ma badz+ra/ lnga par dgyes rdor la dbon bsam sprul sogs/ drug par dus 'khor/ bdun par 'od dpag mgur mtsho bcas so sor sgrub mchod dang gdung chog sbrel ma gnang / 'di skabs dgung zhag dngos rdzogs zin kyang pad+ma badz+ra bdun gcig 'od dpag bdun gcig bka' brgyud mgur mtsho bdun gcig rdor brag sprul sku dpon slob rnams kyis zhi khro bdun gcig gzhan yang dgongs tshigs dang po nas bum sgrub 'phar ma dang kun rigs sgrub mchod 'phar ma/ mgon khang chen mor gsol 'phar/ sgrub sde 'og mar mi 'khrugs pa bdun gcig klu dil sgrub sder kun rigs bdun gcig yang khrod sgrub sde 'di nyid du thog mar gsar rnying bskang gso nyin 'tshogs bdun nas smin gling rdor sems nyin 'tshogs bdun sogs 'don bya rigs mang bar bsgrubs pa bcas la so sor legs 'bul gyis dgyes pa bskangs/ dpal spungs dbon rgan rin po che/mkhyen sprul rin po che/ gar dbang sprul ba'i sku/ zhe chen rab 'byams sprul pa'i sku/ rdzong sar mkhyen brtse rin po che rnams gdan 'dren dang 'brel gsung chog dgongs rdzogs gnad smin bka' drin skyong bar mchod sprin mtshon byed gzab

kun khyab snyan pa'i ba dan/ 1 33spros dang / skyabs rje si tu rin po che'i sku gdung gtsos rten gsum rnams la mchod 'bul sogs dam pa de nyid kyi dgongs pa rdzogs thabs shul bzhugs nye gnas gnyis pos dad spro dang ba chen pos zhu song bar rjes su yi rang ngo / /slar chu sbrul lo de nyid kyi zla 6 pa'i nang chab mgar lha dbu rogs pa dpal lhun sogs kyis skyabs rje byams mgon rin po che'i gser gdung mtha' grub pa dang khel bas/ gser zangs sogs thabs 'tshol lhod med kyis 'di ga yang khrod du gnas yul dogs pas stabs ma bde yang dpal spungs sgang tho chibs ra'i steng khar mgar las bya rgyu'i sta gon rigs grub/ zla 6 tshes 30 nyin mgar las kyi dbu tshugs/ nang shing yang de yi snga gong tsam nas shing mkhan dpon g.yog mang bas rim par bzos/ mgar ba rnams la za chas skor spyi 'grig las lhag pa dang / gla cha ston mo bcas bzang ja sgam 45 rta sga 'byar/ gri bog gos chas sogs mdor na bzang ja 'bor240 song 'dug zla 7 tshes 5 la mgar las gser gtong rgyu bcas legs par grub/ phyi lo shing rta zla 2 tshes 16 la nang gzhug skor nas shin tu rgyas spros bca' sgrub grub nas rab gnas mtha' rgyas sa ga zla ba'i tshes 15 la bla mchod tshogs 'khor bcas legs par grub/ slar shing lug zla 2 tshes 7 la skyabs mgon rgyal ba'i dbang po rgya nag pe cing nas gdan sa 'dir zhabs pad 'bod pa dang stabs 'grigs/ dkon mchog spyi 'dus kyi sgo nas tshogs brgya grangs mang yul lung snod bcud la khrus gsol/ phyi nang kun la rab tu gnas par mdzad pas lha dang bcas pa'i mchod sdong gcig pur gyur la/dus dang rgyun du mar me tshe 'bar gtsos mchod pa'i tshogs kyang rgya cher spros shing /bla ma rin po che kar lu'i thugs rje la gtso bor brten mchod rdzas spyan gzigs

134 'jam mgon kong sprul sku phreng gnyis pa'i rnam thar/kyang bzang gos gser ma kho na shin tu spus nam ldan pa phul/ nye gnas gnyis pos phyi 'byung bla brang la re dogs che na'ang 'di phyi gnyis kar bka' drin gzhal dka' ba'i skyabs rje de nyid kyi dgongs pa rdzogs thabs kho nar snga rjes kun tu gtong sgo rgya che thog de skabs rgyal ba'i dbang por bsnyen bkur sogs kyang dpe bral mdzad song ste/ mchod sdong rin po che'i phra rgyan sogs la bltas na phyogs tsam mtshon nus pa'i phyir ro/ /(8rdzog mar sga stod nas bsnyun khams bzhes nas zhabs brtan dang / gshegs rjes dgongs rdzogs mchod 'bul gser gdung rin po che la phyi nang gi 'gro song ci song sogs zhib par bkod na dad dang lhag blo ldan pa rnams spro ba skyed pa'i rgyur 'gyur srid kyang /yig tshogs la 'jigs nas 'bri ma nus la/ rtsis sprod len gyi deb yig lta bu la dgos pa'ang cher ma mchis snyam mo/ /gser gdung rin po che'i nang bzhugs sogs zhib pa zhig gal shin tu che bas phyi nas bri bar 'gyur ro/ /de lta bus ma tshad rje nyid kyi dgongs pa'i lhag ma sgrub sde 'di nyid kyi skor sogs rgya che rigs gzhan dang / kar brgyud gser phreng gi zhal thang 'bad rtsol 'gro sgo gang ches sgrub bzhin pa 'di dang / mchog gi skye ba sprul pa'i sku rin po che'i don7rgyal ba'i dbang por gsol ba 'debs bzhin pa la/ slad nas bdag cag yongs kyi dpal dang mgon du gdan sa'i chos khrir mnga' gsol/ gsang ba gsum gyi yon tan mngon 'gyur gyi thabs rtsol dang / dam pa'i tshul dgus rje gong ma de nyid kyi gdul bya'i lhag ma skyong bar gor ma chag pa bcas kyi bdag rkyen nye bar gnas pa 'di dag las byung ba ste 'phros don tsam mo/ /)

kun khyab snyan pa'i ba dan/ 135dam pa'i rnam thar gyi mdo don tshul gsum du bsdus nas gal gnad du ngajond pa/da ni skyes bu dam pa rnams kyi rnam par thar pa'i mdo ni dam pa'i tshul dgu'am bcu gnyis su grags pa ltar las/ de dag ci rigs gong du smos pa las shes nus kyang / 'dir yang de rnams kyi nang gses 'ga' re cung zad zhib par smos na/sdom pa dang dam tshig la gces spras ji ltar mdzad tshul/ thugs dam bsag sbyang gi rim pa dang bskyed rdzogs la gnad du bsnun tshul grub pa'i rtags dang bcas pa/ gzhan la 'chad spel phrin las rgya che bas skyong ba'i slob tshogs dam pa mang po ji ltar bskrun tshul te gsum mo/ /dang po ni/ spyir rje bla ma 'di nyid kyis phyi 'dir dam pa'i chos 'dul ba 'di ji bzhin nyams su len pa'i gang zag dkon par gzigs nas/ bstan pa'i gzhi tshangs spyod kyi bslab pa dri ma med pas sku tshe 'da' bar mdzad/ dus dang rgyun du rtags dang cha lugs/ chos gos rnam sbyar sogs 'tsho ba'i yo byad rnams dang mi 'bral/ yar mar gyi gso sbyong sogs la'ang phyag len rnam par dag pa kho nar mdzad/ myos byed kyi rigs dam rdzas skabs phran bu ma gtogs mi bzhes/ rje nyid kyi gsung las kyang / kho bo la so thar gyi lhung ba sde lnga las pham pa bzhis gtan nas gos pa med/ khyad par bud med rigs la dngos su bgrod pa lta ci smos/ sgos mdza' 'tshol ba dang / 'khrig tshig rjen smra/ reg pa'i lhag ma sogs kyis dad ldan khyim pa sun 'byin pa dang / tha na chags pa'i mig gis lta ba tsam

136 'jam mgon kong sprul sku phreng gnyis pa'i rnam thar/yang byed ma myong zhes yang yang gsung / mi chos bla ma'i rdzun 'di nged bla chen rnams la 'byung nyen che bas dogs zon dgos zhes rgyun du gsung la/ phyis 'dir bka' brtag gam phyag mo mi gnang 'dug pa rgyu mtshan des yin par mngon/ lhag ma man chad kyi lhung ba ci rigs byung ba rnams sbo mgu dbyung gsum sogs chos nas gsungs pa'i phyag len rnam dag 'dir mi 'dug kyang / 'gyod sems dang bcas pas mkhan chen drung rin po che'i mdun g.yo zol med par zhus nas bshags sdom byin gyis brlabs pa sogs mdzad/ phyi dro'i kha zas sogs 'ga' re yul dus nad khams kyis gtan spangs ma nus kyang 'gyod sems med pa'i bslab pa khyad gsod ma byas la/ dag tshangs su 'gyur ba'i thabs brtson/ lar rgyun du bag yod dran shes/ theg pa chen po'i sems bskyed dang gsang sngags kyi thabs zab mos zin khul bgyid pa yin zhes gsungs/ ban+de sor gdub gyon mkhan rnams la sor gdub ma gon/ sor gdub de ma gon na mi nus rgyu'i tshor ba 'dra ni med/ don chung dus ston pa bka' drin can gyi bka' dang 'gal don mi 'dug ces gsungs pas mtshon bslab pa phra mo yan chad la gces spras su mdzad/'on kyang gu dog dam grim grim gyis rang tshugs 'dzin pa de 'dra ma yin par mdzad spyod thams cad ma bcos shugs byung bag yangs 'khrol le ba'i ngang nas sdom pa dang 'gal ba 'di'o zhes pa cha shas phra mo'ang mthong rgyu med nges pa yun du mjal ba rnams kyis shes so/ /byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa la'ang gtso cher/nyes spyod sdom dang dge chos sdud/ /sems can don byed tshul khrims gsum/ /zhes pa ltar/ las 'bras la yid ches kyi dad pa brtan po thugs rgyud la lhan skyes su bzhugs pas/ tshong dang so nams bun skyed sogs kyis mtshon sems can la

kun khyab snyan pa'i ba dan/ 137g.yo sgyu gtan nas mi mdzad/ zhabs gras rnams la'ang gtso cher las rgyu 'bras kyi chos kho na gsungs nas dgun bshas sogs sems can gyi srog gcod pa gtan spang dgos tshul zhi drag gnyis kyi sgo nas rgyun du gsungs pas khong rnam pas kyang bag yod byed dgos pa byung / dgra gnyen bar mas bsdus pa ci 'dra zhig yin kyang gsung gi phebs sgo tshun chad drang thal le gsungs/ mdzad spyod rigs la ji ltar yun ring brtags kyang g.yo sgyu zol zog phra mo'ang mi mnga' yang khrod bla brang la sdod bzod mi bde ba bgyid rigs sogs dgra zlar 'os pa rnams la'ang thugs gnag pa'i mdzad spyod 'phrang bsgug ces pa mi mdzad nges pa dang / kun la dngos dang brgyud nas phan ci thogs/ bya ri dwags khyi dang byi la yan chad la byams brtse tshad med/ rgyun du skyabs rten bsngo 'brel sogs la mtshams mtshams su byang sreg dang sgrol chog bskang gso nyin re bzhin thun so sor gzab rgyas mdzad/ dbang lung zhu mi yod rigs la sku ngal la ma ltos par 'phral 'phral re skong / dbul po sogs la mkho rgu'i bza' btung / dgon sde rnams la rten bzhag rten gsum bzhengs pa rnams la zhal 'debs/ gzhan la phan char gang 'gro'i gyod kha mchu zlum pa sogs mdor na bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhis 'gro don rgya chen por mdzad do/ /gsang ba sngags kyi dam tshig las rtsa ba'i bla ma'i thugs dang 'gal med dgongs pa'i dbang du mdzad nas/ rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang gcig pu ni7yab rje rgyal ba'i dbang po mkha' khyab rdo rje yin la/ de ni bcos ma tsam ma yin par thugs kyi dkyil nas chos sku rdo rje 'chang ngam sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das nyag cig tu 'dzin pa las/ tha mal pa'i 'du shes skad cig/ tsam yang med nges nang rtags phyi nas mjal du yod la/ mkhan drung rin po che bka' drin shin tu

138 'jam mgon kong sprul sku phreng gnyis pa'i rnam thar/che ba'i bla ma zhig tu song gshis/ sku yang srid dang bcas par sri zhu dpe med dang /snga rjes dngos 'bul lan grangs la thugs la gces pa'i dngos pos bsal 'thus gnang / phyis sku gshegs rjes gdung rten gyi khra rgyan du gzi chu mig dgu pa zhig phul bas mtshon no/ /phyis su dge tshul slong zhu mi mchog phal phyug dbul mang nyung ci yod 'phral 'phral gnang mdzad pa 'di'ang mkhan chen drung rin po che'i bka' yin par 'dug pa sogs bka' dang dam las nam yang 'da' ba med nges shing / zhe chen rgyal tshab rin po che bka' drin che ba'i rtsa ba'i bla ma zhig tu brtsis pas de mtshungs dang / byams mgon si tu rin po cher sngar gong du bshad pa lta bus brtsi bkur dpe bral gnang ngo / /phyis byams mgon rin po che'i zhal nas 'jam mgon gong mas mdzod lnga bka' bsdu gnang ba dang rgyal dbang mkha' khyab rdo rje sogs la 'chad spel mdzad pa red/ da res kyi rgyal sras 'jam mgon sprul sku 'dis kyang 7rgyal ba'i dbang po bcu drug pa sogs la 'chad spel lan grangs 'gar gnang zhing / kar rabs gtsos rten bzhengs/ thugs dam nyams bzhes sogs las 'jam mgon gong ma'i phrin las bskang thub nges byung song / da ni sku tshes brtan na chog ces sogs thugs dgyes pa'i gsung mang po gleng ba dngos su thos la/ rje 'dis kyang ngas spyi gtsug tu rgyal dbang mkha' khyab rdo rje sgom dus sku zhabs byams mgon rin pe rdzocher gnas 'gyur ba lan grangs mang tshe rabs mang po'i rigs bdag yin 'dra gsungs pa'ang dngos su thos la/ phyis sku gshegs rjes bla ma lco ga la/ byams mgon rin po che de bka' brgyud rgyal ba yab sras red/ sprul pa'i sku nor 'byul 'ong srid kyang mi srid/ 'ong yang mi rung / rgyal ba'i dbang pos gang gsungs las rang 'dod mtho 'dod grags 'dod gtan nas mi

kun khyab snyan pa'i ba dan/ 139nyan/ ngo bo gser yin na rnam pa lha sku dang chab rdzas gang yod kyang 'dra/ sprang ra slag can zhig la 'khrungs yod kyang nor ba med pa des 'tshengs zhes gsungs pa'ang ma 'ongs lung bstan lta bur byung song ngo / /gzhan yang rdzong sar dang dpal spungs mkhyen brtse/ zhe chen kong sprul sogs bla ma mang du bzhugs pa rnams la'ang brtsi bkur mchod bstod kho na mdzad de/ bka' 'gyur bla ma rin po che las bka' 'gyur lung gsan zhing / tshur mthong tsam du grong sngags phal pa lta bu'i chu mgur bla ma las shes bya kun khyab gsan skabs su'ang lugs gnyis kyi go sa mthon po'i nga rgyal cung zad tsam yang med par chos thun thams cad la gus pas phyag gsum re 'tshal bdang zhe sa bkur bsti tshad med mdzad pas mtshon no/ /lar dus dang rgyun du khyer so gsum gyi ting nge 'dzin dang nam yang 'bral med chu bo rgyun gyi rnal 'byor du bzhugs shing / blo 'das phyag rgya chen po'i dbyings su la bzla bar mdzad nges pas dam tshig nyams chag 'byung ba'i gnas med la/ tshur mthong tsam du'ang sngags kyi lta spyod zab mor yid ches shing gdeng rnyed pa'i gsung mchid/ bla sprul 'chal 'chol spyod pa'i rigs la'ang brnyas bcos med pa'i brtsi srung dang / bka' las kyang rang cag la mngon shes med pas gang zag gi rgyud tshod mi shes/ gsang sngags kyi rnal 'byor pa 'dra yin na yul gnyan pas dma' 'bebs tshig ngan zur tsam yang gtong mi phod/ gal te tshul 'chal yin na'ang dgos pa dang 'brel dus sun phyung bar 'os pa tsam las dus rgyun ngan smra lkog lab bya don med ces phebs pas mtshon sngags kyi dam rdzas dang bud med kyi rigs tsam la'ang smod par mi mdzad do/ /gnyis pa thugs dam bsag sbyang dang bskyed rdzogs la gnad du bsnun tshul/

140 'jam mgon kong sprul sku phreng gnyis pa'i rnam thar/grub pa'i rtags dang bcas pa 'ga' zhig bshad pa la/ sku chung ngu'i dus gzim spangs pa'i thar pa chen po'i mdo chog phyag len rnam dag gzhung mthun nyin mtshan cha bdun can tshar gcig rjes su de mthun tshar gcig phyag chen sngon 'gro phyag dang skyabs 'gro sbrel ba/ yig brgya/ maṇ+ḍal/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor bcas 'bum ther kha skong bcas pa re/ snga rjes bsnyung gnas cha mang tsam/ thar chog dang sman chog grangs mang / lo bstar ston pa'i dus chen/ 'jam mgon gong ma'i dus chen/khyad par rgyal dbang mkha' khyab rdo rje'i dus chen bcas la mchod tshogs rgyas pa 'char can mdzad/ lo mjug tu mgon gsol skong mdos sogs bdun phrag re/ma rtsa zla ba re re bzhin/ tshes bcu la phal cher 'jam mgon gong ma'i zab gter gsang thig yab bka'i tshogs mchod/ nyer lnga la yum bka'i tshogs mchod/ nyer dgur mgon po ser ma'i gzhung la phyag bzhi dud sol phyag drug 'bor lnga rjes 'brang / srid rgyal ma thang spom sogs bcug pa rgyas pa dang / skabs skabs su dkon spyi sogs rtsa gsum gang rung tshogs skong 'don res/ gsol 'phang la'ang mgon phrin mi nub bstan rgyal/ phyag drug gtor chog phrin las gter mdzod sogs gtong bar mdzad/ rgyal ba'i dbang po mkha' khyab rdo rje'i mdun sngar sku chung dus chos skyong gtso bo gang bsten bka' 'dri phyag bris phul yod 'dug pas/da skabs rigs chos brgyud pa'i srung ma khyad par can rdo rje ber can lcam dral thugs dam srung ma'i gtso bo mdzad dgos tshul dang / de mtshams rje 'jam mgon gong ma'i thugs dam bstan srung gi gtso bo myur mdzad mgon po bsten dgos tshul phebs yod 'dug pa 'di'i lugs mdzad pa'ang zhar byung ngo / /de lta bu'i dus mchod rigs dang dgong mo'i bskang gso bcas rje nyid sku rkyang gis ḍā dril dkrol

kun khyab snyan pa'i ba dan/ 141bzhin gsung ba'am/ dril gsil tsam gyis mgyogs 'don min par sku yi nye gnas grwa 'khor yod rigs 'tshogs nas rnga rol dung gling dbyangs gdangs sogs spros pa gang rgyas ngang gtor mchod rnams kyang rgyas spros dang ba 'dren pa kho na mdzad pa yin no/ /gzhan yang nyin re bzhin tho rangs ldang ba'i rnal 'byor nas bzung sgrol dkar rgyun khyer/ 'jam dkar sgom bzlas/ le'u bdun ma/ chab gtor/ sngar thugs sgrub bar chad kun sel dang phyis dkon mchog spyi 'dus gtor 'bul tshogs mchod/ bzang spyod/ gtor bsngo mtshal ma sogs phur pa'i sgom bzlas/ gsur bsngo/ gcod lus sbyin rnams dang / gzhan yang dag byed khrus kyi rnal 'byor/ srung sdom go cha'i rnal 'byor/ bza' btung tshogs kyi rnal 'byor sogs rje 'jam mgon gong ma'i thun mtshams rnal 'byor las byung ba rnams dang / phyis su rgyun du yig drug kho na gsungs pas dung phyur ma grub tsam byung yod 'dra'o/ /gzhan yang lha ldan jo shāka bsam yas sogs dang / mtshur phu lha chen/ rgyal dbang rdo rje 'chang gi sku gdung rin po che gtsos khams dbus gtsang gsum gyi gnas rten rnams la mchod 'bul tshogs bsags/ yang khrod gdan sar kar rabs gtsos rgyun du spos dang mar me tshe 'bar khag mang tsam rang dang gzhan bskul la brten gsar bzhag gis mtshon mtha' yas pa 'dir brjod mi nus so/ /bsnyen sgrub nyams bzhes mdzad rigs kyang / sku chung ngu'i dus nas phyis kyi bar/ 'bum 'gyur nang sgrol dkar bsnyen bzlas dang / lo mjug gsang thig phur bsnyen phal cher chad med/ 'jam dbyangs dkar po/ gro lod/ pak+shi bla sgrub/ thugs sgrub bar chad kun sel/ 'jam mgon bla ma'i gsang thig bla sgrub skor bcas bsnyen sgrub las gsum/ smin gling rdor sems/ rata gling phur pa dang tshe

142 'jam mgeni rkang sprul sku phreng gny-is pa'i rnam thar/gsang / 'chi med 'phags ma'i snying thig gi bsnyen sgrub las gsum cha tshang /zur gter tshe sgrub sogs rnying ma'i bka' gter mang po'i bsnyen sgrub/ kai tshang rgyal rgyam/ phag mo lha lnga/ bde mchog rnams bsnyen sgrub sbyin sreg bcas shin tu tshad ldan/ lta'idi skabs byin rlabs kyi tshan kha gzhan dang ma 'dra ba'i gzim lam gsal por byung ba'i zhal 'phros kyang thos lags/ mchan/) mgon po ber gyi bsnyen sgrub las gsum/ bskyed rdzogs nan tan dang / blo sbyong don bdun ma/ phyag rgya chen po lhan cig skyes sbyor rnams dus rgyun nyams bzhes gnad smin 'bral med/ nā ro chos drug lus sbyong sogs snga rjes 'ga' rer yun ring por nyams bzhes rgyun chad med par mdzad cing / bka' brgyud gong ma rnams dang skyabs mgon bco lnga pa'i mtshan gsan pa tsam gyis spyan chab de ma thag g.yo ba'i mos gus khyad par can mnga' bas mtshon bskyed rdzogs sa lam gyi mngon rtogs mthon por byung thog lam rtags kyi yon tan mngon du gyur pa gdon mi za'o/ /de lta na'ang dam pa 'dis ni sngon byon bka' gdams kyi skyes bu dag gi rnam thar lhur bzhes pas rang nyid kyi yon tan sa 'og gi gter bzhin shin tu sba bar mdzad pas zhib bar brjod du ma mchis kyang dgos pa dang 'brel skabs gsung gi zur tsam phebs pa rnams dang rang gzhan gyi mthong thos yid ches can rnams bkod na/sku chung ngu'i dus nas mngon shes mnga' tshul dge rgan bla mas yang yang gsungs pa dang / zur mang nas rdo zhig la zhabs rjes gsal nges dod pa/ gter mdzod snga ma yang khrod du gnang skabs tshe dbang mda' 'phel ma'i skabs mda' mtho gang dang sor gsum tsam ring 'dug pa der 'dus kun gyi mthong snang du grub/dbyar kha zhig la char dkon che bas char slong zhu skabs/ cho ga gang yang ma

kun khyab snyan pa'i ba dan/ 143gsungs shing nye gnas tshos char chog gnang bar gsol ba 'debs par ma gsan nas gzims te bzhugs pas re zhig nas char shin tu chen po babs/ mgon po'i skong mdos sogs yun ring gsung skabs/ grwa 'bor zhig gis mgon po 'di nyid kyis sgrub drags pas da tsam zhal gzigs yod las che zhes zhus par/ zhal gzigs lung bstan ci 'ang med/ skabs skabs su rmilam du mi gzhon chas bzang 'ga' res dga' ba'i nyams dang bcas g.yog byed pa'i tshul rmis pa dam can rdo rje legs pas grogs 'dra mdzad ltas e yin snyam gsungs/ yang char dkon skabs chu mig mgo mang du char slong du phebs pas 'phral du char babs lugs ngo mtshar ba dang / yang khrod sgrub khang gsar bskrun skabs 'gyel dogs gtan nas med pa zhig la khang pa 'di 'gyed nges pa red/ mi gsad 'ongs nges pas 'dir su'ang ma sdod gsungs/ shing mkhan rnams kyis lta rtog byas nas mi 'gyel nges pa red zhus kyang 'gyel 'ong gsungs/ mi med skabs zhig la 'phral du 'gyel song bas kun mngon shes yod par yid ches 'dug dbus phebs rjes mar bod du bzhugs skabs mnal lam la bsnyad pa'i phyis kyi dus 'gyur 'di'ang ji bzhin lung bstan yod 'dug la/ yang khrod du bzhugs skabs shig dpal dga'i bu mo zer ba rdzi bor song ste khyim du 'ong rgyu med stabs/ nyin shas mtshams su rje 'dir bka' brtag gnang rogs zhus par/ ngos la mo 'debs srol mi dar/ 'on kyang dpyad na rnyed rgyu yod pa mi 'dra bas dge rtsa gal che gsungs pa ltar/ phyis gtan nas rnyed rgyu yod ma song / sngar tsha ba rong du gdul byar phebs skabs 'das la nye bar bsnyungs pas tho rangs mnal dang 'od gsal 'dres pa zhig tu rje btsun yid bzhin 'khor lo mjal ba/ phyag g.yas skyabs spyin gdengs tsam mdzad de

144 'jam mgon kong sprul sku phreng gnyis pa'i rnam thar/'jigs pa kun las skyob par bgyi'o gsungs pa la/ da res mi 'chi ba 'dra zhes dang / yang ma bsnyun gong mtshur phu'i mgon khang gi mgon po der sku rdul gyis g.yogs nas skya sang nger byung ba rmis zhes drung rin po che gong ma chos kyi nyin byed la 'jam mgon rin po ches gsungs 'dug 7yid bzhin nor bu thugs thag ma bcad gong tsam la 'jam mgon rin po ches/ rgyal dbang rin po che'i mchog sprul ga na phebs 'ongs dgongs te yod pa'i nub gcig rmi lam du rgyal dbang dngos su mjal bar sku gshegs zin pa thugs dran sos pas/ rje nyid da lta zhing khams gang du bzhugs yod zhus pas/ da lta nga sangs rgyas kun dang dbyer med du yod gsungs/ sprul sku gang du phebs zhus pas/ 'dan a thub tshang rtsar yod ces gsungs pa rmis tshul gzhan la gsungs 'dug khra 'gur phebs skabs/ khra legs yab gzhis bran 'khor mag pa shi bar 'jam mgon rin po che phebs pa yar lam ban chen dgon du mnyan pa rin po che'i mdun byon te gzim mal du bzhugs nas bka' mol skabs phran la rmi lam legs po med/ kha sang thugs rje chen po bcu gcig zhal gyi sku mda' tshad gcig dbu nas gas te skyon zhugs pa yar gso thub ma song bas phran yang cung zad na 'dug shi 'dra song na khyed phebs tsam byung na blo bde che zhes gsungs/ rjes su bsnyun tshad lci skabs khong phebs pas gsung 'byon mdzad mi 'dug kyang spyan cer gyis gzigs te zhal 'dzum tsam gnang bar/ rgyal dbang bco lnga pa'i mtshan nas bos shing thugs dam gsol 'debs zhus pas thugs dgyes nyams kyis zhal ras 'dzum mdangs bcas dgongs pa 'od gsal du bsdus song gsungs/ khra 'gu nas dgongs pa rdzogs rgyu'i gsung 'phros mang po dbu mdzad la phab pa phran shi nas skye ba bod du len nges/

kun khyab snyan pa'i ba dan/ 145myur du 'phrad yong gsungs/ gang du 'khrungs zhus pas7rgyal dbang rin po cher bka' 'dri zhus gsungs/ gdan sa mtshur phu'i lo rgyus kho na gsungs/ de'i sgar la gzigs mo yang yang gnang 'dug ces thos/ zur mang rnam rtser rin chen gter mdzod dbang lung skabs mtshams mtshams slob ma rnams la bka' bslab khrid kyi tshul du yang yang gsung skabs phran la 'jam mgon rin po che'i sprul sku zhes mtshan du gsol ba'i don/ rje gong ma'i mdzad rjes gtso bo mdzod chen rnam lnga 'di 'chad spel ci nus su thub dgos red/ phran gyis da lo rin chen gter mdzod 'chad pa 'di thengs gsum pa yin/ da phan 'chad e thub mi shes/ phran lo brgyar bsdad kyang 'khor lo gsum gyi bstan pa la bya ba 'di las lhag mi yong /da bya ba ma 'grub pa gang yang med/ khyed rnams kyis dbang lung thob pa'i don go rtsa gsum bsnyen sgrub/ yar mar gyi tshes bcu/ rten sdom gsum gtsang ma/ khyad par phyag rdzogs nyams len dgos tshul/ da lta chos zhu ba 'di 'dra slad nas dkon po yin lugs bsam nas legs par nyan dgos sogs bka' snga phyi du ma bstsal song zhes slob ma rnams kyis gsungs/ khra 'gu na bsnyun tshabs ches lci skabs/ g.yu brag rtogs ldan zhes pa'i bla rgan sngags 'chang smyon pa lta bu nyams len thugs dam bzang po can gter sras tshe dbang nor bu'i slob ma zhig yod pa de'i yab mchog gling gi gdung zin gter slob cig red zer bas/ bla rgan smyon pa lta bu de sku mdun bcar te zhabs brtan phul bar yon dge'i gro lod zlog pa gsungs/ sngar nas zhal 'dris che bas 'jam mgon rin po che'i sku mdun du yang yang phebs te zhabs pad brtan dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan/ zhabs pad brtan thabs gang gzab yang yang zhu skabs shig zhal rtsed lta bus 'o da nga ni jo nang rje btsun

146 'jam mgon kong sprul sku phreng gnyis pa'i rnam thar/gyi sprul sku yin pas zhabs brtan gzhon nu ma'i ston mo zhig las phan thabs gzhan mi 'dug gsungs zhes bla rgan des zer 'dug da de 'dra dgon pa red/stabs sgrig mi dgos gsungs zer/ bla rgan des stabs ma 'grig zer/ dgung grangs lnga bcu pa'i keg rgyab 'dir7rgyal ba'i dbang po bcu drug pa chen pos kyang rtsub par gsungs skad dang / rje rang nas kyang dogs pa cher mdzad nas sku mtshams ring sdom mdzad rgyu gtan khel yin kyang / khra legs rin po che sngar nas bla slob chos dam sel med song gshis de nyid sku gshegs pa la thugs ngal che ba'i tshul bzhes gdan 'dren nan tan ngor phebs dgos byung song ba ni sku rkyen ldog tu med pa'i de ma thag rkyen lta bur gyur song zhing / der phebs khar/ yon tan phun tshogs la nga yi dge rgan khyed yin/ 'on kyang 'brog phrug don dam la yi ge slob skabs khyed kyis rna ba bkog 'dug pas de tsam brdung ma 'ong zhes pa dang /bla rgan karma la'ang nga shi tshar dus khyed kyis ma ṇi gsungs shog ces dang / bud+dha chibs skyel du skyod skabs sku gshegs rgyu'i zhal 'phros gnang rjes a cang ku re byas pa yin/ gzim chung lha khri las spyad shing sogs 'di dang 'di 'dra gyis sogs gsungs 'dug gzhan grwa 'khesar rnams la'ang bsnyun gzhi ma bzhes gong nas zhing phebs rgyu'i gsung kho na phab yod 'dug go 'dan khog nas yar phebs skabs/ ser la zhes pa'i steng dbu mdzad bla ma la mi rtag pa sgom zhing e yod gsungs/ ci'ang dran gyi med zhus pa/ rang re rnams lhan rgyas mar lam 'di nas e yong ngam bsam gsungs/ gzhan yang ma 'ongs lung du ston pa dang / gzhan sems shes pa'i mngon mkhyen sogs rang gzhan rnams yid ches pa mang po mthong thos su gyur pa mang yang 'dir de tsam gyis mtshon par byas so/ /

kun khyab snyan pa'i ba dan/ 147karma lha steng du sgrub khang gsar bzheng byed nye ba na/ sa cha shin tu nyams dga' ba yod kyang der chu med pas bzo thabs bral ba la/ rje 'di phebs nas sa cha 'dir rkos dang chu yod 'dra gsungs/ der brkos pas chu zad med babs/ da lta de 'thung chu yin par grags/ tshul de lha steng bla ma bsod dar zhes pas mi mang yod sar bshad pas/ rje 'di'i zhal nas khong gis de 'drar chu yod par ga la shes/ khyed tsho la rkos shog sogs gsungs pa rnams mi dran gsungs/ 'dan khog tu phebs skabs shig la bu chung lkugs pa zhig la chibs srab bskon pa sogs rtsed mo lta bu'i byin rlabs mdzad de phebs/ de rjes kha grags rgyu yod pa byung /'on kyang sems kha mtho dman 'dra zhig yod par/ yang rjes su rje 'di'i zhabs pad du bcar nas rje nyid kyis lkugs phyes pa ltar sems 'di'ang rnal ma zhig mdzad thub zhus pas/ nged kyis sngar de 'dra byas pa'ang mi dran/ shes kyang mi shes gsung skad/ rje rang gi ma yum la sras gsar 'khrungs srir gyur pa dang / deng skabs kyi 'dam dkar dul mo sprul sku 'di bcas sri bu 'ga' re lha mo bu rdzi ma'i rten mdos kyi sgo nas srung bar mdzad pa dang / nad pa gdon chen sogs la rje 'di'i dbu skra dang phyag zhabs sen mo'i cha shas bdug pas 'phral der phan pa/'go nad ngan pa khrus chu gsang chab sogs kyis srung nus pa dang / bka' bsgo bden tshig tsam gyis snod bcud kyi nyes pa zhi ba sogs phra mo lta ci smos/ snyigs dus kyaikla klo mtha' dmag bstan dgra dam sri'i rigs kyi gdug pa'i tsha ngar yang re zhig bag la zha bar 'gyur pa'i nus stobs mnga' ba tshad mas grub bo/ /chos gling rdo rje dgon pa'i nye 'dabs rdo rje 'gag tu 'dre gnas par grags pa'i pha waṃ zhig yod pa der rje nyid byon bzhugs mdzad pa rgyang ring rdzi bo dag gis mthong /

148 'jam mgon kong sprul sku phreng gnyis pa'i rnam thar/der lta bar phyin pas pha waṃ del zhabs rjes shin tu gsal ba byon pa da lta'ang yod/ a thub yab gzhis su phebs skabs shig der bzhed skong grub nas chibs hrag phyir theg ste rgyang tsam na rje nyid kyi chibs slar log khang pa'i 'og de nas chibs pas pus tshugs shig byas song / der 7rgyal dbang bcu drug pa 'khrungs yod rtags su 'dug ces de skabs grwa 'khor rnams gleng / yang khrod sgrub khang gsar bzheng skabs/ rje 'jam mgon gong ma'i gzim spyil bang chung bzhugs khri bcas shar phyogs mgon khang steng du bzhag de gar gzim spyil 'dra zhal sprul ba'i lha bzo lta bu gnas bzang kar 'brug la gsar du bzhengs rgyu bcol bar mdzad pa 'dis/ dbu zhwa phud pa de skabs ci yin ma nges kyang / phyis brtags dus rje 'di dbus phebs rjes ma'i skabs mtshur gdan nas slar gdan sa 'dir phebs rgyu'i sgar theg pa'i zla tshes dang 'grigs 'dug go /sngar sku chung dus phyag dpe 'bru 'ded thabs chag tsam las mi dgongs skabs/ thugs chen gsang 'dus kyi sgrub chen zhig gi rdor slob mdzad/ sngar nas sbyong rgyu sogs mdzad ma grub pas nye gnas bla ma karma nyid bag skrag che skabs/ gtor thun dang dbang sogs bla rgan rnams zil gyis gnon par gsung rgyu yod pa byung ba dang / phyis sgrol ma rnal 'byor ma'i dbang zhig gnang skabs gzhan las khyad thon pa'i gsung lugs bcas la bla rgan rang ngo mtshar shin tu che ba byung ste thugs kyi gting nas dad pa dbang med skyes yod 'dug kyang 'di dang 'di zhes zhib par mi gsung ngo / /lar sngon dus rje rang nyid kyis rang gi khengs pa skyung ba'am dman sa bzung dgos pa'i tshul lta bus bdag ni so skye 'ching ba kun ldan stes dbang gis dam pa'i skye sprul du sgro btags pa las/ rang blo lkog gyur min gshis yin rlom gyi nga rgyal

kun khyab snyan pa'i ba dan/ 149med/ 'on kyang rgyal ba yab sras kyi rdo rje'i gsung rnam pa thams cad pa tshad mar 'dzin pa las 'os ma mchis pas gong sprul kyi mtshan btags pa 'di drang don 'dra yin 'dog kha zhes rgyun du gsung zhing / gsung mgur las kyang /rang mgo rang gis g.yogs pa'i bzang brdzu can/ /ma nges gang byung spyod pa'i tho co can/ /ngan dgu ma tshang med pa'i ser gos can/ /'chi snyam yid la med pa'i shrī'i ming / /da lta mi lus rin chen thob pa dang / /sangs rgyas kun dang bla mas rjes su bzung tshang la ma nor dam pa'i chos dang mjal/ /de lta na yang tshe 'di'i brel bas g.yeng / /bsam phug chos brgyad re ba'i 'dun nyes po/ /bslab sdom rtswa bzhin dor ba'i snying med khyod/ /do dgong mi 'chi'i gdeng tshad med bzhin du/ /yun ring grabs shom byed pa'i rtag 'dzin mkhan/ /phyi nang snod bcud skad cig mi rtag 'gyur/ /sgos su tshe 'di nam mkha'i glog dang 'dra/ /cis kyang mi phan 'chi ba 'ongs nges pas/ /de dus mi 'gyod dam chos sgrub re ran/ / spyir na 'gro drug gnas kun bde ba med/ /da lta mtho ris mi yi dpal thob kyang / /

150 'jam mgon kong sprul sku phreng gnyis pa'i rnam thar/na rga 'chi ba'i sdug bsngal mi bzad pa/ /rang gi thog tu babs bzhin da dung yang / /bde bar rlom nas snyom las 'dug pa 'di/ /gdon gyis zin nam snying dang bral lam ci/ /'di phyi kun tu dge ba'i dam pa'i chos/ /byar med phyag rgya chen po'i nyams len skyongs/ /mig ltos yar lta gong ma'i rjes su snyogs/ /tshe 'di'i 'dun ma mkhan dang blo ma bstun/ /zhes sogs gsungs rnga ltar kho na dang / phyis 'dir sku ma gshegs pa'i snga lo tsam la nye gnas rnam par gsung ba'i zol gyis/ khyed tshos sngar gyi bla ma mar mi dwags gsum lta bu dang / phyis mjal zhing dbang chos thob yul gyi bla ma rnams yon tan che chung ngam/ bzang ngan gyi dbye ba chen po yod snyam pa de log rtog kho na red/rang gi snang ba dag ma dag gi khyad par las bla ma rang gi ngos nas bzang ngan gyi dbye ba spu tsam yod re zhes dbu bsnyung bzhes so/ /de ni spyir rje rang nyid kyis dag snang kho na gzigs pa'i ngo skal du bla ma rdo rje 'chang lta bu las tha mal gyi snang ba shar ma myong ba'i gsung los yin cing / bye brag rje rang nyid gong ma de rnams dang mnyam pa'i yon tan nyams rtogs la mnga' brnyes pa'i spobs pas mi 'jigs seng ges ri sgra sgrog pa zhal gyis bzhes pa'ang cis kyang mngon no/ /thams cad mkhyen pa rgyal dbang bcu drug pas kyang /

kun khyab snyan pa'i ba dan/ 151yon tan gzhi ma tshul khrims rnam par dag /chos kyi rtsa ba gzhan phan byang sems can/ /mdo don snying po gnyis snang 'khrul ba zhig /rgyal sras 'jam mgon bla mar gsol ba 'debs/ /zhes skyabs rje mchog gi ngang tshul ji lta bar snying nas gsol ba btab pa'o zhes rdo rje'i gsung gis bsngags par mdzad pas mtshon no/ /grub pa'i rtags kyi nang nas khyad par du 'phags pa'am 'khrul ba med pa ni nyams dang rtogs pa'i yon tan thugs rgyud la ji ltar zhabrungs pa dag yin la/ de yi tshul ni so so'i skye bo las dang po bas mthong zhing brjod mi nus kyang rje rang gi gsungs sogs las rjes su dpog pa sa bcad ma stong tsam 'bri bar bya'o/ /de yang sku na phra zhing dpe cha slob sbyong rgya cher ma mdzad pa'i dus na'ang sems don gyi zhal gdams tshigs bcad brtsams pa thams cad mkhas pa sus gzigs kyang ngo mtshar skye ba/ de yang nyams myong gi dmar khrid can du gsungs pa sogs kha shas ni dgongs gter yin snyam pa'ang mjal/ nye gnas bla rgan karma la gsungs par/sgis nang zhes pa'i ri ngogs shig nas phebs skabs rang sems la sku gsum tshang tshul ji bzhin rtogs pas sngar gyi de go ba zhig red 'dug ces dang / zur mang drung pa'i mdun du sku rten zhig la rab gnas mdzad skabs snang sems 'dres nas ye shes pa dngos su bzhugs song ba'i nges shes brtan po drung rin po che la'ang zhus pas thugs dgyes par gyur/ 'on kyang de dus nyams shig yin 'dug pas phyis su de 'dra'i rtog pa'ang med song gsungs/ yang dil yag sgrub dpon bla ma

152 'jam mgon blo gros mtha' yas/la gsungs par/ sngar yab rje rgyal dbang mkha' khyab rdo rje'i mdun nas sgrol dkar tshe khrid zhib par gsan/ phyis su de'i skabs shig gi gsung bshad gnang tshul tshig de lhang nger dran pas rkyen byas rang sems kyi ngo bo rjen pa de ji bzhin mthong ba byung ngo zhes bka' bstsal ba dang / rje rang gi gsung las/rje 'gro ba'i mgon po karma pa/ /dpal mkha' khyab rdo rje snying nas dran/ /dus lan gcig mi lus rin chen thob/ /rje 'gro ba'i mgon pos rjes su bzung / /pha bka' brgyud kyi man ngag lhug par bstsal/ /chos phyag rgya chen po'i ngo sprod thob/ /bu sgom sran chung yang byin rlabs babs /nyams rtogs pa gong 'phel ngo mtshar che/ /nad ngan pas mnar te 'chi la thug /sems gzhi rtsa bral ba'i bog 'don dang / /don gnas lugs rtogs pa'i grogs su gyur/ /da 'chi ba zer ba'i 'jigs rngam la ya nga ba'i blo dang bral nas mchis/ /da de yang pha gcig de yi drin/ /tshe 'dus byas kyi dbang du ma song bar/ /gtang rag tu sgrub pa'i mchod pa 'bul/ /

kun khyab snyan pa'i ba dan/ 153sgrub brgyud kyi bstan pa'i srog shing 'dzin/ /da rdo rje 'chang dang dbyer med par/ / mkha' mnyam gyi 'gro ba'i dpal du shog /ces dang / rgyal ba'i dbang por rtags 'bul sogs phul ba ni /rigs kun khyab bdag dang po'i sangs rgyas mchog /dpal ldan bla ma 'bral med snying dbus bsnyen/ /rgyal mchog gang gis 'bangs mthar snyeg pa yi/ /snyom las chos gzugs 'du shes gsum pa la/ /bong ba gser gzigs rjes brtse'i rigs bdag tu/ /bzhes pa 'di ko e ma sngon smon mthu/ /'bad pas ma yin lhun grub rten 'brel rmad/ /gang gi bka' bzang spyi gtsug rgyan nyid du/ /blangs nas sems don rtogs pa'i glu chung 'di/ /'phags mchog dgyes pa'i rol mor mchod pa 'bul/ /dang por mi rtag sdug bsngal 'dus byas chos/ /snying po med pa'i bsam pa khong nas sha ra/ /bar du yang dag lam la rab zhugs nas/ /'bor ba spang dang myang 'das blang byar go /da lta 'khor 'das mnyam pa'i gdeng zhig rnyed/ / chos rnams thams cad ye shes chos sku'i rtsal/ /

154 'jam mgon blo gros mtha' yas/rig dang ma rig so mtshams skad cig ma/ /'khrul grol kun gyi rtsa ba rang gi sems/ /da lta'i shes pa spang bsgyur bzo ma bcos/ /rang babs ngang gnas stong gsal ma 'gag pa/ /phyis snang ma lus nang du 'dzin sems stong / /snang ba stong pa gnyis su dbye ba bral/ /zung 'jug tshig gis mi mtshon blo las 'das/ /mtha' bral ming brgyas mtshon pa'i gnas lugs don/ /mdo sngags bskyed rdzogs thabs brgyas gnyer ba yi/ /sangs rgyas da lta'i sems las med par 'khrungs/ /mgon khyod ye gdod gong nas rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /nyam thag 'gro ba'i dpal du miyi zol /rim bgrod lam gyi ngal bar ma ltos kyang / /tshur mthong snang ngor gdams ngag rnam thar du/ /ston phyir thugs dam rim 'khrungs tshul 'di yang / /ro gcig chen po sgom med yar ldan nyams/ /nges par gzigs la rgan bu yi rangs shing / /dad gus spro ba'i thal mo snying gar zum/ /nyin mtshan dus kun bzod med mos gus dang / /lus rten 'di yis bstan don grub bo snyam/ /rdo rje 'chang dngos gang gi dgongs pa'i bcud/ /

kun khyab snyan pa'i ba dan/ 155pha nor bu la phog pa'i nyams bzang la/ /bka' brgyud gser gyi phreng ba'i bzhugs gral du/ /ra gan gser du brdzu ba'i sel ma zhugs/ /phyogs dus rgyal bas dbyings nas mkhyen no snyam/ /mkha' 'gro chos skyong rnams kyis spyan gyis gzigs/ /bdag kyang sgom med chos sku'i rgyal thabs cher/ /rang byung khyab bdag rig pa'i rdo rje dang / /dbyer med thugs yid 'dres par thugs rjes zungs/ /dge bas rgyal bstan mdzes pa'i rgyan byed the(ga /ces pa 'di bzhin7rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen gzigs bcu drug pa chen pos bka' lung gser gyi cod pan spyi bor bcings te rang gis rtogs tshod maṇ+ḍal du phul zhing mchog gi thugs dam sa mtshams snyan sgron dang / gus 'bangs tha shal pa'ang mgon po mchog gi dgongs klong dang dbyer med pa'i smon tshig bcas bcos bsgyur med par rgyal sras 'jam mgon sprul skur 'bod pas shar mar bris te phul bar dgyes pa'i ye shes spyan gyi 'bab stegs su gyur cig ces dang / rang gi nyams myong ma sbas glu ru blangs pa rdzun chen 'khor lo zhes bya ba ni/dpal dang po'i sangs rgyas 'khor lo'i mgon/ /mgon rdo rje 'chang chen mi yi gzugs/ /pha bka' drin 'khor med karma pa/ /rje mkha' khyab rdo rje'i zhabs la 'dud/ /

156 'jam mgon kong sprul sku phreng gnyis pa'i rnam thar/bdag da lan dal 'byor mi lus thob/ /gzhi 'khor ba'i chos la nges 'byung skyes/ /yid dad pa drag pos lam la zhugs/ /rgyud byang chub sems kyis yongs su gtams/ /dus dang por nyams len skyong tsa na/ /sems rnam rtog bkag nas mi rtog bsgoms/ /dus bar du rnam rtog ngo bo bltas/ /yid 'gyu ba bar snang bser bu bzhin/ /yengs ma yengs dran pas rgyang so btsugs/ /dus deng sang snang grags rtog pa'i chos/ /tshogs drug gi rtog tshogs ji snyed pa/ /gang shar yang chos nyid gnyug ma'i klong / /blo rtsol bas ma lhad rang babs gshis/ /sems gdod ma'i gnas lugs mtshar po che/ /rang rtsol bas rtogs pa ma yin te/ /pha bka' brgyud bla ma'i byin rlabs dang / /mchog rdo rje 'chang dbang thugs rje yis/ /mi tha mal sems las sangs rgyas rnyed/ /sems 'dzin gtad kyi sgom pa rang sar stor/ /blo bag yangs kyi rnal 'byor tha mal pa/ /pha bla ma mnyes pa'i mchod pa 'bul/ /

kun khyab snyan pa'i ba dan/ 157gnas 'og min chos dbyings pho brang na/ /mgon rdo rje 'chang chen skad pa de/ /bu rang gi sems la yongs su rdzogs/ /tshul kun rdzob kyi snang ba mi 'gog pas/ /yid 'gyu ba dga' sdug ltad mor che/ /don blang dor bral ba e ma ho/ /zhes pa'ang rgyal dbang rdo rje 'chang gis rjes su bskyangs pa'i 'bangs dpal ldan mkhyen brtse 'od zer gyis thol byung du smras pa'i rang mtshang gcer ston mkhas pa khrel ba'i rol mor bris pa e ma ho zhes gsungs pa mtshon byed dang / sku gshegs khar nye gnas shig gis thugs ma g.yeng zhus yod 'dug pas de 'dra zhu mi dgos pa'i phyag gis brda mdzad/ sku gshegs nas ring tsam song rjes sangs rgyas mnyan pa rin po ches bla ma rnams kyi mtshan nas bos pas/ 7rgyal dbang mkha' khyab rdo rje mkhyen no zhes gsungs skabs spyan gyis gzigs nas 'dzum tsam mdzad pa la slar thugs dam gsal 'debs kyi spros pa sogs ma mdzad pa gong smos ltar ro/ /de ni mkhas pa chen po zhig gis gzhi yi 'od gsal ngos zin nas thugs dam du bzhugs pa'i ring la dbugs chad zin kyang 'dzum rgyu sogs yod par bshad pa sngar thos pa dang shin tu 'grigs 'dug ces bla rgan karmas gsungs so/ /gzhan yang gzhan la zhal gdams gnang ba zhig kyang 'di ltar/mkha' khyab nam mkha'i rdo rje chos sku yi bla ma/ /

158 'jam mgon kong sprul sku phreng gnyis pa'i rnam thar/kha sbyor bde ba chen po longs sku yi bla ma/ /sna tshogs 'gro don mdzad pa sprul sku yi bla ma/ /sku gsung dbyer med rdo rje 'chang dbang de mkhyen no/ /rang re sngon smon bzang pos rgyal bstan dang mjal zhing / /sgrub brgyud bstan sgor zhugs nas mtshan ldan gyi rje btsun/ /bla ma mchog gis bskyangs shing gdams zab ni gnang ba'i/ /skal bzang 'di 'dra u dum wā ra las dkon pa'i/ / rnyed pa mchog 'di thob pa ngo mtshar las ngo mtshar /'on kyang 'dus byas mi rtag sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin/ / sang tsam mi 'chi chog pa'i rang dbang ni med bzhin/ /'chi ba gnam lcags lhung 'dra glo bur du 'ong gi /dam chos sang bya gnangs bya'i long skabs kyis dben pas/ /da lta da lta dam pa'i lha chos la gshegs dang / /sus kyang ma bcos lhun grub rdo ba yi khang bu/ /yab mes rgyal ba'i bzhugs gnas mi med kyi dgon par/ /'di snang sems khral bor la da lta rang gshegs dang / /kha zas log 'tshos ma sbag lo ldum dang bcud len/ /gang byung de gas chog pa'i chog shes kyi nor ldan/ /bse ru bzhin du gnas pa'i dam bca' zhig phul sgortog /skyabs kyi mchog gyur kun 'dus drin chen gyi bla ma/ /
