kun khyab snyan pa'i ba dan/ 159yid bzhin nor bu rin chen mos gus kyis bsten na/ / 'di gtan dbul sel 'phral yun legs tshogs kyi dpal 'byor/ /nam yang mi 'dzad chos sku'i rgyal thabs la bsgyur zhing / /lhar bcas skye rgu'i mchod 'os dam pa ru 'gyur bar/ /tshad med lung de mdo sngags thams cad nas yang yang / /mgrin gcig bsngags pa'i zab lam rnal 'byor la brtson cig /ka dag spros pa bral ba'i gzhi gnas kyi ye shes/ /kha tsam na yam min par thos bsam gyis gzhig ste/ /ga dar yang yang byas pa'i sgom pa la 'dud tshe/ /nga dang nga yir 'dzin pa'i phyi rjes su ma 'brang / /ca rer da lta'i shes pa so ma la ltos dang / /cha shas blo yis dpyad pa'i sdug sgom de ma byed/ /ja yun tsam yang ma yengs rang sa ru glod mdzod/ /nya mo chu nang nam byung lta ba dang 'dra de/ /ta thā ga ta'i dgongs min blun rmongs kyi u tshugs/ /tha chad rnam rtog sgrug pa'i bya ra de ma byed/ /da lta'i gsal rig ma bcos tha mal gyi shes pa/ /na mar 'dzin med ma bcos rang lugs su bzhag pas/ /pa ri pu ri'i rtog tshogs gang shar gyi gya gyu/ /pha rol spangs pa'i logs nas chos sku zhig ma re/ /ba 'jo tsam du gnas pa'i dran med kyi gti mug /

160 'jam mgon kong sprul sku phreng gnyis pa'i rnam thar/ma rig lung ma bstan de phyag chen du ma rloms/ /tsa na ka yi 'bras tsam 'dzin pa yi cha shas/ /tsha ba me stag phra mosna me phud kyi rgyu bzhin/ /dza dzor 'brul ba'i rgyu las ye shes de ma yin/ /wa ler 'dzin med ma bcos shar grol gyi gu yangs/ /zhwa nag gser mdangs can gyi bla ma yi dgongs bcud/ /zab gsal yid la mi byed mda' bsnun gyi bzhed gzhung / /'a cag rnams kyi snying nor don brgyud kyi pha phog /ya mtshan rang zhal mjal ba'i smon lam zhig zhu'o/ /ra ba gangs ri'i khrod 'dir rgyal bstan gyi snying po/ /la chen sgrub brgyud rka tshang byin rlabs kyi tshan kha/ /sha shob brjod 'dod tsam min 'gran zla dang bral ba/ /sa lam rtsis bgrang mi dgos rtogs grol 'di e ma/ /ha cang brjod pa mang po bsam gtan gyi tsher ma/ /ha lam gang shar mdor bsdus zol med kyi glu chung / /a la la ho rjes 'jug dga' ston du spel bas / /a don skye med mkha' khyab rdo rje yi go 'phang / /tshe 'di nyid la 'grub pa'i bden tshig cig zhu'o/ /zhes pa sgrub brgyud nges don snying po'i ring lugs 'dzin pa'i chos sde chen po khra 'gu bkra shis chos gling gi blo gros chos 'byor gyis bskul ngo ma ldog phyir rgyal

kun khyab snyan pa'i ba dan/ 161sras dpal ldan mkhyen brtse 'od zer gyis gang dran ri mor thal ba dge bar gyur cig ces sogs nyams bzhes rtogs mgur gyi skor dang / zhal gdams bslab bya'i skor/ nyer mkho sna tshogs pa'i skor bcas gsung rtsom pusti che gras gnyis tsam yod 'dug kyang da lta pusti gcig tsam las ma dpe bzhugs mi 'dug go /'on kyang de rigs las ngo mtshar ba'i gsung don zab rgyas kyi snying pos lci ba sha stag yod 'dug pa zhib mjal bgyid na blo ldan rnams kyis rje 'di'i thugs rgyud la yon tan ci tsam yod pa shes nus so/ / gsum pa gzhan la 'chad spel gyi phrin las rgya che ba dang / skyong ba'i slob tshogs dam pa mang po las ji ltar rigs pa mtshan gyi rnam grangs tsam smos na/rgyal dbang mkha' khyab rdo rjes/khyed ni don brgyud bstan pa'i srog 'dzin te/ /bka' brgyud gdams zab smin grol mdzod khang nas/ /snyan brgyud yid bzhin nor bu'i gter longs la/ /sgrub brgyud rgyal bstan tshugs shig grub pa'i dbang / /zhes gsungs pa ltar gong smos de rnams dang /khyed ni theg chen 'khor los bsgyur ba ste/ /gzhung gdams smin grol bka' yi chu bo bzhi/ /skal ldan yid kyi rgya mtshor phab nas kyang / /rgyal ba'i gdung brgyud gsob mdzod rigs pa 'dzin/ /

162 'jam mgon kong sprul sku phreng gnyis pa'i rnam thar/ces bka' bstsal ba'i don bzhin/ shes bya mdzod tshar gcig rje gong ma yon tan rgya mtsho'i bka' 'bum tshar gcig rgyal dbang mkha' khyab rdo rje'i bka' 'bum tshar gcig gdams ngag mdzod tshar gnyis/ gter mdzod tshar gsum/mar mi'i rnam mgur tshar mang po/ dwags po dang dus mkhyen bka' 'bum nas rgyal dbang theg mchog rdo rje bar bka' 'bum dang rgyun yod rigs bklags lung / kai tshang skor dang shangs chos skor dbang lung lan grangs mang po/ nā ro chos drug dang phyag chen khrid lan grangs mang ba/ blo sbyong dang thugs rje chen po'i sgom lung dmar khrid rnams dus rgyun du zhu mkhan mang / gzhan dbang lung khrid gsum bar med gnang ba gong gsal ltar dang / bka' brgyud sngags mdzod/ zur mang snyan brgyud pod lnga bka' 'gyur lung bcas gzhan la 'chad spel mdzad grub ma song pa tsam las tshur gsan rigs lan re gnyis ma chad pa med pa lta bu byung /de'ang zang zing tsam don du gnyer ba ma yin par bstan don kho nar sku ngal la ma lhos par gsal dag dal lhod go bab chags nges mdzad de/ dper na gter mdzod snga ma gsung dus phag mo'i dbang zhig gi byin 'bebs skabs slob ma zhig la byin phab nas lus 'dar ba dang 'phar ba ma zad gar stabs kyi rnam pas rgyug mchong byed cing / ngag gis ra la ya ra la ya sogs sngags sgra 'byin bzhin 'khrab byung bas gzhan 'gas bzung dgos pa byung ba dang / slob ma phal cher la'ang lus 'dar zhing sems la bde stong gi nyams 'char ba dbang phal cher la byung ngo / /mtshur phur rgyal ba'i dbang por rgyal rgyam dbang 'bul skabs sin+dha ra'i me long la hrīḥrnams rang byon du song ba da lta mtshur sgar rten sgam du bzhugs pa dang / tshe mda' mkhyud gang tsam ring ba byung / zur mang du gter mdzod gnang skabs/

kun khyab snyan pa'i ba dan/ 163dpon slob thams cad kyi mthun snang du mngon sum grub pa tshe mda' mdzub gang 'phel ba dang / 'pho lung gnang skabs rgan rgon mang po thun shi bog pa sogs rtags dang ya mtshan mang ba dang bcas pa'o/ /sku chung ngu'i dus gdan sa chen por khri 'don skabs/ tā si bcu gcig pa pad+ma dbang mchog rgyal pos 'bel gtam mdzad pa las/mdo sngags rgyal bstan yan lag dang bcas pa /'chad dang dbang skur man ngag khrid bcas pas/ /yongs su 'dzin dang spel la 'jigs bral gyi/ /rdo rje'i slob dpon chen por bzhugs par mdzod/ /khyad par ri bo'i khongs su'ang rab grags pa'i/ /mdzod chen rnam lnga'i chos kyi 'bor lo che/ /'dzam gling tha grur khyab pa'i 'chad spel ni/ /bye ba brgya stong bzlas pas dus 'da' mdzod/ /kho bo blo gros gzhon pas ma theg pa'i/ /chos kyi sgron mer bgyid 'os gang yin rnams/ /khyed kyi phyag tu bzhag pas bshad sgrub kyi/ /rgyal mtshan srid rtser bsgreng bar mdzad du gsol/ /zhes bskul bar mdzad pa ltar spyir 'chad spel phrin las rgya che zhing / bye brag rgyal ba'i dbang po bcu drug par byams mgon rin po che rang gis phul ma grub pa'i rin chen gter mdzod sogs rje 'dis 'bul bar mdzad do/ /des na gong gsal

164 'jam mgon kong sprul sku phreng gnyis pa'i rnam thar/rgyal dbang mkha' khyab rdo rje'i bka' dang / 'dir bshad ma thag pa'i byams mgon si tu'i gsung rnams kyi don rje 'dis ji bzhin grub cing de dag gis kyang snyan ngag mkhan gyi zlos gar tsam ma yin par ma 'ongs 'byung 'gyur gzigs pa'i gsung bstsal ba sogs tshad ma'i bla slob 'di dag la gzu bor gnas pa'i blo ldan dag gis brtags na ngo mtshar mi che ba'i gnas med do/ /mdor na shes bya'i gnas ma lus pa spyi dang / bye brag rgyal bstan yongs rdzogs kyi sdom mdzod chen rnam lnga sogs thos pa rgya che ba dang / de'i don rags pa tsam ma yin par zhib mor bsams pas gtan la phab/ bsgoms pas nyams rtogs kyi klong brdol/ mkhas pa phyogs re ma yin par mdo sngags spyi dang khyad par sngags kyi lta sgom gyi gnad/ tha na gar thig dbyangs gsum yan chad la 'gran zla dang bral/ btsun pa ngo lkog can ma yin par chos dang mdzad spyod zhu dag pher/ bzang po phyogs lhung med pa shin tu drang po'i thugs bsam rnam par dag pas dpyod ldan dang yun ring bsten pa dag gis lhag par bsngags/ 'chad pa'i tshe sku ngal la ma ltos par thog ma nas sbyong rtsol dpe gzigs zhib cha dang / dngos gzhi'i skabs su thogs pa med par mdzad/ rtsod pa dngos mdzad pa sku tshe 'dir med kyang bka' 'dri zhu ba po spobs pa can 'ga' res brgal brtag ci tsam byas kyang lung rigs kyi sgrub byed bcas the tshom sel nus/ rtsom pa na zhal gdams rnams ni snyan ngag sogs kyis rab btags ma yin par rang bzhin brjod pa go bde ba rgyal bas mdo rgyud las gsungs pa lta bu'i snyan 'jebs don ldan kho na 'byung / 'bul yig chab shog sogs skabs su babs na rab btags bsnyon dor gzugs rgyan sogs kyis bcings pa'i snyan ngag rtsom pa ches ya mtshan pa ste da lta

kun khyab snyan pa'i ba dan/ 165pod chen lhag tsam bzhugs so/ /mkhyen paliye shes kyis chos thams cad kyi gnas lugs ji lta ba gzigs pas gcig shes kun grol du gyur/ brtse ba'i thugs rjes bstan 'gro la phyogs lhung med pa'i phan pa 'ba' zhig dang / nus pas dam sri gdug pa can rnams kyang brlag par mdzad na gzhan lta ci smos so/ /de ltar gong du 'ga' zhig rgyas par bshad zin na 'dir thams cad mdor bsdus pa'o/ /slob ma'i tshogs kyang7rgyal dbang bcu drug pa chen po rang byung ye shes rig pa'i rdo rje/ dpa' bo bcu pa/ rgyal tshab lcog gra sprul sku/ 'brug yongs 'dzin dang / chos mgon/ dpal spungs mkhyen sprul/ rje dbon bsam sprul/ zur mang gar bstan drung gsum sogs skyes chen phal cher/ gnas mdo chags med mchog gling yang srid sogs bka' brgyud kar 'brug rnams dang / rdzong sar mkhyen brtse/rdzogs chen kaḥthog sogs kyi bla sprul ches mang ba gsar rnying ris med rnams dang / bla ma rin po che karma rang byung kun khyab sogs gdan sa chen po dpal mtshur gnyis kyi rdor slob mkhan po rnam pas gtsos sa kar rnying gsum gyi bla ma dge slong grangs mang / bod gzhung sa'i sku drag rgya mi kha shas/ 'brug pa/ 'bras ljongs pa/ sde dge rgyal blon sogs 'bangs sde skya ser pho mo bgrang gis mi lang pa dang / khyad par sku tshe gcig la lus dang grib ma'i tshul du mi 'bral bar gro lod sgrub phug sogs su sku mtshams bcad rgya snga rjes thugs dam nyams ba zhes mdzad rigs la/ bzang po spyod pa'i grogs tshangs pa mtshungs par spyod pa'i nye gnas bla rgan karma zhes pa tshe 'di blos btang zin pa'i bya bral 'khrul zhig chen po 'di nyid bcas mkhas dang grub pa'i skye bu'ang mang ngo / /

166 'jam mgon kong sprul sku phreng gnyis pa'i rnam thar/zhar byung rten gsum bzhengs pa'ang / gdan sa yang khrod 'dir kar rabs lha khang rten dang brten pa bcas sgrub sde gsar bzhengs la dpal chen lha khang / bla ma lha khang / thugs dam lha khang / mgon khang / 'bebs khang / drung khang /mtshams khang sogs dang / phyi nang yongs rdzogs la sku brnyan bris 'bur shin tu mang po/ 'jam mgon gong ma dang byams mgon pad+ma dbang mchog gi 'dra zhal byin ldan/ zhal thang che chung stong phrag nye ba/ karma dgon du dus mkhyen sku zangs gser tho can sogs/ gzhan yang sku rten rang gis bzhengs pa dang gzhan la bskul ba sogs stong phrag mang po ste/ dbus phebs rjes ma'i skabs kyang rje nyid dang sngar nas zhal 'dris che ba'i bla grwa rnams la/ da res dbus su song skabs nga la rten gsum thub dbang gtsos sku 'dra 'di dag dang rol sil sbus dag 'ga' re yod/ rgyu zas ci yod ni nye gnas gnyis po las ngas ci'ang mi shes gsungs pa bzang brdzu zol zog min nges kun la gsal ba ltar ro/ /gsung rten la'ang mdo rgyud bstan bcos 'don cha'i skor bris dpar khyon bsdoms pod yar brgal bzhugs/ thugs rten ni snga rjes mchod rten 'ga' re bzhengs yod 'dug pa dang /yang khrod 'dir sgrub pa po bco lnga tsam gsar du 'phar bar mdzad do/ /mjug bsdu dang bsngo smon/dngos kun khyab cing rtag pa'i sku ni mkha' khyab mtshan dpes spras/ /zla ba nyid kyang zhi bsil chos kyi bdud rtsi'i 'od snang spro/ /mtshungs pa med pa rnam grol lam gyi sa mkhan mchog gcig pu/ /mkhas grub bye ba'i gtsug rgyan gang der slar yang

kun khyab snyan pa'i ba dan/ 167snying nas 'dud/ /gang zhig mchog gi dpal dang ldan la kāl tsakra dang / /shes bya thams cad mkhyen cing gzigs la sarba dz+nyā bud+dhā/ /brtse ba'i 'od zer snyom par spro la kṛ pa de baḥste/ /phrin las rgya mtsho mkha' khyab gdal ba'i karma ka yang ngo / /phan bde'i snang chen sbar ba'i rgyal bstan nyi/ /chu lha'i phangs par phyogs tshe mkhyen rab kyi/ /cha shas yongs su gang ba'i 'od dkar can/ /snyigs ma'i rgud kun gshed du blo mtha' yas/ /gang de'i thugs bskyed yon tan rgya mtsho las /legs byung rnam thar pad+ma dkar po zhes/ /shas cher brtse bas brlan pa'i steng 'thung zhig /srid 'dir byung yang srid pa'i dri mas min/ /phyi ru brtan mkhas yongs rdzogs 'dul ba 'dzin/ /nang du byang chub spyod mchog rgyal ba'i sras/ /gsang ba dkyil 'khor dbang phyug rdo rje 'chang / /don dam srid zhi kun la khyab pa'i bdag /gang zhig mchog gi dpal yon zla med pas/ /'gro khams mdzes par byed pa'i snang ba ni/ /rmad byung 'gro ba'i mgon por bzhengs pa yi/ /rnam 'dren khyod 'dra'i rnam thar dpal du grub/ /mtshan dpe'i sku mchog chos gos gsum gyis mdzes par 'khyud/ /smra ba'i ngag la sde snod gsum gyis legs par spras/ /ye shes thugs la bskal pa gsum gyis rab tu mdzes/ /brtan ldan chos 'phags rnam thar kun nas brnyes par mdzad/ /sems dang sems byung rgyu ba chad cing yul dang yul can ngo bo log /rang bzhin gang du grub pa med cing yin min dbang pos shes pa med/ /mtha' dang bral ba tha mal shes pa 'od gsal phyag rgya chen po yi/ /rnam dag lta ba'iri dbang mthon por de nyid gzigs pa 'dzegs par gyur/ /dngos po kun la rab tu khyab pa dang / /bde gshegs 'gyur med rtag pa dam pa'i dbyings/ /rang byung rig rtsal gdod nas lhun grub pa/ /thugs dam

168 'jam mgon kong sprul sku phreng gnyis pa'i rnam thar/mthil du nges don snying pos dpa'/ /khyad par 'bras bu rdo rje theg pa'i lam /dbang 'byor zung 'jug grub pa'i sar bgrod nas/ /rdo rje 'chang dbang mkha' khyab rdo rje yi/ /go 'phang la ni bde blag nyid du gshegs/ /rim bgrod theg pa'i ngal brgyas ma nongs shing / /rtsol bcas lam la brten par ma byas kyang / /tha mal shes pa rang babs skyong kho nas/ /rang sar grol ba sgrub brgyud 'di'i khyad cesas/ /legs legs drang ngesan gzigs pa rgya che zhing / /mkhas mkhas smra lce bde 'gas gshe mod kyang / /mang mang grub pa'i ring lugs 'di kho na/ /yang yang thugs kyi dpal be'u'i bcud du gyur/ /rnam mkhyen rgyal ba'i ye shes yongs kyi gzugs/ /rang byung rig pa'i rdo rje'i thugs ka nas/ /nyid las gzhan min rigs bdag khyod sprul bas/ /chos kyi dbyings bde spros pa bral lam snyam/ /gsang ba 'dzin pa'i rnam thar gang yin mtha'/ /rdo rje 'dzin dbang gang gis bzlums pa na/ /'chad po nga yang nyan po nyid yin ces/ /dgongs pa rdo rjes gsang tshig gtol min nam/ /gang gis rgyal bstan yongs rdzogs mdzod chen lnga'i/ /pu sti nyid du bskyil ba'i cho ga ni/ /ha cang bsdus pa'i skyon de bsal slad du/ /khyod kyis rgyas par 'chad dang spel ba 'dra/ /ye nas grol la gsar thob ma mchis pa'i/ /lam ni ngang bzhag chen por dbang 'byor mang / /thabs tshul du mas drangs pas 'gro mang khams/ /srid pa'i khongs su da dung yod dam ci/ /rdo rje lus kyi rtsa rlung thig le'i 'gros/ /don dam dbu mar bstim pa'i thabs zab mo/ /reg bde med kyang zung 'jug grub pa ni/ /klu sgrub rje dang nyid kyi khyad par chos/ /deng dus thub bstan nyi mar dag snang gi /mig bral 'byung po'i bya rnams skad 'byin pas/ /dam chos 'dul ba'i tshangs spyod mi ldan na/ /sgrub kyang bstan don

kun khyab snyan pa'i ba dan/ 169mi 'grub sgro skur 'phel/ /de slad mkhas pa rang gi rjes slob dang / /phyis 'byung skye ba sprul sku'i ngo mtshar dpal/ /rje btsun rgyal sras bla ma'i rnam thar gyis/ /gdul bya'i lhag ma skyongs zhes gdams par nges/ /mdor na skad cig rer yang ting nge 'dzin/ /bye ba brgya ru 'jug cing ldang ba dang / /'gro mang de snyed sgrol ba'i cho 'phrul kyang / /brjod pa lta ci bsam yang ga la nus/ /'on kyang snyigs dus gdul bya phyogs re yi/ /blo dang mthun pa'i rnam thar gtam gtsang mas/ /lha dang bcas pa'i skye dgu rnam grol gyi/ /kun dga'i dga' ston dbyar gyi lang tsho bzhin/ /phyogs tsam mtshon pa'i rdzogs ldan sprin gyi gdugs/ /srid pa ji srid mkha' mthar brdal ba las/ /dge legs nor bu'i gru char zad med 'jo/ /skal bzang rgyal ba'i 'bras bzang bskyed pa'i rgyu/ /'du 'dzi bre mo'i gtam gyis dus 'da' bar/ /smras pa'i ngag kun 'khor ba ngan song rgyu/ /'di na brjod pa don ldan bla ma yi/ /rnam thar cung zad gleng ba'i skal bzang byung / /'on kyang ma sbyangs so so'i skye bo'i blo/ /ma rig rmongs pa'i dri dang rtag 'grogs phyir/ /'gal dang 'khrul ba ci mchis mthol bshags na/ /mkhas dbang dpyod ldan rnams kyis bzod par mdzod/ /khyad par rje 'di'i zhal slob mkhas grub tshogs/ /bha go ra tha'i dka' thub grub rnams kyis/ /nyes bshad kha dris rnyog pa bgrung ba dang / /dag byed gaṅgā'i chu rgyun 'bebs par zhu/ /zhes skabs don bshad pas mjug bsdus nas/slar yang /ngo bo 'od gsal bri gang bral ba'i ye shes ka dag chos kyi dbyings/ /rang bzhin lhun grub rdo rje snying po'i gangs can mtsho yi bkod pa 'bar/ /thugs rje'i 'phrul chen 'du mi mdzad par 'gro khams ji snyed don mang byed/ /gcig

170 'jam mgon kong sprul sku phreng gnyis pa'i rnam thar/pu'i bdag nyid du ma'i gar mkhan dkon mchog rtsa gsum 'dus pa'i dpal/ /de lta'i tshul la rab tu dang ba yis/ /bdag dang mkha' mnyam 'gro ba'i sgo gsum pa/ /rab gus gaṅgā'i rdul snyed nyid sprul nas/ /byang chub snying po'i bar du phyag 'tshal lo/ /rang gzhan dus gsum lus dang longs spyod dang / /dge tshogs dang bcas kun bzang mchod pa'i sprin/ /rab 'byams rgya mtsho'i zhing khams yong 'gengs pas/ /phyi ma'i mu mthar thug gi bar du mchod/ /bdag sogs 'gro bas thog med dus ring nas/ /bcas dang rang bzhin kha na ma tho'i sdig /bgyis dang bgyid bstsal rjes su yi rangs rnams/ /mi 'chab mi sbed mthol zhing bshags par bgyi/ /rgyal dang rgyal sras nyan rang so skye yi/ /dus gsum dge ba'i tshogs ni ji snyed dang / /dpal ldan bla ma'i rnam par thar pa la/ /bsam pa thag pas rjes su yi rang ngo / /sems can rnams kyi mos pa'i bsam pa dang / /blo yi bye brag ji lta de lta bu'i/ /che chung dang ni thun mong theg pa yi/ /chos kyi 'bor lo rgya cher bskor du gsol/ /sdug bsngal de rgyus gdung ba'i 'gro mang khams/ /ji srid de srid rtag pa dam pa'i sku/ /'pho 'gyur bri gang bral ba rdo rje yi/ /rang bzhin nyid du bzhugs par gsol ba 'debs/ /'di lta'i dge ba phun tshogs rang bzhin cha shas rdzogs pa'i ga bur 'dzin/ /'jig rten khams su rtag par 'char ba nub pa med pa'i 'od dkar pos/ /srid zhi'i bsod nams ma 'bad lhun grub yid bzhin 'jo ba dang 'grogs nas/ /bde legs dpyid kyi dpal dang yon tan byang chub kun da'i 'dab grol shog /bkra shis gang zhig dpal ldan bla ma'i rnam par thar bkra shis gang zhig srid zhi'i khyon kun yongs khyab pa'i/ /bkra shis snyan pa'i glu dbyangs rgya che lha yi rnga / /bkra shis ba dan phyogs las rnam par rgyal gyur cig /ces pa

kun khyab snyan pa'i ba dan/ 171'di'ang rje btsun bla ma dam pa 'di nyid kyi nye gnas thugs zin slob ma'i thu bo lugs zung mkhyen dpyod kyi blo gros mkha' ltar yangs shing / bslab pa gsum gyis spras pa karma bud+dha chos 'phel dang yon tan phun tshogs te rnam pa gnyis kyis kho bo rang la yig gzugs thabs ma chag tsam 'bri shes pa dang / rje bla ma 'di yi zhabs pad du yun ring bcar ba rgyu mtshan du mdzad de/ lha rdzas rab dkar/bzang gos rgya ser gyi stod 'gag bcas gnang nas/ rnam thar zhal gsung rtsa tho dang / der ma 'khod pa phyin chad kyi phyag li las byung ba ji ltar bsgyur bkod dang sgro skur med nges shig bri dgos zhes gsungs pa dang du blangs nas/ btsun gzugs karma blo gros 'od zer zhes bgyi bas rab byung bcu drug pa'i bye brag nyi ma zhes pa chu lug lor dbo zla'i dga' ba gsum pa nas dbu bzung / rjod byed kyi tshig la mkhas pa mgu ba'i rnam dpyod ma mchis kyang brjod bya'i don la sgro skur med pa'i tshul gong du so so'i thad nas gsal ba ltar/ kar rabs lha khang bzhengs te rab gnas mdzad grub pa yan chad rje nyid kyi zhal gsung gtso bor bzung / bar skabs mi gsal rigs 'thad 'os gzhan gyis cung zad brgyan/ lo grangs mang tsam ring phyag tho med gras sa bcad ma stong tsam bkod pa dang / me phag lo nas sku gshegs kyi bar phyag li las phyag tho rgyas par gnang 'dug pa rnams mdor bsdus/ gzhan rang gzhan gyis mthong thos rdzun med nges pa'i yid ches can rnams kyang ci rigs par bkod de/ mdor na rang bzo'i skyon che rigs kyis don las phyir phyogs pa med nges pa yin snyam pa 'ba' zhig nag pa zla ba'i tshes 15 mnyam med don kun grub pas dpal ldan 'bras spungs su dus kyi 'khor lo'i rtsa rgyud gsungs pa'i nyin legs par bsgrigs grub pa ste/ 'di la

172 'jam mgon kong sprul sku phreng gnyis pa'i rnam thar/'gal 'khrul gyi tshogs ci mchis mkhas pa rnams la bshags therang gzhan ma lus par dpal ldan bla ma rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phangapa'i rgyur gyur cig /sarba dā ka phywa ṇi bha wan tu// //

dpe skrun smon tshigarig pa'i rdo rje gsung rab mdzod khang nas/ /blo gros mtha' yas mdzod kyi lde mig ces/ /deb phreng 'phrul gyi par du bskrun pa'i dges/ /kun gyi blo gros gter sgo rang dgar 'byed/ /rig pa'i nor bu rigs drug thang mar brdal/ /ma rig rmongs pa'i dbul ba ring du bcil/ /gsung rab rgya mtsho'i brjod don kha yi rlangs/ /mtha' yas skye 'gro'i blo yi mkha' la 'thul/ / rtogs pa'i chu ris snying rje'i sprin du 'khrigs/ /'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i mdzad 'phrin char du bsnyil/ /las nyon mi gtsang dri ma dag par bkrus/ /mngon mtho'i ljang pa lang 'tsho rab tu smin/ /mngon rtogs lam gyi skya rengs ngang gis shar/ /sgrib gnyis mun pa'i go skabs dbyings su nub/ /kun mkhyen rta bdun dbang pos mdun bsus nas/ /chos kyi 'bor lo'i 'od zer 'bum du spros/ /ma lus sdug kun ljan ldin rab tu skem/ /

174 dpe skrun smon tshiga'aphags pa'i tshogs kyi pad tshal ci dgar bzhad/ /mchog gsum snang ba mi nub rtag tu brtan/ /rdzogs ldan dpal yon nam mkha'i spun zlar shar/ /snyigs ma'i rgud cesags mtha' dag cig car zhi/ /bstan 'dzin skyes bus 'dzin ma'i khyon kun gang / /chos kyi sbyin bdag mnga' thang 'byor pa rgyas/ /zab rgyas rgyu mthun chos sku yun du gnas/ /'gro kun bdud bzhi'i g.yul las rnam rgyal ba'i/ /'bras bu chos sku'i go 'phang mngon byed shog /ces pa'ang blo gros mtha' yas pa'i mdzod ces pa'i deb phreng rim byon gyi dpe skrun smon tshig tu 'jam mgon bla brang gi mkhan po'i ming tsam 'dzin pa blo gros rnam rgyal ne gis/ phyi lo 2008 zla 1 tshes 15 nyin bris pa dge'o// //
